If you are serious, punctual, loyal, professional, and want to grow with a company that treats its people like family, we would like to hear from you. ## Main Responsibilities Your responsibilities will include: ### Live Trip Management * Monitor active pedicab trips in real time * Watch for delays, missed pickups, rider issues, customer confusion, and trip problems * Help make sure riders are assigned properly * Help make sure trips are completed correctly * Follow up on recently completed trips when needed * Monitor upcoming trips and make sure they are not missed * Communicate quickly when a trip needs attention ### Customer Communication * Communicate with customers by phone, text, app messaging, or other company communication tools * Answer questions about rides, pickup locations, timing, pricing, and general service * Help customers find the correct pickup location * Handle customer confusion professionally * Calm down upset or frustrated customers * Escalate serious issues to management when needed * Use professional, friendly, clear English at all times ### Rider Communication * Communicate with pedicab riders working in the field * Help riders understand trip details * Help coordinate pickups and drop-offs * Follow up with riders about delays or trip issues * Make sure riders are staying active, responsive, and professional * Report rider problems to management * Keep communication clear, direct, and respectful ### Boardwalk Location Knowledge You will be expected to become very familiar with Ocean City, Maryland, especially the boardwalk area. You will need to learn: * Major hotels * Popular restaurants * Boardwalk attractions * Street numbers * Common pickup and drop-off areas * Landmarks * Busy areas * Restricted or confusing areas * Common tourist destinations You do not need to know this on day one, but you must be willing to study and learn the area quickly. This is extremely important to the role. ### Dispatch and Operations Support You may also help with: * Reservation monitoring * Schedule updates * Rider attendance tracking * Daily shift notes * Customer service logs * Trip issue reports * App/admin system tasks * Basic data entry * End-of-shift reporting * Communicating operational issues to management ## Required Skills Please do not apply unless you have **strong spoken and written English**. This role requires live communication with American customers and American staff. Clear English is not optional. It is one of the most important requirements of the job. You must have: * Excellent written English * Strong spoken English * Good listening skills * Ability to communicate clearly and professionally * Ability to stay calm under pressure * Strong attention to detail * Fast response time * Good judgment * Reliability * Punctuality * Ability to check in before your shift starts * Ability to work independently * Ability to follow systems and procedures * Willingness to learn a live transportation operation * Willingness to work U.S. Eastern Time hours ## Preferred Experience Experience in any of the following is helpful: * Dispatching * Taxi, rideshare, delivery, logistics, or transportation operations * Customer service * Call center work * Virtual assistant work * Travel, hotel, tourism, or hospitality support * Live chat support * Phone support * Operations assistant roles * Scheduling or appointment coordination * CRM or dispatch software * Google Maps or map-based work You do not need to have pedicab experience. We can train the right person. But you must be smart, reliable, communicative, and willing to learn. ## Personality Fit The right person for this role is: * Calm under pressure * Fast to respond * Not easily overwhelmed * Comfortable with live operations * Very organized * Honest * Loyal * Detail-oriented * Good with people * Able to solve problems * Not afraid to ask questions * Willing to take ownership of the role * Serious about punctuality and attendance * Looking for long-term work, not short-term side gigs This job can be busy. You may have multiple rides, riders, and customers needing attention at the same time. We need someone who can think clearly and communicate professionally even when things are moving fast. ## Technology Requirements You must have: * Reliable high-speed internet * A quiet work environment * A working computer * A reliable headset or microphone * Backup internet plan preferred * Ability to use web-based software, messaging apps, maps, spreadsheets, and dispatch/admin tools Because this is a live dispatch role, reliability is extremely important. Internet problems, power problems, or repeated missed shifts will not work for this position. ## Growth Opportunity We are building a long-term team. This role starts as a dispatcher / operations assistant, but there is room to grow into a larger operations role as the company expands. Future growth may include: * Senior dispatcher * Operations manager * Hiring support * Training support * Customer service lead * City launch support * Admin manager * Multi-city operations support We want people who are serious about building a career with us. As Atlantic Pedicabs maintains stability and expands into other cities, there will be more opportunities for dependable people who prove themselves. ## Important Note About English and Professionalism Please only apply if you have strong spoken and written English. This job requires direct communication with customers, riders, and management. If you are not comfortable speaking and writing in English throughout your shift, this will not be the right position. Please also only apply if you are a serious professional. We are looking for someone who respects time, shows up early, communicates clearly, and takes pride in doing the job correctly. We respect everyone’s time and ask that you only apply if you truly meet these requirements. Start Date: Immediate start. We are hiring now and training will begin right away for the right candidate. ## How to Apply To apply, please start your message with: **“Boardwalk Operations”** Then answer the following questions: 1. Why are you interested in this role? 2. Are you available to work 2:00 PM to 12:00 AM Eastern Time, 5 days per week? 3. Are you comfortable working either Monday/Tuesday off or Tuesday/Wednesday off? 4. Describe your spoken and written English level. 5. Tell us about a time you handled an upset customer or a stressful work situation. 6. Do you have any dispatch, customer service, logistics, taxi, delivery, hotel, or operations experience? 7. Are you comfortable learning the Ocean City, Maryland Boardwalk, including hotels, restaurants, attractions, landmarks, and street numbers? 8. What tools or software have you used for work? 9. Do you have reliable internet, a quiet work environment, and a working headset? 10. Are you able to check in a few minutes before every shift? 11. Why should we trust you with a live transportation operation? 12. Are you looking for long-term stable work with room to grow? Applications that do not start with **“Boardwalk Operations”** may not be reviewed. We are looking for serious, reliable, long-term candidates only.

What we need from you: * Create Ukrainian landing page copy for each of the 3 product categories. * You may use AI or translation tools to prepare the Ukrainian content, but the final result must be polished and publication-ready. * Structure each page as a professional offer page, not as a long technical article. * Prepare strong headlines, subheadlines, benefit sections, product/application sections and call-to-action texts. * Adapt the message to B2B clients, construction companies, industrial clients, distributors, public sector buyers or organizations looking for modular infrastructure. * Make the content clear, trustworthy and focused on generating inquiries. * Suggest improvements to the page structure if needed. * Optional but welcome: propose CTA button texts, short form text, SEO title and meta description for each landing page. title: WordPress FSE Expert Implementation Developer
description: ABOUT THE WORK We turn strategy into shipped web properties across a growing portfolio of brands (advisory, education, media, wellness, and client work). This role is about building, not babysitting: standing up new WordPress sites from briefs, extending a shared theme system that powers the whole portfolio, and shipping clean, fast, and on-spec. You'll work from clear scopes against real deadlines, in a codebase that has opinions. We value developers who take ownership, ask sharp questions early, and ship work that doesn't come back. If you do your best work in a quiet, focused, low-drama environment, you'll fit here. THE STACK We build modern block themes. Full Site Editing, theme.json-first styling, block patterns, and template parts. Our brands run on a shared base theme, so a change to the system can ripple across many sites. That means we care more about discipline than plugin count: - Gutenberg / FSE native. We do NOT use Elementor, Divi, Bricks, or WPBakery, and we're not looking to. If your WordPress is "drag the page builder, install 30 plugins," this isn't for you. We use WordPress FSE best practices across the board. No exceptions. - Clean cascade, no shortcuts. theme.json and colocated CSS over global stylesheets. No `!important` when a rule doesn't win, you fix the cause (specificity, source order, markup), not paper over it. - Restraint over abstraction. A pattern, custom block, or template part earns its place by being reused across pages. - Generic, semantic naming. Classes describe form, not location (card, not teaching-card). - WP-CLI fluent. Safe search-replace, db, post, cron, cache. You reach for `wp` before raw SQL, and you back up before you mutate. If that reads as constraints, this isn't your role. If it reads as relief, read on. WHAT WE BUILD New sites & funnel-based buildouts (primary) - Stand up WordPress block-theme sites from briefs, wireframes, or designs - extending the shared base theme rather than reinventing per site - Build pages with native blocks, patterns, and template parts; write theme.json and colocated CSS, not a pile of plugins - Implement to spec: accurate, responsive, cross-browser, fast - Build forms, opt-ins, membership/access-control, and lead flows that work the first time Integrations & tracking (part of every build, not an afterthought) - Wire up Fluent CRM, Amazon SES, affiliate/tracking (Everflow), and similar - Implement and verify GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion/event tracking - and confirm the data actually lands - Connect third-party apps and APIs cleanly when appropriate Performance & quality (baked in) - Ship Core Web Vitals–friendly builds: optimized assets, lean plugin footprint, sane caching - QA across devices and browsers before handoff - no broken links, no console errors, no surprises - Only write custom PHP / JS / CSS where the build genuinely calls for it System & maintenance (secondary, but it matters here) - Extend and harden the shared theme system; keep file-based templates and DB overrides in sync - Updates, fixes, and small enhancements on properties across the portfolio - Document what you changed (we keep changelogs and context notes) so the next person picks up cleanly WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong, demonstrable WordPress FSE build experience - block themes / FSE specifically, not just maintenance or page-builder work. Live URLs you can point to. - Real fluency in JavaScript, HTML, PHP, and CSS - you can read and write custom code, and you understand the cascade well enough to win specificity battles without `!important` - Hands-on with `theme.json`, block patterns, template parts, and WP-CLI - Comfortable with GTM, GA4, and pixel/conversion tracking - Performance and SEO-readiness built into how you work, not bolted on at the end - Self-directed: you run your own task management and communicate cleanly in Slack - Reliable on deadlines and obsessive about the last 5% - the details that make a build feel finished Bonus: experience with membership/access-control or building/maintaining a multi-site portfolio on a shared theme. HOW WE WORK - Remote and async-friendly; some overlap with US Central hours for syncs when needed - Day-to-day comms in Slack - Contract / project-based to start, with steady ongoing work for the right person - Rate: competitive HOW TO APPLY Send: 1. Portfolio - 2–3 WordPress sites you built, with live URLs and one line each on what you actually did. Block-theme/FSE examples get read first. 2. One complex build or integration problem you solved and how you solved it 3. Your availability, timezone, and rate 4. Start your message with the word "Delivery" so we know you read this Strong candidates will be asked to complete a short, paid test build before we move forward.

Expected monthly compensation for a part-time schedule is $260-$650 per month, depending on agreed weekly hours and experience. Candidates who grow into a full-time schedule may be considered for a monthly compensation range of $520-$1,040 per month, depending on scope, performance, and business needs. title: Content Producer / Podcast Manager / Audio & Video Editor
job_title: Content Producer / Podcast Manager / Audio & Video Editor
description: ## About Boost Boost is building an ecosystem of tools and training for independent restaurants, coffee shops, and foodservice operators. Boost Back Office is already launched. It helps restaurant owners better understand and manage the operational numbers behind their business, including inventory, COGS, recipe costing, menu profitability, ordering, and related back-office workflows. Boost Academy is launching soon. It will provide practical, framework-based training for restaurant owners and operators, helping them understand their numbers, improve profitability, and run stronger businesses. Academy will also serve as the top of the funnel for Boost Back Office and, eventually, Boost Front Office. We are looking for a producer/editor/podcast manager who can help turn raw founder-led expertise into polished, useful, publishable content across Academy, social media, YouTube, podcast platforms, and other channels. ## Role Overview We are hiring a Content Producer / Podcast Manager / Audio & Video Editor  to edit and produce content for Boost Academy (course lessons), social media, YouTube, podcast-style content, interviews. The founder will provide the core expertise, frameworks, interviews, screen recordings, and raw audio/video. Your job is to turn that raw material into professional, clear, engaging content that can be published across multiple platforms. This role is part video editor, part content producer, part podcast manager, and part publishing operator. You do not need to own the whole growth strategy, but you do need to be organized, self-directed, detail-oriented, and able to move content from raw recording to finished asset without needing to be micromanaged. You will also help manage the podcast/interview workflow, including coordinating guests, preparing episodes for publishing, producing audio and video versions, and distributing public episodes to all relevant podcast and content platforms. ## What You’ll Own ### Video and Content Production * Editing founder-led videos * Editing interview-style content * Editing Boost Academy course lessons * Cutting long-form videos into short-form clips * Adding captions, titles, hooks, callouts, graphics, zooms, and light motion where useful * Cleaning up audio and improving pacing * Producing videos for YouTube, social media, ads, and course platforms * Formatting content for each platform * Publishing or scheduling content, depending on workflow * Managing content files, versions, exports, and asset organization * Creating reusable editing templates and production systems * Working with the Growth Lead to produce clips and assets based on current campaigns ### Podcast and Interview Management * Helping identify and organize potential podcast/interview guests * Managing guest outreach, scheduling, reminders, and follow-up * Coordinating recording logistics * Preparing guest information, episode notes, and production briefs * Producing full podcast/interview episodes from raw recordings * Creating audio-only podcast versions where appropriate * Creating video podcast versions for Academy, YouTube, and/or other platforms * Writing or preparing episode titles, descriptions, show notes, and timestamps * Creating short promotional clips from each episode * Preparing quote cards, episode graphics, or other promotional assets when needed * Publishing public episodes to all relevant podcast platforms and directories * Promoting episodes across YouTube, social channels, email , and other relevant channels * Maintaining a publishing calendar for podcast and interview content * Tracking episode status from idea to booked, recorded, edited, approved, published, and promoted ## Content Types You May Work On * Academy course lessons * Founder teaching videos * Restaurant profitability breakdowns * COGS/menu pricing videos * Screen recordings and software walkthroughs * Podcast-style interviews * Guest interviews with restaurant owners, operators, vendors, experts, and other relevant people * YouTube videos * Audio podcast episodes * Short-form social clips * Ad creative variations * Customer/community videos * Internal training or onboarding videos ## You Are a Good Fit If You * Can take raw footage and make it clear, polished, and engaging * Understand pacing, hooks, captions, and retention * Can edit educational content without making it feel boring * Can create short-form clips from longer recordings * Can work with screen recordings, talking-head videos, interviews, and course content * Understand basic podcast production workflows * Can manage guest scheduling and episode logistics without constant follow-up * Are organized with files, exports, naming conventions, publishing calendars, and deadlines * Can make judgment calls without needing every edit approved * Are comfortable working with a founder who provides rough material and expects you to help shape it * Can follow brand direction while also improving the output over time * Are reliable, communicative, and consistent ## What Success Looks Like Success in this role means Boost has a consistent content production machine. Key outcomes may include: * Course lessons edited and ready for Academy * Weekly long-form content published * Short-form clips produced from longer recordings * Podcast/interview episodes booked, produced, published, and promoted * Content delivered on schedule * Editing quality improves over time * Clear file organization and repeatable workflows * Founder time spent recording and creating, not editing, publishing, chasing guests, or managing production details * Growth Lead has enough creative assets to test ads and social angles ## Initial Priorities In the first 30 days, I would expect you to help with: * Creating a simple production workflow * Creating editing/export templates for recurring content types * Editing initial Academy lessons * Editing one long-form founder-led or interview-style video * Creating short-form clips from that content * Helping define file organization and handoff process * Setting up or improving the podcast/interview production workflow * Creating a system for guest outreach, booking, episode tracking, and publishing * Identifying any required tools, access, or missing assets ## Time and Work Expectations I care more about effective output than inflated hours. That said, any hours billed to Boost must be hours actively worked for Boost. I do not want overlapping billing, double-booked work, or a situation where someone says they are working eight hours for Boost while actually splitting that same block of time across multiple clients or jobs. I would rather pay more for fewer honest, focused hours than pay for a larger block of time that is not actually dedicated to this business. Please be clear about your real availability, preferred working arrangement, and how many focused hours per week you can reliably commit. ## To Apply Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer the questions below. 1. Describe your biggest win when it comes to producing, editing, repurposing, or managing content. Include what the raw material looked like, what you created from it, and the result. 2. Describe your biggest win when it comes to podcast, interview, YouTube, or long-form content production. Include your role in booking, producing, publishing, or promoting the content. 3. Explain what you would do in week one to get started quickly with Boost. Be specific. I am looking for how you organize, prioritize, and create ---------- ntum. 4. Explain what resources you would need to do this job that you do not have yet. This should not be a wish list. I only want the true requirements: access, tools, files, brand assets, software, information, or people you would need to perform well. 5. Share examples of long-form videos, short-form clips, course lessons, podcast/interview edits, ads, or social content you have produced. 6. Pick one example from your portfolio and explain your role in it. What did you receive, what did you change, and what decisions did you make? 7. If you have managed a podcast or interview show before, explain the workflow you used for guest booking, recording, editing, publishing, and promotion. 8. What does your ideal editing/production workflow look like from raw recording to final published asset? 9. How do you organize files, revisions, exports, episode assets, guest information, and content versions? 10. How would you promote a public podcast/interview episode after it is published? 11. How many focused hours per week can you realistically commit to Boost, and how do you handle time tracking or work logs? 12. Are you currently working with other clients or employers? If so, explain how you avoid overlapping work time and ensure billable hours are dedicated to the client being billed. 13. What kinds of content are you best at producing, and what kinds are outside your strengths? Applications that show strong examples, clear ownership, reliable production habits, and the ability to manage content from idea to publication will be prioritized.

Please be clear about your real availability, preferred working arrangement, and how many focused hours per week you can reliably commit. ## To Apply Please do not send a generic cover letter. Share links to relevant examples, case studies, campaigns, funnels, ads, content systems, or growth work you have led. title: Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA
description: WISE SCOUT RECRUITMENT OPERATIONS & CLIENT SUCCESS VA Remote · Full-Time ABOUT WISE SCOUT Wise Scout is a recruitment firm that helps small and growing businesses find and hire exceptional remote talent, primarily in the Philippines. We're a small, tight-knit team that does meaningful work: we match the right people with the right opportunities and help businesses build teams they're genuinely proud of. We're a caring, lighthearted team that believes work should be purposeful but not all-consuming. We care about our families, our people, and doing things well. If you've ever wanted to be part of a company where you're treated as a person first — this is that place. We're growing, and this hire is a critical next step. The person who steps into this role won't just support the work, they'll help shape how we operate and eventually build a team of their own. ROLE OVERVIEW We're looking for a Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA to be the operational engine behind Wise Scout's hiring pipelines and client relationships. This is a role for someone who loves moving things forward; who sees a task and gets it done without waiting to be told twice. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our recruitment process: setting up client meetings, building assessment pipelines, posting jobs, filtering candidates, tracking progress, and keeping clients informed every step of the way. You'll also support internal HR for our staff and jump into client-facing calls when needed. This isn't a role where you'll wait for perfect instructions. We have processes — many of them — but they're still being refined. You'll need to be comfortable stepping into some ambiguity, figuring out what the next step is, and moving forward. If that excites you, you'll thrive here. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY This role requires meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours, as client meetings and internal team calls happen in U.S. time zones. - At least half of your working hours must be available during U.S. business hours in the Central time zone. During busy weeks, around a quarter of your hours will be spent in the U.S. Central time afternoons (between 12–4am PHT) - Weekly all-hands meeting with the full Wise Scout team (Tuesdays 2pm CST/3am PHT) - Weekly operational sync with Hiring Coordinator to drive hiring pipelines forward - Schedule is otherwise flexible; we trust you to manage your time and deliver results WHAT YOU'LL OWN This role is broad but focused. Here are the five core areas you'll be responsible for: 1. CLIENT COMMUNICATION & RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT - Set up and schedule intro calls with new clients; follow up with meeting notes, to-dos, and next steps - Maintain consistent, professional communication with clients throughout the hiring process - Send follow-up check-ins over days and weeks to stay top of mind with prospective clients - Represent Wise Scout warmly and confidently in email and on video calls - Potentially run intro meetings and hiring calls with clients independently over time 2. HIRING PIPELINE MANAGEMENT - Build and manage assessment pipelines in Criteria Corp for each active role - Write experience questionnaires: self-assessment quizzes designed to quantify a candidate's background through how they answer, not just what they say - Post job descriptions across multiple job boards - Download and score applicants in spreadsheets; filter to top candidates based on scores and answers - Move candidates through each stage of the pipeline with clear documentation and communication 3. RECRUITMENT REPORTING & TRACKING - Maintain a master tracking spreadsheet showing all open roles, current stage, and time-in-process for each - Upload data and report regularly to leadership on pipeline health: how many applicants, who's moving forward, and where things stand - Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between steps or between client touchpoints 4. JOB DESCRIPTION WRITING - Use AI tools (and interview notes) to draft compelling, accurate job descriptions for each client role - Collaborate with team to refine and finalize before posting 5. INTERNAL HR & STAFF SUPPORT - Check in regularly with Wise Scout's internal staff to gauge workload, morale, and needs - Answer basic technical questions about Slack, ---------- , and other internal tools - Track team hours in ---------- , compile timesheets, and submit payroll through ---------- - Support onboarding of new hires as the team grows WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Skills and tools can be taught. What we can't teach is the right wiring. Here's what that looks like for this role: YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU: - Are self-directed; you see what needs to happen next, and you do it - Love checking things off a list and moving tasks forward without being prompted - Are detail-oriented without being paralyzed by perfectionism — 90% shipped beats 100% stuck - Communicate openly and confidently, both in writing and on video calls - Are comfortable making mistakes and talking about them honestly, so the team can move on - Solve problems independently; you Google it, look at how it was done before, and figure it out - Enjoy understanding the whole process, not just your piece of it - Can hold a lot of moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF YOU: - Need clear, step-by-step instructions for everything before you can act - Are uncomfortable with ambiguity or imperfect processes - Avoid difficult conversations or are reluctant to give or receive direct feedback - Struggle to communicate confidently with clients or leadership - Get overwhelmed when managing multiple tasks or clients at once TOOLS YOU'LL WORK WITH You must arrive proficient in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Gmail. Everything else can be learned on the job. - Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Meet (must-have on day one) - Slack: internal team communication - Criteria Corp: assessment and hiring pipeline tool (we'll train you) - ---------- : time tracking for internal staff - QuickBooks Online: bookkeeping and invoicing (light exposure helpful) - ---------- : payroll and payments - AI writing tools: to assist with job descriptions, email s, and candidate summaries - Fathom or similar AI note takers: for meeting documentation WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE To be clear about scope: - No marketing, social media, or content creation - No image design or creative work - No bookkeeping or accounting responsibility TRAINING & ONBOARDING This position includes a three-month training and onboarding period. We don't expect perfection on day one — we invest in getting you up to speed the right way. Here's roughly what the arc looks like: - Week 1: Learn our tools, processes, and active client roster; shadow existing pipelines; get familiar with our communication style and documentation - Month 1: Take ownership of client communication for existing roles; begin building and managing assessment pipelines with guidance - Month 2: Run pipeline reporting independently; begin drafting job descriptions and experience questionnaires with light review - Month 3: Fully own your client relationships and hiring pipelines; begin joining or running client calls; formal performance review at 90 days We meet regularly throughout; you won't be left guessing. And if something isn't working, we'll talk about it directly and fix it together. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS We believe in being transparent about what you can earn — not just today, but down the road. Here's the full picture: This position includes a three-month training and onboarding period, compensated at $5.50/hour. After this period, compensation increases to $6.00–$7.00/hour for the following nine months. After your first full year, compensation increases to $7.50–$9.00/hour based on performance, with annual raises to follow. Over the next 3–5 years, this individual would progress into a strategically focused leadership role, managing a team of their own, at compensation ranging from $30,000–$40,000 USD annually ($1.7M–$2.25M Philippine pesos). ADDITIONAL DETAILS: - Twice-monthly payroll: hours worked 1st–15th paid on the 20th; 16th–end of month paid on the 5th - Monthly PhilHealth and SSS contribution reimbursement (minimum $30/month), beginning after your training period - Annual performance-based raises - Performance bonuses or profit sharing eligibility beginning at 9 months - 15 days PTO per year (years 1–2)  -> 18 days (years 2–5)  -> 21 days (5+ years) - 6–8 paid holidays (U.S. holidays observed; flexibility for key Philippine holidays) GROWTH & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY This is not a dead-end role — it's a launchpad. As Wise Scout grows, so does this position. The person who excels here will have the opportunity to move into a team leadership role, eventually managing a small team of their own that supports the full client roster. That means more responsibility, more compensation, and a real career path — not just a job. We're not looking for someone to plug a gap. We're looking for someone to grow with us for the long haul. If you're still here in three years, we want you to look back and say this was one of the best decisions you ever made. The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then a live face-to-face interview. Then we will make our final decision. title: Supply Chain & Logistics Manager
description: Supply Chain & Logistics Manager: The Supply Chain & Logistics Manager owns end-to-end supply chain, inventory planning, and logistics operations at Teton. This role is responsible for ensuring the right inventory is available at the right time to support customer demand, sales growth, and operational efficiency across domestic fulfillment and direct import fulfillment programs. This position serves as the primary bridge between Sales and Operations, partnering closely with Account Managers, Purchasing, Warehouse Operations, Product Development, Finance, and Client Services to proactively plan inventory, support customer opportunities, and execute fulfillment strategies that meet customer expectations. The Supply Chain & Logistics Manager is responsible for maintaining inventory availability across Teton facilities, fulfillment partners, and customer-specific programs while balancing service levels, inventory investment, and supply chain risk. Success in this role requires strong collaboration with the Sales team to understand upcoming customer needs, forecast demand, secure inventory, and develop fulfillment solutions that support both domestic distribution and direct import programs. This role also manages supplier relationships, international freight operations, fulfillment network optimization, and logistics support staff. Full-time: 40 hours per week, Mountain Daily Time Reports to: Director of Operations ________________________________________ Key Responsibilities Sales Partnership & Customer Fulfillment • Partner closely with the Sales team to understand customer opportunities, forecasted demand, program launches, and inventory requirements. • Ensure inventory availability and fulfillment readiness to support sales growth, customer commitments, and account retention. • Develop inventory and fulfillment strategies for both domestic distribution and direct import customer programs. • Provide proactive inventory visibility, supply chain risk assessments, and replenishment recommendations to Sales and Account Management teams. • Participate in customer planning discussions and support large opportunities by evaluating inventory availability, lead times, sourcing options, and fulfillment solutions. • Coordinate cross-functional execution of customer-specific inventory programs, special buys, launch inventories, and direct import shipments. • Identify potential inventory constraints and collaborate with Sales and Operations to develop mitigation plans before customer service is impacted. • Serve as the operational owner of inventory availability and fulfillment performance for key customer programs. Supply Chain Planning & Inventory Management • Own inventory planning and replenishment strategies across all Teton facilities and fulfillment partners. • Monitor inventory levels, inventory health, and stock availability to ensure Sales teams can confidently support customer demand and growth opportunities. • Lead collaborative forecasting efforts with Sales, Purchasing, and Operations to align inventory investments with customer demand, strategic initiatives, and revenue goals. • Analyze inventory performance, safety stock levels, and inventory turns to optimize working capital while maintaining service levels. • Develop inventory allocation strategies that prioritize customer commitments, key accounts, and growth opportunities while balancing overall inventory health. • Identify risks related to inventory shortages, excess inventory, supplier delays, and demand fluctuations, and develop mitigation plans. • Maintain accurate inventory data and reporting within Fishbowl Inventory and other operational systems. • Support product launches, seasonal demand planning, and inventory allocation strategies. • Establish additional fulfillment centers as needed and manage inventory movement between locations. Supplier & Procurement Coordination • Partner with suppliers and factories to align production schedules, readiness dates, lead times, and shipment planning. • Monitor supplier performance related to quality, lead times, capacity, and delivery reliability. • Support supplier communication, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Assist with sourcing projects and supply chain optimization efforts as needed. Inbound Logistics • Manage end-to-end inbound freight from international suppliers to all Teton facilities and Canadian 3PL partners. • Coordinate directly with factories on readiness dates, booking lead times, ship windows, INCOTERMS, and routing compliance. • Manage container bookings, shipment tracking, and coordination with freight forwarders and customs brokers. • Ensure accuracy and compliance of all import documentation, packaging specifications, labeling, and shipping requirements. • Maintain complete visibility of inbound shipments and expected inventory receipts. • Analyze freight spend, transit times, and landed costs to drive efficiency and negotiate competitive rates. monitor key supply chain metrics, including inventory turns, fill rates, forecast accuracy, freight costs, and supplier performance. • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, cost control, and data accuracy. ________________________________________ Qualifications • 5+ years of experience in supply chain management, inventory planning, international logistics, freight forwarding, or related operations roles. • Strong understanding of supply chain planning, inventory management, forecasting, procurement, and logistics operations. • Experience with AI Forecasting Tools • Demonstrated experience partnering with Sales teams to support customer demand planning, inventory availability, and fulfillment execution. • Strong knowledge of international title: Full Charge Bookkeeper - US Transportation Company
job_title: Full Charge Bookkeeper - US Transportation Company
description: Higher Ground Transportation Services, Inc.  · ---------- ·  Remote / Virtual  ·  Full-Time Salary About You ---------------- You're the kind of person who genuinely enjoys making a business's finances make sense. The messy QuickBooks file, the pile of unreconciled accounts, the invoices going out late — these aren't just problems to you, they're puzzles worth solving. You've worked with US small businesses before, you know how to talk to clients and subcontractors without hand-holding, and you take quiet pride in the fact that your books are clean, your reports land on time, and your principals never have to wonder what's happening with the money. If you're looking for a role where you own the financial system — not just maintain it — and where your attention to detail and follow-through directly shapes whether a growing transportation company hits its numbers, this is it. About Higher Ground Transportation Services ---------------- Higher Ground Transportation Services is a Baltimore-based transportation company that moves students, construction crews, and other clients reliably, every day. Founded and led by CEO Jan, with COO Teressa running operations, Higher Ground has earned contracts with Baltimore City Public Schools, Clark Construction, DPR, and a growing roster of partners. The company is at an inflection point — scaling up, bringing financial operations in-house, and building the systems that will support its next phase of growth. The person who steps into this role will have a direct line to leadership and a real stake in getting the financial foundation right. About the Role ---------------- This is a full-time, fully remote bookkeeping and financial operations role reporting directly to Jan (CEO). You'll own the company's books in QuickBooks, manage AR and AP, handle high-volume invoicing across multiple contract types, coordinate subcontractor billing, and produce the monthly financial statements that give Jan and Teressa the visibility they need to run the business. You'll also serve as the primary point of contact for client billing questions and work closely with Jan's Virtual Assistant to keep the quote-to-booking pipeline moving. This is a build role. You'll inherit a QuickBooks file that needs cleanup, processes that need documentation, and a financial operation that needs ownership. If you like starting with a blank slate and making it better, this is the right opportunity. What You'll Do ---------------- Core bookkeeping and financial operations: • Own the QuickBooks file — clean it up, keep it current, and make it the reliable source of truth for the business • Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts monthly • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable end-to-end • Produce monthly financial statements: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, AR aging, AP aging • Support year-end preparation and CPA coordination Invoicing and contract billing: • Handle all customer invoicing — accurately, on time, and on cadence — for schools, construction clients, summer camps, and subcontractor trips • Populate client-specific invoice templates with zero-error accuracy (dates, trip data, PO numbers) • Manage invoicing volume during peak periods (500+ trips over an 8-week summer camp season) Subcontractor and DPR contract management: • Collect, review, and verify subcontractor invoices against actual work performed • Communicate with subcontractors regarding missing information, corrections, payment status, and deadlines • Manage dedicated invoicing for the DPR contract and farmed-in trips Client communication and revenue operations: • Follow up on unpaid invoices and lapsed quotes — professionally and persistently • Confirm quote acceptance, payment method, and PO requirements before trips are finalized • Work with Jan's VA to keep the Working Document current: quote status, payment method, PO requirements, invoice status, trip readiness A Day in the Life ---------------- You start the morning by reviewing the QuickBooks dashboard and flagging anything that needs same-day attention — an overdue invoice, a subcontractor payment due this week, a reconciliation discrepancy from yesterday. You send the daily status note to Jan before 9am without being asked. Mid-morning, you pull the BCPS invoices for the previous week's trips, populate the mileage and time formulas in the client template, and transmit them on schedule. You follow up by phone with a construction client whose invoice from three weeks ago is still outstanding — you've email ed twice; this one needs a call. After lunch, you reconcile the last of the credit card accounts for month-end, generate the AR aging report, and flag one account that's gone 60 days past due for Jan's review. You finish the day by entering three new subcontractor invoices, verifying them against the trip log, and updating the Working Document so the VA has current status on tomorrow's pending bookings. Nothing dropped. The books moved. Leadership has what they need. What We're Looking For ---------------- Must have: • Strong QuickBooks proficiency — QBO experience required, ProAdvisor certification strongly preferred • Experience cleaning up and maintaining bookkeeping files (not just inheriting a clean set of books) • Full-cycle AR/AP experience including proactive collections follow-up • Demonstrated high-volume invoicing experience — accuracy under volume pressure • Professional English communication — written and verbal, including client-facing calls • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and meet deadlines without reminders • Experience supporting US-based businesses Strongly preferred: • Prior experience at a CPA firm, accounting firm, or multi-client bookkeeping service • Experience with client-specific invoice templates and contract-based billing • Experience managing subcontractor or vendor invoices • Familiarity with Limo Anywhere or willingness to learn it quickly • Experience supporting small and growing businesses (owner-operator environment) Schedule & Compensation  ---------------- Full-time, fully remote. Core hours aligned to US Eastern Time, with consistent availability during business hours for client and internal communication. Compensation is structured at full-time equivalent of $12/hr USD, with compensation options, vacation and other benefits discussed transparently in the offer process based on qualifications and experience. A 90-day performance review is standard. How to Apply  ---------------- Please apply to this position through our online application.  This gives us a better opportunity to understand your fit for the role.  Any submissions provided through this job site will not be reviewed. Apply Here: ---------- The application includes your basic information, resume upload (cover letter optional), 4 questions.  You will also be able to upload a loom if desired or send it in a follow up email .

title: MSP IT Support Technician
description: MSP IT Support Technician — Job Description About Us We are a small, family-oriented Managed Services Provider based in Northern California, USA. Our team is made up of just two to three people, and we treat each other like family — not like numbers on an org chart. We work closely together every single day, helping each other solve problems, sharing knowledge, and making sure no one is ever left to figure things out alone. If you have ever wanted to be part of a team where you truly matter, where your contributions are noticed and appreciated, and where the people you work with genuinely care about you — this is that place. We pride ourselves on the deep, lasting relationships we build with our clients. Our customers are not just ticket numbers or account names. They are small business owners, professionals, and teams who depend on us every day to keep their technology running smoothly. We take that trust seriously. Every interaction we have with a customer is an opportunity to show them that they are valued, heard, and appreciated. We do not just fix problems — we make people feel taken care of. That philosophy is at the heart of everything we do, and it is the single most important quality we look for in every person who joins our team. The Role We are hiring an MSP IT Support Technician to join our small, close-knit team. This is a full-time, work-from-home position. You will be the friendly, knowledgeable voice and presence our customers interact with when they need help. Your primary responsibility will be to field incoming support requests from customers via phone calls, email s, and text messages, turn those requests into organized tickets in our system, and then work to resolve them — either on your own or by collaborating closely with the rest of the team. This is not a siloed role where you are handed a queue and left to grind through it alone. You will be working side by side with the team throughout the day, communicating constantly, asking questions, sharing ideas, and leaning on each other to deliver the best possible outcomes for our customers. We believe that the best support comes from a team that actually talks to each other, and we have built our workflow around that belief. Working Hours Your working hours will be 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday, Los Angeles, California time (Pacific Time). You must be available and at your desk during these hours. Our customers operate on this schedule, and being reachable and responsive during their business day is essential to the role. Key Responsibilities Customer Communication & Support Intake Answer incoming phone calls from customers who are reaching out for technical support. You will be the first point of contact for many of our clients, so a warm, patient, and professional phone presence is essential. Monitor and respond to support requests received via email and text message throughout the workday. For each request, gather all relevant details from the customer — what the issue is, when it started, what they have already tried, and any other information that will help us solve the problem efficiently. Create well-organized, detailed support tickets in our ticketing system for every request, ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks and that the team has the information needed to start working the issue immediately. Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting Work through support tickets to diagnose and resolve technical issues across a variety of client environments. Typical issues you will encounter include workstation and laptop problems, printer and peripheral connectivity, email and Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, network and internet connectivity issues, password resets and account lockouts, software installation and configuration, VPN and remote access problems, and basic server and infrastructure alerts. You will not be expected to know everything or solve every problem on your own. Part of your job is knowing when to ask for help and collaborating with teammates to find the right answer. We solve problems together. Ticket Management & Documentation Keep tickets updated with clear, thorough notes so that any tea ---------- mber can pick up where you left off. Document the steps you took, what you found, and what was done to resolve the issue. Maintain accurate records within our systems, including client assets, configurations, and procedures. Good documentation is what allows our small team to operate efficiently and deliver consistent, high-quality support across all of our clients. Team Collaboration & Continuous Learning Participate actively in daily team communication — whether that is a quick call, a group chat message, or a screen-sharing session to work through a tough problem together. Share what you learn with the team so that we all grow together. Stay current on the technologies and platforms our clients use, and be open to learning new tools and systems as our client base evolves. What We Are Looking For Required Previous experience in IT helpdesk or technical support, whether in an internal IT department or at a Managed Services Provider. We are not looking for a specific number of years — we are looking for someone who genuinely knows their way around common IT support scenarios and can hit the ground running with real-world troubleshooting skills. Familiarity with the day-to-day realities of MSP work. If you have previously worked at an MSP, you already understand the pace, the variety, the multi-client juggling act, and the importance of documentation and ticket hygiene. That experience is a big plus. Strong English communication skills. You will be communicating directly with our customers through email , text, and phone calls. Your English must be clear, professional, and easy to understand. You should be comfortable writing detailed email s, carrying on a natural phone conversation, and adjusting your tone depending on the situation — whether it is a calm explanation to a frustrated user or a friendly check-in after resolving an issue. A genuinely friendly, patient, and positive personality. This is not optional and it is not a soft requirement — it is central to who we are as a company. Our customers need to feel appreciated and taken care of every time they interact with us. If you are the kind of person who naturally puts people at ease, who stays calm under pressure, and who actually enjoys helping others, you will thrive here. Reliability and consistency. You need to be at your desk, ready to work, during our business hours every day. Our customers depend on us being available, and your teammates depend on you being present and engaged. A reliable home office setup including a stable, high-speed internet connection (at least 25 Mbps), a quiet workspace free from background noise during phone calls, and a computer capable of running multiple remote access sessions and browser tabs simultaneously. A headset with a quality microphone for clear voice communication on customer phone calls. Preferred (Nice to Have, Not Required) Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Entra ID (Azure AD). Familiarity with RMM and PSA tools such as Atera, NinjaOne, or similar platforms. Working knowledge of Windows Server environments, Active Directory, and Group Policy. Basic networking knowledge — understanding of DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall basics, and general LAN/WAN connectivity troubleshooting. Experience with backup and disaster recovery platforms such as Veeam, Acronis, or similar solutions. Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or Microsoft certifications. Experience using a ticketing system and understanding of basic ticket lifecycle management. What It Is Like to Work With Us We are not a large, impersonal company. We are a handful of people who genuinely like each other, look out for each other, and want to see each other succeed. When you join our team, you are not filling a seat — you are becoming part of something small and meaningful. Your work will be visible. Your impact will be felt. And the relationships you build with our customers will matter, because those relationships are the foundation of our business. We maintain a positive, friendly, and collaborative work environment and it is a high priority for us that every tea ---------- mber contributes to that culture. We want people who are likeable, who bring good energy, and who make the people around them — teammates and customers alike — feel better for having interacted with them. If that sounds like you, we would genuinely love to hear from you. Compensation & Benefits Competitive monthly salary in USD Paid time off 13th-month pay Permanent work-from-home setup — no commute, no dress code, just a comfortable place to do great work. A supportive team that actually has your back.

That means you will: Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts What Success Looks Like Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids. Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward. You are successful when: Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained You bring smart recommendations before being asked You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics You identify problems early and come with solutions You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence What We Do Not Want This role is not a fit for someone who: Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids Waits to be told what to do Runs mostly auto and category campaigns Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters Avoids accountability for business outcomes Needs someone else to create the strategy Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work. We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives. Responsibilities Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies Review performance trends and create clear action plans Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets. Goals for This Role The goal of this role is simple: Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business. You will be expected to: Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts Build client trust through clear strategic communication Create proactive recommendations that lead to action Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand Turn data into decisions Own outcomes, not just tasks Requirements 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience Must be able to run accounts manually. Must also be familiar with Pacvue Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs Preferred Experience Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance Who Will Thrive Here You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable. You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next. You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter. Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance. It is leadership.

description: This role directly determines our revenue. Abrahams Consulting LLC holds NASA SEWP VI Contract #80TECH26D1658 — a $20 billion federal IT contract. Abrahams Consulting LLC holds NASA SEWP VI Contract #80TECH26D1658 — a $20 billion federal IT contract. We can only sell what is loaded into our NASA catalog. You are the person who builds, maintains, and prices that catalog. Without a well-managed catalog, there are no orders. This is hire #3 on a brand-new government contract team. **The scale of this catalog 9 IT technical areas to catalog across 5,000 Max line items per daily submission 500+ Target items loaded within 60 days The nine technology areas span everything from laptops and servers to software, cloud platforms, networking equipment, AV systems, security tools, and product-based services. Your job is to build this catalog from the ground up and keep it accurate, priced correctly, and growing. **About the role You will be responsible for building and maintaining our entire IT product catalog on NASA's SEWP portal. This involves submitting structured data files called Technology Refreshments (TRs) to add, update, and remove products, assigning the correct UN product classification codes (UNSPSC), and ensuring every price we post is at or below our GSA Schedule price. You will also track product lifecycle — removing discontinued items before NASA flags them. This is a data-heavy, process-driven role. You need to be comfortable working with large spreadsheets, following strict formatting rules, and managing hundreds to thousands of product records with precision. A single incorrect price or wrong product code has real consequences on a federal government contract. Required availability: Monday–Friday, overlap with US Eastern Time business hours — flexible on specific hours but must be reachable during the day for coordination with the PM and DPM. What you will do Build the initial product catalog — Load our first 500+ products into the NASA SEWP database within the first 60 days. Work with our Program Manager and supplier contacts to gather product names, descriptions, part numbers, pricing, and UNSPSC codes for each item. Submit Technology Refreshments (TRs) — Prepare and submit daily TR files in the required keyword-value text format to add new products, update existing ones, change pricing, and remove discontinued items. Follow strict NASA formatting rules — no attachments, no HTML, no logos in TR email s. Assign UNSPSC codes — Every product in the catalog must have a correct 8-digit United Nations Standard Products and Services Code. You will learn and apply this coding system to accurately classify all IT products and services we offer. Monitor and maintain price compliance — Our SEWP prices must always be equal to or lower than our GSA Schedule prices. You will check prices regularly, flag any discrepancies, and submit corrections. If a supplier drops their price, you must update our catalog and notify the Contracting Officer within 7 calendar days. Manage product lifecycle (End of Life) — Track when products are discontinued by manufacturers. Any item on contract for more than 18 months without activity may be flagged by NASA. You will proactively EOL items before that happens. Manage provider/supplier records — For each manufacturer or supplier we resell, maintain accurate provider records in the SEWP system including supply chain level designations (Authorized Reseller, Subset Reseller, etc.) and supplier point of contact information. Support quote building — When the PM or DPM builds quotes for federal agencies, you will be the reference point for accurate product details, current pricing, and CLIN numbers. Help verify that every item quoted is active in the SEWP catalog. Maintain catalog accuracy reports — Keep internal spreadsheets tracking what is in the catalog, what needs updating, what is coming up for EOL, and what new products are pending submission. What you need to know about TR rules NASA has strict rules for catalog submissions. Maximum 1 regular TR per day. Maximum 5,000 line items per TR. TR files must be plain text (.txt) in keyword-value format — no attachments, no logos, no HTML. Submitting incorrectly formatted TRs results in exclusions and delays. You will be trained on the exact format, but attention to detail is non-negotiable from day one. Requirements Must have -Advanced Microsoft Excel — you will manage large product datasets, do price comparisons, and build tracking spreadsheets -Strong data entry accuracy — product codes, prices, and part numbers must be exact -Experience managing product catalogs, databases, or large data sets -Comfortable learning and applying structured classification systems (like UNSPSC codes) -Highly organized — you will track hundreds to thousands of products simultaneously -Good written English for internal coordination with the PM/DPM team -Reliable high-speed internet + professional home office setup -Full-time availability, Monday–Friday Nice to have* -Experience with e-commerce product catalog management (Shopify, Amazon Seller, etc.) -Familiarity with IT hardware and software products (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Cisco, Microsoft, etc.) -Experience with GSA Schedule pricing or government procurement -Background in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain -Experience with product classification systems or data standardization -Prior experience working with US-based clients or employers Why this role is different -Revenue-critical work -The catalog you build is what generates all our orders. Your work has direct business impact. -Supporting a NASA contract -Your work sits at the heart of a $20 billion federal IT procurement vehicle. -Long-term stability -10-year contract. This is not a short gig — it is a career-level role. -Build something from zero -You are creating the entire catalog from scratch. Real ownership from day one. title: Outbound Calling Sales Person/Onboarding Manager
description: I am the founder of an online marketplace platform that is similar to airbnb, except it's specifically designed for long-term-care facilities for the elderly and disabled. We serve Adult Family Homes, Assisted Living Facilities and Nursing Homes. When one of these homes has an empty room available for an elderly person, they can list it on our website with photos and pricing info. When a family needs to find care for an elderly parent, they can go on our site and search their city to see all the available rooms nearby. They can contact the business with any questions, schedule a tour, request a quote or book the room. We're looking for a friendly, patient and self motivated outbound caller with outstanding sales and English speaking skills. The ideal candidate is a very committed person seeking steady and long-term employment in a position that will help thousands of elderly people and small business owners. This position is full time. Job Description: You will be cold-calling assisted living businesses to offer to list their available rooms on our website/platform for free - so that families can find them easier. 90% of the time, the people you will be speaking with are the business owners themselves. (The other 10% will be their employees.) Most facilities accept Medicaid clients. (Medicaid is a social service for low-income individuals. The government pays the cost of their care, but at a much lower price than private-pay) Business owners will have the option to post their Medicaid openings for free, or if they are looking for private pay clients, they can post their private pay openings on a monthly subscription (optional). If they agree to sign up and list their room(s), you will start by creating an account for them. You will ask their name, email and phone number. After you create an account for them, you'll then attach them as a user to their Organization profile. The next step is to ask them specific questions about their facility as you fill out their facility details such as Contact info, amenities, alcohol, tobacco, pets policies, equipment, and what they do or don't do at their facility. You'll then create two listings for them over the phone. One free Medicaid listing, and one Private Pay listing. The Medicaid listing will be published and live right away, but the private pay listing will stay unpublished. You'll ask them certain questions about about the room they have available, and about the services they offer, and what type of client they are looking for. You'll check all the boxes with their answers. You'll then ask them to get on our website either from their computer or phone, and you'll ask them to search their city from our homepage, and see how their listing looks. You will explain exactly how the entire process works, and instruct them where to click and exactly what to do. You'll explain how the free Medicaid listings work, and how the paid Private Pay subscriptions work. We have a very specific word-for-word script that you'll follow until you have the script and process memorized. Once you end the call, you'll send them a welcome email with additional instructions. The email will have instructions for setting a password, updating any of the facility information, adding photos, and starting a private pay subscription. They can either add photos themselves or email you their photos, and you'll need to add them to their listings. You will update a spreadsheet with all the businesses you sign up every day. You will remain their point of contact in case they need any help on their account. When we call businesses this way, we sign up 1.5 - 2 new accounts/listings per hour, and you will have no problem doing the same within just the first few weeks. The difference between this position and a typical cold-calling sales/telemarketing position is that the majority of the businesses you will be calling are actually happy to hear from you and are excited that you will help them. They have a hard time filling their empty rooms, and there is no service quite like ours. There are no angry people yelling at us or hanging up the phone. Please note that the majority of business owners you call are not native English speakers. Most are immigrants from other countries, and may have limited English and limited experience with computers/internet/technology. This role requires absolute patience. These people have huge hearts for caring for elderly and disabled people, but require some patience with technology. They are usually very self-aware and will tell you they are not good at computers, and they're extremely grateful for our absolute patience in showing them how it all works and explaining in a way that they understand. Pay: The pay is $1,000 month for full time 8 hours per day - plus commissions. While we are ok with the providers creating only free Medicaid listings, we definitely want them to list their private pay listings for the $199/monthly subscription. The $199/month gets them Google Ads, so they will get real google leads to see their listings and contact them directly to book their room. Most of their $199/month goes directly toward Google Ads. Your commission on every single paid subscription is $10. Most clients do not pay for a subscription on-the-spot over the phone, but instead they subscribe in the weeks following your phone call. If a business that you called and signed up pays for a subscription within 3 months of your phone call, you will earn the $10 commission. Every month that they stay subscribed, you will keep getting the $10 commission. Once they find a client and fill their room, they can unsubscribe and remove their ad. If another room becomes available later, and they subscribe again to advertise their opening, you will get the same $10 commission again every month - as long as they re-subscribe within 7 months of ending their first subscriptions. These businesses get an opening every 3-4 months. The average time it takes for them fill a room is 4-6 months. Payday is twice a month around the 1st and the 16th using Payoneer. Trial Period: After the initial training period, you'll start the calls at your own pace on your own. We need to see some of your accounts start signing up for the paid subscriptions as you get more confident and improve. There's a learning curve and the script can be difficult to memorize at first, but overall we'll monitor your sign ups and subscriptions over 2 - 3 months after training. We will know in the first few weeks if you are struggling badly, and will support you with as much additional training as needed. We are patient and willing to spend extra time with you as long as we're seeing improvements. If it looks like you're struggling with no noticeable improvement, or are far below the average with sign-ups, we may end your employment. This has never happened with anyone, but still worth mentioning. Training: I will be training you personally along with our sales director William. He is also Filipino, and has been working with us for over 2 years. We can get on video calls with you as you listen to my calls or William's calls, and watch our screen for the entire calls. You can ask any and all questions in between calls. We'll also send you hours of screen-recorded samples of successful calls to watch and memorize. You can access our Test website and create practice accounts to get used to the software navigation. We will be hiring 3 people for this role, and you'll have the ability to practice doing mock calls with each other to get comfortable with the script. It is a fairly long script because it goes from signing them up, updating their facility info, listing their rooms, to you leading an interactive website demo that they follow along as you explain to them how it all works. It will require some practice, memorization and patience to get comfortable. If you apply for this position, please mention "the assisted living marketplace". Once you're comfortable, you can start calling people as we listen in and watch your screen. If you prefer to record your calls, instead of having us monitor live, that works too. Then you will continue on your own with periodic check-ins from William or myself. Any questions you ever have, you can text or email myself or William. Requirements: Eagerness to memorize the script and process, honesty, patience and communication. We want you to do well and we will continue to train you as long as needed for you to succeed. If you're struggling with anything, please don't be shy or embarrassed or try to hide it. We want to help! We can only succeed if you're succeeding. I've failed more than anyone, and nobody is going to judge you or be mean to you. Outstanding English speaking skills and genuine friendly personality. Our approach is very different from typical cold call sales positions and we will train you until you're a master. Fast reliable Internet, computer and a smart-phone is required. We will provide access to virtual phone numbers through QUO app that you can call/text from. We will also set you up with a company email that you can email from and give to your customers in case they need any further assistance from you with their account. Benefit/PTO You will get 13th month pay in December. In the first year, it the bonus will be relative to the number of months you worked in that first year. You will get 15 days PTO that you choose. You can only take PTO days after 90 days of working unless pre-approved during interview process. There will be 7 additional US holidays that will be paid including Christmas, New Years Day, Thanksgiving, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Memorial Day. Time Zone: Our company is near Seattle, WA USA and the Time Zone is Pacific Time. The calling/working hours are between 8am - 5pm Pacific time. This is a full time position for 8 hrs per day. You can choose which 8 hrs to work as long as it's Mon - Fri within 8am - 5pm Pacific. If you wish to apply for this position, please provide an English voice sample with your application saying the following lines: "Hi, I was calling to see if you guys have a room available?" "Perfect! I work with families, with hospitals, and with Medicaid to help you get clients without agencies or referral fees. We have a website where we list Adult Family Homes that have current openings. Would you be against me adding your availability to our site?" If you have any questions or if there's anything I missed, please let me know. Thank you! Vitaly

The ideal candidate is a planner and project manager at heart — someone who loves details, checklists, logistics, timelines, clear communication, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You will help take a simple trip outline and turn it into a complete, polished, highly detailed itinerary with every important step accounted for. This includes gathering essential information, confirming details with clients and vendors, researching travel logistics, checking drive times and transfer flow, coordinating reservations and activities, tracking deadlines, and helping ensure each trip runs smoothly from start to finish. We are a boutique surf travel company that plans elevated, highly customized trips for families, couples, groups, and corporate clients. Our clients expect thoughtful planning, accurate information, beautiful trip flow, and excellent service. This role is essential to delivering that experience. This is a remote position. A strong internet connection, excellent written English, and comfort using remote work tools are required. We use Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, Zoho Cliq, email , shared documents, spreadsheets, and online research tools. Key Responsibilities Trip Planning & Itinerary Execution - Turn high-level trip outlines into detailed, step-by-step travel itineraries. - Research and verify important trip details such as travel times, transfer logistics, activity timing, restaurant options, surf lesson schedules, check-in/check-out times, and destination-specific considerations. - Help create smooth trip flow with realistic timing, appropriate buffers, and thoughtful sequencing of activities. - Identify missing details, open questions, possible conflicts, and logistical issues before they become problems. - Coordinate with hotels, villas, surf schools, guides, chefs, drivers, restaurants, wellness providers, and other travel partners. - Gather and organize key information from vendors, including pricing, availability, inclusions, cancellation policies, payment terms, contact details, meeting points, and guest requirements. - Assist with booking and confirming trip components such as transfers, surf lessons, activities, meals, spa appointments, restaurant reservations, and special requests. - Maintain detailed trip notes, confirmations, deadlines, and task lists. - Help prepare polished client-facing trip materials, including itineraries, proposals, booking documents, and travel guides. Vendor & Partner Communication - Communicate professionally with travel partners and vendors by email , WhatsApp, and other channels. - Follow up consistently to collect missing information, confirmations, pricing, photos, menus, policies, and other required trip details. - Track vendor responses and make sure all important information is documented clearly. - Help compare vendor options and summarize findings for the team. - Confirm all details before client travel, including dates, times, locations, inclusions, costs, contact information, and special requests. Project Management & Operations - Manage trip-related tasks inside Google Docs/Sheets, Zoho Projects, Zoho CRM and shared documents. - Keep projects organized, updated, and moving forward. - Create and maintain quality assurance and planning checklists, spreadsheets, timelines, and operational documents. - Help ensure deadlines are met and no trip detail is missed. - Support the team with administrative, research, and operational tasks as needed. - Assist with improving internal systems, templates, SOPs, and planning processes over time.
