Requirements & Skills - Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant, Travel Planner, Project Coordinator, Event Planner, Executive Assistant, or similar role. - Excellent written English communication skills. - Strong research skills and ability to verify information from multiple sources. - Strong organization and time management skills. - Experience managing projects, timelines, checklists, or complex administrative workflows. - Proficiency with Google Docs, Google Sheets, spreadsheets, and shared documents. - Familiarity with online calendars and scheduling tools. - Comfort using project management and CRM systems. Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, or similar tools is a plus. - Ability to work remotely with a reliable computer and strong internet connection. - Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury service, events, or client-facing operations is a strong plus. Nice-to-Have Experience - Travel planning or itinerary creation. - Hotel, villa, tour operator, or hospitality coordination. - Event planning or wedding planning. - Executive assistant work involving complex scheduling and logistics. - Client service for premium or high-touch customers. - Experience creating polished documents, proposals, or client-facing itineraries. - Interest in travel, wellness, adventure, or boutique hospitality. We combine real surf expertise with thoughtful travel planning, trusted local partners, and a high level of service. title: Enrollment Specialist
description: OUR MISSION Colure Health’s mission is to deliver reliable, patient?centered care that improves health outcomes through consistency, compassion, and disciplined operational excellence. We believe that if we can save one life, then the work is worth it. Every employee plays a role in building the systems, relationships, and trust that make high?quality longitudinal care possible. ABOUT COLURE HEALTH & THE ROLE Colure Health operates the Mozaiq Care+ platform, which includes post-discharge outreach and ongoing care-management programs — Transitional Care Management (TCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) — for health-system partners including NYC Health + Hospitals. The Enrollment Specialist is the first point of contact in the patient journey: working from provider and discharge patient lists, the Specialist identifies eligible patients, verifies their information and insurance, obtains consent, and completes enrollment in Mozaiq Care+ before handing the case to a Care Coordinator for post-discharge outreach. This role supports U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. Because the Philippines is roughly 12–13 hours ahead of ET, scheduled shifts fall overnight in Philippine local time; the legally required night-shift differential applies to hours worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Review provider and discharge patient lists (PCP panels, specialist rosters, and hospital discharge census) to identify patients who may qualify for Colure Health’s Mozaiq Care+ care-management programs: Transitional Care Management (TCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI). • Make first contact with each identified patient — ahead of the Care Coordinator’s outreach call — to introduce Colure Health and explain the relevant program in clear, plain-language terms. • Verify all information needed to enroll the patient: identity, demographics, insurance/payer details and coverage, caregiver contacts, and program-specific eligibility criteria (qualifying diagnosis, time-since-discharge window, and similar requirements). • Obtain and accurately document verbal or written patient consent prior to enrollment, consistent with program and payer requirements. • Set the patient up in Mozaiq Care+: create or update the patient record, confirm insurance and eligibility, and complete enrollment intake so the case is fully ready before hand-off. • Hand off each verified, enrolled patient to a Care Coordinator with complete, accurate notes so the post-discharge outreach call can move directly into the safety screen and scheduling conversation without re-asking for information already collected. • For Remote Patient Monitoring enrollments, coordinate device shipment and walk the patient or caregiver through setup, expectations, and basic troubleshooting. • Resolve enrollment barriers — consent hesitation, distrust, language, confusion about cost or insurance — using an Acknowledge – Reframe – Solve – Close approach. • Maintain accurate, audit-ready enrollment, insurance-verification, consent, and disenrollment/opt-out records in Mozaiq Care+. • Use qualified interpreter support and caregiver-permission protocols for limited-English-proficiency, elderly, and caregiver-involved patients, consistent with Colure Health standards. • Track personal list-to-enrollment conversion metrics and participate in regular call review and QA coaching. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Excellent spoken and written English (C1 / near-native); Tagalog or another Philippine language is a plus but not required, since calls are conducted in English. • High school diploma or equivalent; coursework or experience in healthcare administration, insurance, or care management is a plus. • 6+ months of experience in a contact-center, healthcare-enrollment, insurance, or patient-facing administrative role. • Comfortable explaining program benefits and consent requirements clearly, accurately, and without overstating what a program guarantees. • Strong active listening and rapport-building skills; able to work through hesitation or confusion about enrollment without applying pressure. • Solid computer literacy and the ability to accurately enter and verify demographic, insurance, and consent data in Mozaiq Care+. • High attention to detail; enrollment and consent records must be accurate and audit-ready. • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet distraction-free workspace, and equipment suitable for handling sensitive health and insurance information. • Available to work scheduled shifts within the role’s Eastern Time (ET) operating window. • Able to pass a background check and complete HIPAA / PHI-handling training prior to handling live patient enrollments. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Prior experience with Transitional Care Management, Chronic Care Management, Remote Patient Monitoring, or Behavioral Health Integration programs. • Experience with insurance verification, eligibility checking, or medical billing basics. • Familiarity with EHR, CRM, or care-management enrollment platforms, including reviewing provider panels or patient rosters. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • List-to-enrollment conversion rate among patients identified from provider and discharge lists as program-eligible. • Insurance-verification and consent and intake documentation accuracy and completeness in Mozaiq Care+. • RPM device activation and successful setup rate, where applicable. • Zero compliance incidents: no enrollment completed without valid consent, no clinical advice given, no overstated program claims. • Turnaround time from patient-list review to verified enrollment and hand-off to a Care Coordinator. WHAT COLURE HEALTH OFFERS • Full paid training on Mozaiq Care+ care-management programs (TCM, CCM, RPM, BHI), consent requirements, and the Mozaiq Care+ platform before handling live enrollments. • Remote, work-from-home role with a defined, consistent shift schedule. • Ongoing coaching and QA feedback from a dedicated Enrollment Program Manager. • Career growth path within Colure Health’s care-management organization. ROLE BOUNDARIES & COMPLIANCE Enrollment Specialists are not clinicians. Enrollment Specialists do not diagnose, provide clinical advice, or make final care-eligibility determinations on their own judgment — clinical eligibility is confirmed by Colure Health’s clinical team. Their job is to work the provider/discharge list accurately, explain programs clearly, verify insurance and consent, and complete enrollment so the Care Coordinator can move straight into safety screening and scheduling. title: Care Coordinator
description: OUR MISSION Colure Health’s mission is to deliver reliable, patient?centered care that improves health outcomes through consistency, compassion, and disciplined operational excellence. We believe that if we can save one life, then the work is worth it. Every employee plays a role in building the systems, relationships, and trust that make high?quality longitudinal care possible. ABOUT COLURE HEALTH & THE ROLE Colure Health operates the Mozaiq Care+ platform and runs post-discharge care-continuity outreach for patients discharged from NYC Health + Hospitals facilities. The goal is simple: close the gap between hospital discharge and the patient’s next real appointment. The Care Coordinator is a care-access closer, not a salesperson. Patients typically arrive already identified, verified, and enrolled by an Enrollment Specialist, so the Coordinator can move straight into the safety screen and scheduling conversation. Every completed, safe call ends with a booked PCP, specialist, or telehealth appointment, or a clearly owned same-day safety action — a pleasant conversation with no scheduled next step is not a successful call. This role supports U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. Because the Philippines is roughly 12–13 hours ahead of ET, scheduled shifts fall overnight in Philippine local time; the legally required night-shift differential applies to hours worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Place outbound, post-discharge calls to patients recently discharged from NYC Health + Hospitals facilities (Bellevue, Elmhurst, Kings County, Lincoln, Metropolitan, and Woodhull), following Colure Health’s Care Continuity Outreach Playbook call flow: Verify – Safety – Reason – Path – Barrier – Close – Document. • Verify patient identity (name and date of birth) and confirm permission before discussing care details with a caregiver or family member. • Run the safety screen on every call to surface emergency or same-day clinical issues before scheduling; immediately direct patients to 911 or 988 and stop routine scheduling when a red-flag symptom is reported. • Determine the correct follow-up pathway — PCP, specialist, telehealth fast-track, or same-day clinical escalation — and close every reachable, safe call with a booked appointment as the primary outcome. • Identify and resolve real-time barriers to care (transportation, language, childcare, work conflicts, cost concerns, distrust) using the zero-barrier approach; no referral form or insurance question is used as a reason to delay scheduling. • Offer immediate PCP assignment to patients who do not have, or have lost contact with, a primary care provider. • Apply the Acknowledge – Reframe – Solve – Close objection-handling framework to move hesitant patients toward a scheduled next step. • Receive each patient after an Enrollment Specialist has already reviewed the provider/discharge list, verified eligibility and insurance, obtained consent, and set the patient up in Mozaiq Care+ — using that completed intake to move straight into the safety screen and scheduling conversation instead of re-collecting information. • Document every call outcome in Mozaiq Care+ using the required outcome code (appointment booked, next step assigned, unable to reach, refused, same-day escalation, or emergency escalation) along with barrier, urgency, owner, deadline, permission status, and next action. • Adapt scripts for elderly, limited-English-proficiency, behavioral-health, and caregiver-involved patients, and for those enrolled in MLTC, FIDA, or PACE plans, using qualified interpreter support where needed. • Meet quality and productivity standards measured against the Manager QA Scorecard (opening and trust, privacy and permission, safety screen, pathway accuracy, barrier resolution, conversion close, documentation, and role boundaries). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Excellent spoken and written English (C1 / near-native); Tagalog or another Philippine language is a plus but not required, since calls are conducted in English. • High school diploma or equivalent; coursework or experience in healthcare, customer service, or call-center operations is a plus. • 6+ months of experience in a contact-center, customer-service, healthcare-support, or patient-facing role. • Comfortable following a structured call script while adapting naturally to real, sometimes difficult, patient conversations. • Strong active listening, empathy, and de-escalation skills; able to stay calm with anxious, confused, or distrustful patients. • Basic computer literacy and the ability to navigate a documentation platform (Mozaiq Care+) while talking with a patient. • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet distraction-free workspace, and equipment suitable for handling sensitive health information. • Available to work scheduled shifts within the role’s Eastern Time (ET) operating window, including rotating evening or Saturday shifts. • Able to pass a background check and complete HIPAA / PHI-handling training prior to taking live patient calls. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Prior experience in a healthcare, medical office, insurance, or care-management call-center environment. • Familiarity with EHR, scheduling, or care-management platforms. • Experience working U.S. healthcare accounts or supporting U.S.-based patients. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Appointment-booked rate — the primary metric: every safe, reachable call ends in a scheduled PCP, specialist, or telehealth visit, or a documented same-day safety action. • Average Manager QA Scorecard score (100-point rubric covering opening/trust, privacy, safety screen, pathway accuracy, barrier resolution, conversion close, documentation, and role boundaries). • Zero automatic-fail incidents: no medication advice given, no false reassurance, no missed red-flag symptom, no unauthorized PHI disclosure. • Documentation completeness and accuracy in Mozaiq Care+ on every call. WHAT COLURE HEALTH OFFERS • Full paid training on the Care Continuity Outreach Playbook, safety-escalation protocols, and the Mozaiq Care+ platform before taking live calls. • Remote, work-from-home role with a defined, consistent shift schedule. • Ongoing call coaching and QA feedback from a dedicated supervisor. • Career growth path within Colure Health’s care-management organization, including pathways into Enrollment Specialist and senior coordinator roles. ROLE BOUNDARIES & COMPLIANCE Care Coordinators are not clinicians. Care Coordinators do not diagnose, clear symptoms, give medication advice, or tell a patient they are “fine.” Their job is to screen for safety, remove barriers, and get the patient to the right appointment or escalation — every call ends with a documented next step. title: Competitor Pricing Analyst
description: Big Little Campers is a premium campervan rental company based in Auckland and Christchurch, New Zealand. We need someone reliable to check a small set of competitor websites every working day and log their rental prices into a spreadsheet, following a fixed checklist. No sales or customer contact involved. This is a data accuracy and consistency role, not a creative one. Precision and showing up every day matter far more than speed. ## What "good" looks like in this role - Every entry is the genuine final price for the exact scenario specified, not an approximation - A working screenshot exists for every single row, no exceptions - The same scenario is checked the same way every week, so the numbers are truly comparable over time - The weekly session happens on a similar day and at a similar time each week, so the data points stay consistent - Anything odd gets flagged rather than silently logged and left for someone else to notice weeks later ## What this role does not involve - No customer contact, no phone calls, no email s to competitors or customers - No pricing decisions. You are gathering information, not setting or recommending prices - No scraping tools, scripts, or browser automation. This is a manual, human-eyes-on-the-page check, which is the whole point: it catches things automated tools miss and isn't blocked by bot detection ## Skills and requirements - Comfortable using Google Sheets (entering data into existing columns, not building formulas) - Comfortable taking and organising screenshots, and using a shared drive folder - Good written English for the weekly Slack summary - Reliable internet connection and consistent weekly availability for a single 3 to 4 hour session - Previous experience with data entry, market research, or virtual assistant work preferred but not required ## Pay and hours This role is approximately 3 to 4 hours per week, paid hourly, in one sitting. We'll confirm the exact rate during hiring based on experience and current market rate for this kind of role, benchmarked against listings for similar data entry and market research VA roles on OnlineJobs.ph. ## Onboarding (first two weeks) - Week 1: Walkthrough call to go through the Competitors tab, Scenarios tab, and Weekly Log tab together, and complete the first week's entries live on the call - Week 2: Complete the weekly session independently, with a short check-in message once done - End of week 2: Short review call to check the data quality and answer any questions before this becomes fully independent

Current clients include: * Steadfast Storm Shelters * Blue Ribbon Septic * Lake Martin Storm Shelters * Families United * Vatos Tacos We’re looking for an experienced SEO professional who understands today’s search landscape and can help clients grow through quality SEO—not outdated tactics. This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for one exceptional SEO professional—not a team or agency. Individual applicants only. ? What You’ll Be Doing You’ll manage SEO across multiple client websites. Responsibilities include: * Keyword Research * Search Intent Analysis * Keyword Clustering * Technical SEO Audits * On-Page SEO * Internal Linking * Content Planning * Content Optimization * Competitor Research * Content Gap Analysis * Keyword Cannibalization Analysis * SEO Reporting * Schema Recommendations * Local SEO * Site Architecture Reviews * SEO QA before publishing You’ll work directly with management to improve rankings, traffic, and lead generation across multiple industries. ? Required Skills You should already be comfortable with: * Modern SEO best practices * Technical SEO * Local SEO * Content SEO * Search Intent * Internal Linking * Keyword Research * Keyword Clustering * Schema Markup * Site Architecture * Competitor Analysis * Google Search Console * Google Analytics ? Software Experience Required: * SEMrush * Google Search Console * Google Analytics * Screaming Frog * Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Teams, OneDrive) * Microsoft Excel * ChatGPT or similar AI tools Required CMS Experience: * WordPress * Webflow Nice to Have: * Shopify * Looker Studio * Zapier * Make * n8n ? Work Schedule (Required) This is a full-time remote position. You must be available during U.S. Central Time (CST/CDT) business hours. Required schedule: * Monday through Friday * Approximately 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time You will communicate with management throughout the workday using Microsoft Teams. Please do not apply if you cannot consistently work U.S. Central Time. ? This Position Is NOT For You If… * You think SEO is mostly backlinks. * You rely entirely on AI to write content. * You keyword stuff. * You don’t understand search intent. * You have never completed a technical SEO audit. * You don’t know how to identify keyword cannibalization. * You’re unwilling to continue learning as SEO evolves. ? We’re Looking For Someone Who… * Thinks strategically instead of simply following checklists. * Pays close attention to detail. * Can solve problems independently. * Writes excellent English. * Understands technical SEO. * Loves learning. * Is organized. * Communicates well. * Takes ownership of projects. * Can manage multiple client accounts. * Is dependable and responsive during business hours. ? Experience Required Minimum 3 years of professional SEO experience. Required experience: * Local SEO * Technical SEO * Content SEO * Internal Linking * Keyword Research * Keyword Clustering * Search Intent Mapping * Site Architecture * Schema Markup * Google Search Console * Screaming Frog * WordPress * Webflow Bonus: * Shopify * Local Service Businesses * Ecommerce * AI-assisted workflows ? Our Standards We don’t publish content because it’s “good enough.” Every page should have a clear purpose and provide value to users. We care about: * Search Intent * Helpful Content * Technical Excellence * Clean Site Architecture * User Experience * Long-Term Rankings * Ethical SEO Practices ? What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days you’ll help: * Improve rankings across multiple client websites. * Identify and fix technical SEO issues. * Improve internal linking. * Eliminate keyword cannibalization. * Increase qualified organic traffic. * Increase client leads. * Build scalable SEO processes. ? To Apply Your application must include: 1. Your resume. 2. Links to three websites you’ve personally improved with SEO. 3. Explain your role on each project. 4. What is the biggest SEO mistake businesses make today? 5. Explain the difference between: * Search Intent * Topical Authority * Keyword Cannibalization 6. What is the first thing you do when starting a brand-new SEO project? 7. Which SEO tools do you personally use every week? 8. How do you currently use AI in your workflow? 9. Tell us about your biggest SEO success. 10. Describe how you would identify and fix keyword cannibalization. 11. Describe your process for creating an internal linking strategy. 12. At the very top of your application include these words: Blue Rhino Applications without those words will not be considered. ? Why Join Express Media? You’ll work directly with leadership on real client campaigns and help build SEO strategies that drive measurable business growth. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving challenging SEO problems, takes pride in producing high-quality work, and wants to grow with our agency for years to come.

title: Social Media Content Strategist & Coordinator
description: We are looking for a Social Media Content Strategist and Coordinator to own and operate a dog brand's organic content engine on TikTok and Instagram. We are looking for a strategist to help build a content system, one that is consistent, content pillar-driven, data-informed, and built to compound over time. We need someone who thinks in systems as naturally as they think in content, who can translate founder stories and dog walks into content that stops a scroll, and who takes ownership of their work. You will work directly with the founders. You will write content briefs and scripts that send them out the door knowing exactly what to film. You will manage the content calendar, write captions, track performance, and report back with a clear point of view on what is working and what is not. You will be the engine behind the engine. This is a contractor role, fully remote, with genuine room to grow as the brand grows. What You Will Own - Content Planning and Strategy - Brief and Script Writing - Caption Writing - Content Calendar Management Please apply if this role sounds like the right fit for you!

description: We are an AI marketing firm based in Atlanta, Georgia. We specialize in Generative Engine Optimization, helping local businesses appear in AI-generated search results on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot. We are building a scalable service delivery operation and need a technically strong web developer to implement backend fixes that make our clients' websites readable, crawlable, and citable by AI search engines. This is not a design role. This is a technical implementation role focused on schema markup, site performance, crawlability, structured data, and CMS-level content publishing. You will receive clear task lists generated from our OtterlyAI audit platform and execute them precisely. What You Will Do Schema Markup Implementation (Primary Focus) This is the most important technical task in our service delivery. You will build and deploy JSON-LD structured data for every client website. Every new client requires a complete schema implementation in Month 1. Ongoing clients receive schema updates as their services or information changes. Specific schema types you will implement regularly: LocalBusiness schema with full NAP data (name, address, phone), service area, business hours, geo coordinates, and founding date where available. Service schema for each individual service a client offers, linked to the parent LocalBusiness entity. FAQPage schema on all key service pages. BreadcrumbList schema for site navigation. Review and AggregateRating schema where client has verifiable review data. OpeningHoursSpecification for businesses with complex or 24/7 schedules, which is critical for HVAC and towing clients. All schema is implemented as JSON-LD in the page head. Never inline RDFa. Test every implementation using Google's Rich Results Test and ---------- validator before marking complete. AI Crawlability Fixes You will receive crawlability reports from OtterlyAI identifying technical barriers preventing AI bots from reading client websites. Your job is to resolve each flagged item. Common fixes you will execute: Robots.txt audits and corrections. Many client websites block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, or other AI crawlers either intentionally or by a ---------- through legacy configurations. You will identify blocked bots and add the appropriate allow directives. JavaScript rendering fixes. Content loaded via JavaScript is invisible to most AI crawlers. You will identify pages where key service content, contact information, or structured data is rendered client-side and implement server-side rendering or static fallback content so AI bots see the full page. Page speed improvements affecting crawl budget. Compress images, implement lazy loading, clean up unused scripts, and verify Core Web Vitals are not causing crawlers to time out or deprioritize the site. XML sitemap verification and submission. Confirm sitemaps are current, include all key service pages, and are submitted to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools. Canonical tag review to ensure AI crawlers are not indexing duplicate or thin content pages. WordPress and CMS Implementation The majority of our clients are on WordPress. Some may be on Wix, Squarespace, or custom HTML sites. You will: Publish GEO-optimized content written by our Claude AI workflow. Content arrives formatted and ready. Your job is to publish it correctly with proper heading structure (H1, H2, H3 hierarchy), internal links to relevant service pages, meta title and meta description populated, correct category and tag assignments, and featured image added if provided. Install and configure Yoast SEO or Rank Math on WordPress sites that do not already have an SEO plugin. Configure site-wide settings: organization schema at site level, social profiles linked, XML sitemap enabled. Create new service pages when our content team produces content for services a client has not previously featured on their website. These pages need to match the existing site design, load correctly on mobile, and pass the OtterlyAI crawlability check before being marked complete. Monthly Technical Maintenance Each month you will receive a short technical task list per active client based on the latest OtterlyAI audit recommendations. Typical monthly tasks include updating schema when client hours, services, or pricing changes, fixing any crawlability issues flagged in the weekly audit, publishing new content articles produced by the VA and Claude workflow, and verifying that previously implemented schema is still valid and rendering correctly. You will log all completed tasks in our shared Google Sheet client tracker with the date completed and any notes for the team. Occasional Development Projects As we grows you may be asked to build simple landing pages for specific service areas, implement tracking pixels for Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, connect client websites to Google Business Profile APIs for automated data syncing, and support the eventual integration of OtterlyAI API data into client reporting dashboards. Tools and Technologies You must be proficient in these before applying: WordPress (theme editing, plugin configuration, page publishing, settings management) JSON-LD schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList at minimum) HTML and CSS (sufficient to edit page templates and fix rendering issues) Google Search Console (sitemap submission, crawl error identification, index coverage review) Bing Webmaster Tools (sitemap submission, crawl verification) Google Rich Results Test and ---------- Validator robots.txt configuration Basic JavaScript debugging (sufficient to identify JS-rendered content problems) Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager (basic implementation) Familiarity with these is a strong advantage: Yoast SEO or Rank Math plugin configuration Core Web Vitals optimization Cloudflare or similar CDN configuration Wix, Squarespace, or Webflow (for non-WordPress clients) Google Business Profile API n8n or ---------- (for future automation work) Who You Are You are technically precise. Schema errors, unclosed tags, and broken robots.txt configurations are things you catch before they cause problems, not after. You are fast but not careless. Our clients pay monthly retainers and their monthly deliverables need to go out on schedule. You understand deadlines and communicate proactively when something will take longer than expected. You can work from a task list without needing to redesign everything. We are not asking you to rebuild client websites. We are asking you to implement specific technical improvements to existing sites. You follow the brief exactly and ask for clarification before making assumptions. You understand why the technical work you are doing matters to AI search. You do not need to be a GEO expert, but you should understand at the level of "schema markup helps AI tools understand what this business is and where it is" so you can make intelligent decisions when the task list has ambiguity. You communicate in English clearly and professionally. You will interact with the team lead and occasionally with the VA team. Written communication needs to be clean and unambiguous. Requirements Minimum 2 years of professional web development experience Demonstrated experience with schema markup implementation, with examples you can show Strong WordPress proficiency across multiple client sites simultaneously Reliable high-speed internet with backup option Available for a minimum of 10 to 15 hours per week with potential to grow Ability to turn around standard technical tasks (schema implementation, robots.txt fix, content publishing) within 24 to 48 hours of receiving the task What We Offer Good base pay. A team of strong, integrous individuals. Part-time to start (10 to 15 hours per week) with clear growth path as client volume increases Fully remote and asynchronous work Clear task lists generated from our audit platform, no ambiguity about what needs to be done Long-term stable engagement built on monthly client retainers, not project-based gigs Paid training on OtterlyAI audit outputs and GEO-specific technical requirements Direct access to the firm owner for priority questions How to Apply Cover letter - Include the following: Two examples of schema markup you have implemented on live websites. Paste the JSON-LD code directly in your email or provide URLs where we can verify it with Google's Rich Results Test. If you have never implemented a schema, do not apply. A brief description of a robots.txt problem you identified and fixed on a client site. What was blocked, how did you find it, and what did you change? Your WordPress experience summary: how many sites have you managed simultaneously, which plugins you know well, and whether you have worked in multisite environments. Your available hours, time zone, and typical turnaround time for a standard schema implementation task. Applications without all four items will not be reviewed. Applications that say "see my portfolio" instead of answering the questions directly will not be reviewed.

title: Email Marketing Specialist — Savaya Botanicals (DTC Supplement Brand)
job_title: Email Marketing Specialist — Savaya Botanicals (DTC Supplement Brand)
description: We're a DTC supplement brand selling through Shopify with Meta Ads as our primary acquisition channel. We're scaling and we need someone who can turn our email marketing into a serious revenue channel — not just a newsletter, but a full retention machine that drives lifetime value, repeat purchases, and subscriptions. We use Klaviyo. We need someone who lives in Klaviyo. The Role You own email . The flows, the campaigns, the segments, the copy, the design, the testing, the data. This isn't a role where we tell you what to send — we need someone who builds the strategy, executes it, and reports on what's working. You'll work closely with our Creative Strategist on visual direction, but the email domain is yours. Our goal is simple: email should drive 30%+ of total revenue. If you've done that before, we want to talk. What You'll Do ? Build, optimise, and manage all Klaviyo email flows from scratch — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned browse, post-purchase, win-back, sunset, VIP, replenishment, subscription nudge, review request ? Write high-converting email copy — direct response style, not corporate newsletter. You understand pain points, urgency, social proof, and how to make someone click "buy" from an email ? Design or direct the design of all email templates — clean, on-brand, mobile-first. If you can design in Klaviyo or Canva yourself, even better. If not, you brief our designer with precision ? Plan and execute weekly/bi-weekly campaign sends — promotions, content, education, launches, seasonal ? Build and maintain smart segmentation — by purchase behavior, engagement level, product interest, lifecycle stage, subscription status. No batch-and-blast ? A/B test everything — subject lines, send times, copy, design, offers, flow timing. You test with structure, not gut feeling ? Monitor deliverability — inbox placement, spam rates, list hygiene, domain reputation. You keep us out of the promotions tab ? Analyze and report on email performance — revenue attribution, flow performance, campaign ROI, list growth, churn. Weekly report to the founders ? Focus on LTV and subscriptions — our biggest lever is turning first-time buyers into subscribers. Your flows and campaigns should be engineered to drive recurring revenue ? Build a replenishment strategy — supplements run out. You know when. You email at the right time with the right message ? Coordinate with our Creative Strategist to ensure email creative is congruent with ads and landing pages What You Won't Do ? Run ads — separate team ? Build landing pages — separate workflow ? Customer support — separate team ? Guess — everything you do is backed by data or a structured test What We're Looking For ? Deep Klaviyo expertise — you've built flows from scratch, not just tweaked templates. You know the platform inside out: flow filters, conditional splits, dynamic content, custom properties, API events ? DTC e-commerce email experience — ideally supplements, beauty, wellness, or health. You understand the buying psychology in this space ? Direct response copywriting skills — your email s read like a good sales page, not a corporate memo. You write hooks, you build urgency, you close ? Data-driven — you can pull a Klaviyo report and tell us exactly where the revenue is leaking and what to fix ? Experience with subscription models — you've worked with brands that sell subscriptions or replenishment products and you know how to use email to drive and retain subscribers ? Experience building segments that actually drive results — not just "engaged vs. unengaged" but sophisticated behavioral segments that change how you communicate ? Deliverability knowledge — you understand SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up schedules, list cleaning, and why engagement-based sending matters How You Work (This Matters as Much as Your Skills) ? You build systems, not just email s. Your flow architecture, your testing calendar, your segmentation logic, your reporting cadence — all of it is documented and repeatable ? You create SOPs for everything you build. If you set up a flow, there's a document that explains the logic, the triggers, the timing, and the reason behind every decision ? You organise your work so that someone could take over your email program and understand exactly what's running, why, and what's next ? You take full ownership — you don't wait for us to tell you what to send. You look at the data, see the opportunity, propose the test, and execute ? You report proactively — every week we know what's performing, what's underperforming, and what you're doing about it ? You think about email as part of the full customer journey, not an isolated channel. How does the email experience connect to the ad they clicked, the landing page they saw, and the product they received? What Success Looks Like ? Email revenue grows from current levels to 30%+ of total revenue within 90 days ? All core flows are live, tested, and optimised within 30 days ? Subscription conversion rate from email increases measurably within 60 days ? Weekly reporting cadence established and maintained ? Full SOP documentation for every flow and process within 60 days ? List health metrics stay strong: deliverability above 95%, unsubscribe rate below 0.3% Screening Questions — Answer These in Your Proposal Share a Klaviyo flow you built from scratch. Walk us through the logic: what triggers it, how many email s, what are the conditional splits, and what results did it drive? A DTC supplement brand has a 12% repeat purchase rate and no subscription program yet. How would you use email to increase that? Be specific about which flows and campaigns you'd build. What's your process for writing a high-converting email ? Walk us through from blank page to final send — including how you decide on the angle, subject line, and CTA. You notice that your welcome flow has a 45% open rate on email 1 but drops to 12% by email 4. What do you do? Have you built SOPs or documentation for an email program before? Describe what you documented and why. What's your weekly reporting structure? What metrics do you report on and what do you do with the insights? Details ? Remote, ongoing contract ? Klaviyo is non-negotiable — if you don't know Klaviyo deeply, this isn't the right fit ? Reports to: Founders + coordinates with Creative Strategist ? Brand: Savaya Botanicals (supplements, DTC, Shopify) Apply with: ? 2–3 examples of Klaviyo flows or campaigns you've built (screenshots or case studies) ? A short message about your experience with DTC email marketing and subscription-based brands ? Your answers to the screening questions above ? Your monthly or hourly rate We're looking for someone who treats email like a revenue engine, not a checkbox. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: CRM & Hubspot Specialist
description: About Us Strategic Axis is a leading training and professional development provider, delivering corporate training, certifications, and learning solutions that help professionals and organizations grow, adapt, and succeed. What are we looking for? We are looking for a data-driven CRM & HubSpot Specialist to take full ownership of our HubSpot ecosystem. In this role, you will be the bridge between marketing, sales, and client success, ensuring our portal is optimized, our data is clean, and our automation is driving measurable growth. The ideal candidate isn't just a "user"—you are an architect who understands how to build scalable workflows and turn raw data into actionable insights. Key Responsibilities -Platform Architecture: Design and maintain the technical structure of HubSpot (CRM, Sales, Marketing, and Service Hubs) to support business goals. -Automation & Workflows: Build and manage sophisticated automation for lead scoring, nurturing, internal notifications, and client onboarding. -Data Integrity: Implement strict data governance protocols to ensure hygiene, manage deduplication, and maintain accurate property mapping. -Reporting & Analytics: Develop custom dashboards and advanced reports to track KPIs (e.g., MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline velocity, and ROI). -Integration Management: Oversee integrations between HubSpot and third-party tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gmail/Outlook, and Slack). -Lead Lifecycle Strategy: Define and manage lead stages (Subscriber, Lead, MQL, SQL, Opportunity) to ensure a clear path from first touch to closed-won. -Lead Scoring Model: Develop and refine predictive lead scoring based on behavioral data (email opens, website visits) and firmographic fit to prioritize high-value prospects. -Campaign Execution: Build and deploy marketing assets within HubSpot, including landing pages, tracking URLs (UTMs), and automated email drip campaigns. -Lead Routing: Design and monitor automated "round-robin" or territory-based lead assignment rules to ensure sales follow up with MQLs within established SLAs. -Database Segmentation: Create dynamic active lists for targeted marketing based on industry, persona, and engagement level to increase conversion rates. -Attribution Reporting: Manage multi-touch attribution reports to identify which marketing channels and campaigns are generating the highest quality leads. -Team Enablement: Act as the internal "HubSpot Guru," providing training and documentation to ensure high adoption across all departments. -Newsletter Strategy & Execution: End-to-end management of our recurring newsletters. This includes content curation, layout design, and scheduling. -Email Marketing Optimization: Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, CTAs, and send times to maximize open rates and engagement. -Content Distribution: Repurpose high-performing newsletter content for LinkedIn posts and lead magnets to drive top-of-funnel growth. -Nurture Sequences: Design automated "Welcome" and "Re-engagement" email sequences that keep our brand top of mind for cold or dormant leads. -Subscriber Growth: Implement on-site pop-ups, slide-ins, and gated content strategies to consistently grow the newsletter subscriber base. -Brand Consistency: Ensure all outbound marketing communications align with our brand voice, especially when targeting HR professionals and C-suite stakeholders. ### Core Responsibilities: The Marketing Engine -Full-Funnel Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute multi-channel marketing plans (Email , LinkedIn, Content) designed to attract, engage, and delight B2B clients. -Content & Newsletter Management: Lead the editorial calendar for our recurring newsletters. You will handle everything from subject line copywriting to layout design and performance analysis. -Lead Generation & Management: Build and optimize lead capture forms, landing pages, and automated "lead magnets" to convert website traffic into actionable leads. -LinkedIn & Social Integration: Manage corporate LinkedIn presence and lead generation efforts, ensuring brand consistency across all digital touchpoints. -Brand Voice & Copywriting: Act as the "editor-in-chief" for all outbound communications, ensuring a professional, insightful, and supportive tone—specifically when targeting HR Directors and C-Suite executives. -Event & Program Support: Assist in the digital promotion of corporate events (e.g., wellness workshops, webinars, or CSR initiatives) through automated invite sequences and follow-up workflows. ### Technical Requirements HubSpot Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Marketing Hub (Workflows, Sequences, and Lead Flows). Funnel Optimization: Proven track record of reducing funnel friction and improving MQL-to-SQL conversion rates. Inbound Knowledge: Strong understanding of inbound marketing methodologies and content-led lead generation. ### Qualifications & Skills -Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing HubSpot in a B2B environment. -Certifications: Active HubSpot Certifications (Marketing, Sales, and Reporting) are highly preferred. -Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of custom objects, API integrations, and advanced workflow logic. -Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and the ability to interpret complex data sets. -Communication: Ability to translate technical CRM requirements into plain language for non-technical stakeholders. -Detail-Oriented: A "zero-mistake" approach to data management and email automation. ### Performance Indicators (KPIs) -Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs): Volume and quality of leads generated. -Conversion Rate: Percentage of leads moving through each funnel stage. -Sales Feedback Loop: Consistency and speed of lead follow-up by the sales team. -Database Health: Percentage of "marketable" contacts and bounce rate management. ### Why Join Us? This is a pivotal role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital infrastructure. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your work directly impacts revenue and the efficiency of the entire team

CRO optimizes funnels. But nobody connects the data between them. The result? Creative doesn't know what's actually converting. Media buyers don't understand why certain ads work. CRO can't tell creative what messaging drives purchases. Everyone's optimizing their piece without seeing the whole picture. We need someone who owns all three functions—not as a manager who delegates, but as a hands-on leader who understands the mechanics deeply enough to connect them. But more importantly, you'll build the feedback loops that make these functions work as one integrated system. This isn't a CMO role where you sit in meetings and review dashboards. This is a full end-to-end performance marketing role where you're in the trenches—guiding creative direction based on ad data, adjusting media buying strategy based on funnel performance, and optimizing CRO based on traffic quality. --- What You'll Do Creative Strategy Leadership - Diagnose performance issues and identify whether the problem is creative, targeting, or funnel - Connect media buying metrics to downstream conversion data - Guide platform strategy across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels CRO Ownership - Own funnel performance—landing pages, advertorials, checkout flow - Run and analyze tests on copy, layout, offers, and user experience - Connect CRO insights back to creative and media buying (what messaging converts, what traffic quality issues exist) - Build dashboards and reporting that show the full customer journey, not just isolated metrics The Feedback Loop - Build the system that connects creative, media buying, and CRO into one continuous improvement engine - Create processes for insights to flow between teams automatically - Identify where breakdowns happen in the customer journey and fix them - Own the holistic view of performance that most companies lack --- What We're Looking For - 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership role - Extensive media buying experience—you've managed significant ad spend ($500K+/month) and know what good media buying looks like - Extensive CRO experience—you understand funnels, conversion optimization, and how to diagnose where we're losing customers - Proven ability to connect data across channels and build unified marketing strategies - Experience leading marketing teams (media buyers, CRO specialists, etc.) - Strong analytical skills—you live in the data and make decisions based on it - Strategic thinker who can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to fix details - Clear communicator who can translate complex data into actionable insights for leadership - Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or high-growth consumer brands - Background in both paid social (Meta, TikTok) and other channels (Google, Pinterest, native) - You've scaled a brand from 7-figures to 8-figures or beyond - Experience with advertorial funnels and direct response marketing Bonus Points: - Dropshipping experience (fast-paced testing, thin margins, rapid scaling) - Experience at a performance creative agency—you've seen what works across multiple brands and brought that pattern recognition in-house - Experience with AI creative tools and emerging ad formats --- This Role Is NOT For... We're being direct because we respect your time: - Specialists who only know one piece (creative OR media buying OR CRO)—you need to understand all three - People who want to manage from a distance and delegate everything - Those who can't connect data across platforms and see the full picture - Marketers who optimize for vanity metrics instead of profit - Anyone who needs a large team to execute—you should be able to get hands dirty - People who view creative, media buying, and CRO as separate disciplines instead of one system - Those who struggle to translate data into actionable creative and funnel direction --- Compensation & Benefits - Monthly Salary: $5,000 - $8,000/month + Profit Share - Profit share tied to marketing performance (details discussed during interview) - Remote-first environment - Work directly with founders on growth strategy - Lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on - Build the marketing engine for a portfolio of scaling brands --- Our Hiring Process We don't waste time—yours or ours. If you've ever been frustrated that creative, media buying, and CRO don't talk to each other—and you know exactly how to fix it—this role was made for you. P.P.S. title: Medical Sales Representative - Cold Calling
description: About Us We’re building a global talent pool of high-performing remote Medical Sales Representatives (Cold Callers) to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative, and allied health support. Our mission is simple: help more people access care through ethical, respectful outreach and a warm, professional patient-first approach. If you’re confident on the phone, resilient, and enjoy hitting targets without being pushy, we’d love to meet you. Role Overview As a Sales Representative (Cold Calling), you’ll be the first voice many people hear. You’ll contact warm and/or cold leads, introduce clinic services, handle basic objections, and book qualified appointments or drive next steps (e.g., intake form completion, discovery call scheduling). This is a pooling / talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to clinic openings based on: • Your sales experience (healthcare preferred but not required) • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US) • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialers/SMS/email) • Compensation alignment and performance expectations Important: This is healthcare-related outreach. We prioritize professionalism, consent-based communication, and privacy-safe handling of lead data. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) • Make outbound calls to leads (cold, warm, or reactivation lists, depending on clinic assignment). • Qualify prospects using a script and criteria (needs, location, readiness, eligibility, where applicable). • Clearly explain services and next steps in simple, human language (no hype, no pressure). • Book appointments or schedule a consult, and ensure the lead receives confirmations and instructions. • Follow up via SMS/email/CRM to reduce no-shows and improve conversion. • Handle objections professionally (price, hesitation, timing, trust) and escalate clinical questions appropriately. • Keep CRM records accurate: call outcomes, notes, tags, follow-up tasks, and dispositions. • Hit activity and outcome targets (calls/day, connects, qualified appointments, show rate). • Coordinate with patient support/ops teams for smooth handoffs and accurate scheduling. • Maintain compliance: respect do-not-contact rules (if provided), consent preferences, and confidentiality. • Participate in coaching, script optimization, and performance reviews. Must-Have Qualifications • 2+ years experience in cold calling / outbound sales/appointment setting (B2C or B2B). • Strong spoken and written English with confident phone presence. • Comfortable following scripts while sounding natural and empathetic. • Resilient mindset: can handle rejection and stay consistent day-to-day. • Organized and metrics-driven (can work toward targets and track progress). • Strong attention to detail for CRM updates and follow-up scheduling accuracy. • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and clear async communication. • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and backup plan. • Willingness to work shifts overlapping AU/UK/US/NZ depending on assignment. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points) • Experience selling or booking for healthcare, telehealth, wellness, or subscription services. • Experience with consultative selling (needs-based approach vs hard selling). • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zoho) and dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, Dialpad). • SMS/email follow-up experience (Twilio, Podium, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.). • Strong objection handling and ability to improve scripts through feedback. • Experience with compliance-minded outreach (opt-outs, consent language, data privacy). Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples) • CRM: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, GoHighLevel • Dialer/VoIP: RingCentral, Dialpad, Aircall, CloudTalk • SMS/Email: Podium, Twilio, Gmail/Outlook • Productivity: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion/Trello/Asana • Reporting: Google Sheets Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based) • Location: Philippines (remote) • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift) • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening) • US-friendly (PH night shift) • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clean handoffs. Compensation (General Guidance) • Starts at USD 10/hour • Many clinic assignments include performance incentives, such as: • bonus per qualified appointment booked • bonus per attended appointment (show rate) • monthly performance bonus for hitting targets Details vary by clinic and will be confirmed during matching. How to Apply (Required) Please submit: 1. CV / Resume 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering: • Your cold calling/sales background (industry + results) • Your best achievement (e.g., appointments booked/week, conversion rate, revenue) • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialer/SMS/email) • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US) • A short example of how you handle a tough objection politely Important: Applications missing the required CV + video may not be considered. Our Screening Process (What to Expect) • Initial screen (English + sales experience + remote readiness) • Practical task: short role-play + CRM note sample + follow-up message draft • Structured interview: scenarios on objection handling, ethics, and performance consistency Join the Pool If you’re persuasive without being pushy, love the rhythm of outbound calls, and want to help more people access care, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Accountant
description: ABOUT THE COMPANY CORE Values Initiative We strive to be 100% present wherever we are and in whatever we are doing in all areas of our lives. There are three kinds of people in this world: those who make things happen, those who watch things happen, and those who wonder what just happened. We make things happen! Client-Centric Our clients put significant faith and confidence in our ability to serve, bless, and help them. They are ultimately the “CEO” of our company. They challenge us to be and do our very best as we strive to solve their problems efficiently and effectively. Our aim is for every client to be thrilled with the solutions we deliver. We have servant hearts – we give freely of ourselves to our customers and each other. We trust we will receive the appropriate reward for our efforts. Collaboration We seek to understand before being understood. It may be difficult to step into another person’s shoes, but as we do, conflicts resolve and relationships improve. We are more concerned with what is right, not who is right. As we combine our diversity of skill sets and perspectives with open and clear communication, we will accomplish much more together. Abundance We do not worry if the glass is half empty or half full because we know it is refillable! There are enough resources, opportunities, and successes to go around for everyone. Some of the fruits of an abundance mindset include gratitude, generosity, and optimism. We view setbacks as temporary and as opportunities to learn, improve, and grow. This leads to resilience, or the ability to weather whatever challenges come our way. ABOUT THE JOB The Accountant directly reports to the Controller and will own the accuracy and timeliness of our clients core accounting processes, ensuring compliance with GAAP and internal controls. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with the accounting cycle—from revenue recognition and cash receipts to accrual adjustments and month-end close—along with strong financial planning and analysis capabilities to forecast, analyze variances, and provide actionable insights. Key Responsibilities: Accounting Cycle & Close Assist the Controller in the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to deliver accurate financial statements on time to the clients. Works with the Controller on the full accounting cycle for some of the clients: revenue recognition, receivables, payables, payroll, and monthly accrual maintenance. Execute cash-to-accrual conversions, including identifying timing differences, adjusting entries, and reconciliations to reflect true period performance. Prepare and review journal entries with supporting documentation from the data given by the Data Team; ensure proper coding and documentation for audit trails. Perform reconciliations of cash accounts and banking activities, ensure accuracy of intercompany accounts, and investigate variances. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Collaborate with the Controller and Finance Team on the FP&A processes (such as 13-week cash forecast, budgeting, 12-month rolling forecast, 5-yr financial models, Adjusted EBITDA, maintaining debt) to translate financial data into clear insights to the clients. Analyze P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow trends; prepare variance analyses against budgets and forecasts. Build and maintain financial models to support business decisions, capital allocation, and scenario planning. Stakeholder and Client Collaboration Active collaboration within the Finance Team. Partner with the Data Team in completion of financial reports and other financial projects. Communicate financial information and reports clearly to the clients if needed. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA/CFA/MBA preferred. 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with demonstrable expertise in the full accounting cycle. Experience with US clients. Strong knowledge on cash-to-accrual conversions and timely accurate journal entries. Proficiency in GAAP and financial statement preparation; experience with consolidation. Solid FP&A background: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling. Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar). Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Effective verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial colleagues or clients. Demonstrated integrity, reliability, and adherence to internal controls. Work Environment: This role is a remote full-time position. The successful candidate will be considered as Independent Contractor. This is a 40-hour work week, from Monday to Friday. Flexible time depending on the agreement with the Controller (2-3hours in the morning Philippine time with overlapping MST schedule). Application Process Interested candidates should submit a resume and a cover letter outlining the qualifications and interest in the position to ---------- letter must contain: Your experience with cash-to-accrual conversions and JEs. Examples of FP&A work (budgets, forecasts, variance analyses) you have led or significantly contributed to. A brief description of process improvements you implemented in your previous roles.

title: Performance Marketer

Not employees waiting to be told what to do—owners who see a problem and fix it. - ITERATIONS > HOURS — We don't measure success by time at your desk. We measure it by how fast you can test, learn, and improve. Ship it. Learn. Repeat. - TRUTH OVER EGO — We prioritize honesty and clarity, even when it's uncomfortable. No politics. No BS. Just data and results. --- The Role Here's the problem we're solving: Most e-commerce companies have creative, media buying, and CRO operating in silos. Creative makes ads. Media buyers launch them. CRO optimizes funnels. But nobody connects the data between them. The result? Creative doesn't know what's actually converting. Media buyers don't understand why certain ads work. CRO can't tell creative what messaging drives purchases. Everyone's optimizing their piece without seeing the whole picture. We need someone who owns all three functions—not as a manager who delegates, but as a hands-on leader who understands the mechanics deeply enough to connect them. You'll lead our creative strategists, work at a strategic level with media buyers, and own CRO performance. But more importantly, you'll build the feedback loops that make these functions work as one integrated system. This isn't a CMO role where you sit in meetings and review dashboards. This is a full end-to-end performance marketing role where you're in the trenches—guiding creative direction based on ad data, adjusting media buying strategy based on funnel performance, and optimizing CRO based on traffic quality. --- What You'll Do Creative Strategy Leadership - Lead and guide creative strategists on concepts, angles, and hooks - Translate media buying data into creative briefs—what's working, what's not, and why - Build the creative testing roadmap based on performance signals - Ensure creative output aligns with what actually converts (not just what looks good) Media Buying Strategy - Work at a strategic level with media buyers on campaign structure, scaling decisions, and budget allocation - Diagnose performance issues and identify whether the problem is creative, targeting, or funnel - Connect media buying metrics to downstream conversion data - Guide platform strategy across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels CRO Ownership - Own funnel performance—landing pages, advertorials, checkout flow - Run and analyze tests on copy, layout, offers, and user experience - Connect CRO insights back to creative and media buying (what messaging converts, what traffic quality issues exist) - Build dashboards and reporting that show the full customer journey, not just isolated metrics The Feedback Loop - Build the system that connects creative, media buying, and CRO into one continuous improvement engine - Create processes for insights to flow between teams automatically - Identify where breakdowns happen in the customer journey and fix them - Own the holistic view of performance that most companies lack --- What We're Looking For - 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership role - Extensive media buying experience—you've managed significant ad spend ($500K+/month) and know what good media buying looks like - Extensive CRO experience—you understand funnels, conversion optimization, and how to diagnose where we're losing customers - Proven ability to connect data across channels and build unified marketing strategies - Experience leading marketing teams (media buyers, CRO specialists, etc.) - Strong analytical skills—you live in the data and make decisions based on it - Strategic thinker who can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to fix details - Clear communicator who can translate complex data into actionable insights for leadership - Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or high-growth consumer brands - Background in both paid social (Meta, TikTok) and other channels (Google, Pinterest, native) - You've scaled a brand from 7-figures to 8-figures or beyond - Experience with advertorial funnels and direct response marketing Bonus Points: - Dropshipping experience (fast-paced testing, thin margins, rapid scaling) - Experience at a performance creative agency—you've seen what works across multiple brands and brought that pattern recognition in-house - Experience with AI creative tools and emerging ad formats --- This Role Is NOT For... We're being direct because we respect your time: - Specialists who only know one piece (creative OR media buying OR CRO)—you need to understand all three - People who want to manage from a distance and delegate everything - Those who can't connect data across platforms and see the full picture - Marketers who optimize for vanity metrics instead of profit - Anyone who needs a large team to execute—you should be able to get hands dirty - People who view creative, media buying, and CRO as separate disciplines instead of one system - Those who struggle to translate data into actionable creative and funnel direction --- Compensation & Benefits - Monthly Salary: $5,000 - $8,000/month + Profit Share - Profit share tied to marketing performance (details discussed during interview) - Remote-first environment - Work directly with founders on growth strategy - Lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on - Build the marketing engine for a portfolio of scaling brands --- Our Hiring Process We don't waste time—yours or ours. Here's how it works: - Step 1: Application (You're here!) - Step 2: Initial Interview with CHRO - Step 3: Internal Assessment by Rescale - Step 4: Interview with CEO - Step 5: Signing of Independent Contractor and NDA - Step 6: Onboarding Total timeline: 1-2 weeks from application to offer. --- Ready to Apply? ---------- Complete the application form above. Be thorough—this is your first impression. Please attach your resume and portfolio. P.S. If you've ever been frustrated that creative, media buying, and CRO don't talk to each other—and you know exactly how to fix it—this role was made for you. P.P.S. We're not looking for someone who needs to build a large team to execute. We need someone who can lead lean, move fast, and connect the dots that most marketers miss.

Primary responsibilities: • LoRA trainer optimization — improving and tuning the LoRA training setup itself: training configs, hyperparameters (rank, learning rate, scheduler), trainer settings, and pipeline efficiency, to maximize output quality while reducing training time and cost. This is about optimizing how LoRAs are trained, not manually collecting datasets or babysitting training runs. Deep hands-on knowledge of AI-Toolkit and Musubi Tuner is required. • Base-model fine-tuning — full fine-tuning of open-source base models, with the same optimization mindset toward configs, training efficiency, and output quality. • Workflow optimization — designing, building, and continuously improving ComfyUI workflows; optimizing node graphs, render efficiency, VRAM usage, batching, and model offloading for repeatable, production-grade output. • Training pipeline optimization — improving training speed, cost, stability, and quality; managing and optimizing multi-GPU training runs. • Evaluation & iteration — building systematic evaluation methods to compare configs, checkpoints, and training approaches, and iterating toward measurable quality gains. title: 2D Illustrator & Animator: Rig Mascot (.ai) for Adobe Character Animator & AI Motion Control
job_title: 2D Illustrator & Animator: Rig Mascot (.ai) for Adobe Character Animator & AI Motion Control
description: That is a great addition! However, it is important to note that **Adobe Character Animator and Kling Motion Control use completely different animation technologies.** * **Adobe Character Animator** is traditional 2D puppeteering. It requires a complex, layered file with all the limbs, facial features, and mouth shapes completely separated. * **Kling Motion Control (on Higgsfield)** is generative AI video. It does *not* use a rigged file or layers. Instead, it requires a single, pristine, high-resolution flat image of the character—ideally in a neutral, unobstructed stance (like a standing A-pose) where the AI can clearly see the entire body, proportions, and face without overlapping limbs. Since the contractor will already be re-drawing and cleaning up the Illustrator file, they can easily provide both. They just need to export a specific version of the character optimized for your AI workflow. Here is the updated job posting with the Higgsfield/Kling requirements integrated: ### **Job Title:** 2D Illustrator & Animator: Rig Mascot (.ai) for Adobe Character Animator & AI Motion Control ### **Job Overview:** We are looking for a skilled 2D illustrator and animator to take our existing company mascot (currently a flat vector logo in an Adobe Illustrator .ai file) and prepare it for two distinct video workflows. First, we need it converted into a fully functional, rigged digital puppet for **Adobe Character Animator**. Second, we need a clean, optimized export of the character prepared for AI motion transfer using **Kling Motion Control via the Higgsfield AI platform**. If you have experience preparing vector assets for both traditional 2D rigging (custom triggers/visemes) and AI video generation, we want to hear from you! ### **Scope of Work & Responsibilities:** 1. **Asset Preparation (Adobe Illustrator):** Open our existing vector mascot file, clean up the paths, and separate the character into the strict, correctly named layer hierarchy required by Adobe Character Animator (e.g., separating eyes, pupils, eyebrows, blinking states, mouth shapes/visemes, torso, and limbs). 2. **AI Motion Control Prep (Kling/Higgsfield):** Using the cleaned vector, create a high-resolution, full-body flat export of the character in a neutral standing pose (or A-pose). Ensure there are no overlapping limbs or objects obstructing the face/body, as this will be used as the base reference image for AI motion tracking and element binding. 3. **Puppet Rigging (Adobe Character Animator):** Import the prepared .ai file into Character Animator and build a complete, high-quality puppet rig. 4. **Triggers & Controls:** Set up auto lip-syncing, eye-gaze tracking, and breathing behaviors. Create keyboard triggers for basic gestures (such as a hand wave, a point, or changing facial expressions). 5. **Testing & Optimization:** Ensure the puppet deforms smoothly without visual glitches during webcam tracking. ### **Project Deliverables:** * The newly organized, layered Adobe Illustrator (.ai) file. * The final, fully rigged Adobe Character Animator (.puppet) file ready for use. * A high-resolution, full-body flat .png (unobstructed, neutral pose) optimized specifically for Kling AI / Higgsfield. * A 10-second test recording (.mp4) showing the Character Animator puppet's functionality. ### **How to Apply:** Please submit your application with the following: 1. A brief introduction about your experience with Adobe Character Animator and preparing character assets for animation. 2. **Links to your portfolio or specific examples of puppets you have rigged in Adobe Character Animator.** (Applications without relevant video or puppet samples will not be considered). 3. Your estimated turnaround time for a project like this. *To ensure you have read this entire job post, please start your cover letter with the word **"ANIMATOR"** in all capital letters. Generic, copy-pasted applications will be ignored.*

Lead Funnel & CRM Management • Ensure every lead from every source flows automatically into HubSpot CRM via Zapier or native integrations. • Build and maintain 7-touch automated follow-up sequences in HubSpot (email + SMS) so no lead goes uncontacted. • Establish speed-to-lead protocols so every inbound lead is contacted within 5 minutes of submission. • Segment leads by source, credit profile, and intent level to prioritize the sales team’s outreach. • Source and manage aged lead lists ( ---------- or equivalent) as a cost-effective supplementary channel. 4. Organic Lead Generation & Content • Manage and fully optimize the CP Restoration Services Google Business Profile, including generating a consistent flow of 5-star reviews from satisfied clients. • Oversee an SEO content strategy targeting high-intent searches by clients seeking credit repair help. • Manage social media content calendar (Facebook , Instagram, TikTok) with 3–5 posts per week, including educational content, client success stories, and promotional offers. • Use tools like Buffer or Later to schedule and automate content publishing. 5. Analytics & Reporting • Track and report weekly on key metrics: leads generated by channel, cost per lead, lead-to-appointment rate, appointment-to-close rate, and cost per acquired client. • Benchmark against industry standards (15–20% lead-to-client conversion rate, $150–$300 cost per client acquisition). • Use A/B testing on ad creative, landing pages, and email subject lines to continuously improve conversion rates. • Present a monthly lead generation report to the CEO with insights, wins, and next-month strategy. 6. Sales Team Enablement • Collaborate with the Sales Manager to ensure lead handoff is seamless and leads arrive with full context (source, credit score range, goal). • Develop call scripts, email templates, and follow-up sequences for the sales team to use with incoming leads. • Work with the Sales Manager to identify which lead sources produce the highest close rates and double down on those channels. QUALIFICATIONS Required • 3+ years of experience in lead generation, growth marketing, or demand generation — ideally in financial services, credit repair, mortgage, real estate, or a related industry. • Proven track record of building and scaling multi-channel lead generation programs that directly drove revenue growth. • Hands-on experience running and optimizing Facebook /Instagram Lead Ads and Google Search Ads campaigns. • Proficiency with HubSpot CRM, including building automated sequences, managing pipelines, and reporting. • Strong understanding of referral partner programs and experience building B2B referral networks. • Experience with Zapier or ---------- for marketing automation and CRM integrations. • Data-driven mindset — you track everything and make decisions based on numbers, not gut feel. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred • Prior experience in the credit repair, mortgage lending, or personal finance industry. • Familiarity with Credit Repair Cloud or similar credit repair CRM platforms. • Experience with SEO content strategy and managing a content calendar. • Knowledge of CROA (Credit Repair Organizations Act) marketing compliance requirements. • Experience managing remote teams or coordinating with offshore tea ---------- mbers. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured by the following metrics, reviewed monthly: KPI Target Qualified leads generated per month 200+ (ramp to 500+ within 6 months) Cost per lead (paid channels) Under $25 Lead-to-appointment conversion rate 25%+ Overall lead-to-client conversion rate 15–20?tive referral partnerships 10 within 60 days, 25+ within 6 months Speed to lead (contact within) 5 minutes of lead submission WHAT WE OFFER • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience. • Performance bonus tied directly to qualified leads and closed deals sourced — the better you perform, the more you earn. • 100% remote position with flexible working hours. • A company with 10+ years of history, 7,000+ clients, and a proven service that sells itself. • Direct access to and support from the founder/CEO. • A clear mandate: you own lead generation. Your results are visible and rewarded. • Opportunity to build and lead your own lead generation team as the company scales.
