title: Senior Marketing Assistant
description: Title: Senior Marketing Assistant — Video Editing (Virtual) Reports To: Karly, Digital Marketing Specialist Location: Remote, Philippines (Austin, TX business hours overlap required) Type: Full-time contractor Compensation: $1,800 – $2,000/month USD, plus 13th-month pay paid in December, prorated by tenure. Start Date: ~30 days ============================================================ ABOUT BRAMLETT PARTNERS ============================================================ Bramlett Partners is the fastest-growing independent residential real estate brokerage in Austin, TX. We support approximately 148 agents who close 1,300+ transactions and over $775M in volume annually. Our operating philosophy: amazing client service drives 5-star reviews and referrals. Technology, content, and systems are how we scale that standard without adding complexity. We are a technology-forward brokerage. Every tea ---------- mber is expected to use AI daily to work faster, smarter, and more independently. ============================================================ ROLE SUMMARY ============================================================ You will be the video editing engine behind Bramlett Partners' content marketing. You report directly to Karly and collaborate in real time with her on every project. Your job is execution: take raw interview footage, B-roll, and photos and turn them into clean, story-driven videos that get our agents and the Austin neighborhoods we serve in front of the right audiences. Beyond video, you will also produce supporting graphic design assets in Canva — video cover images, award and publication-feature posts, and brand-aligned carousels — using Karly's brand guide as your reference. Video editing is the primary role; design is a meaningful secondary responsibility, not an afterthought. This is a hands-on creative role. Karly is currently doing all of this editing and design herself, which means she is in the weeds instead of focused on grander marketing campaigns. Your success is measured by how much creative work you take off her plate without dropping quality. By day 90, the goal is that Karly is reviewing your cuts and designs, not making them. This role requires good judgment and taste. Transcripts, AI captions, and editing tools are starting points — they are not decision-makers. You will be expected to feel pacing, hear when a cut lands, and recognize when an interview ---------- nt needs to breathe versus when it needs to be tightened. If you have edited a lot of video and have strong instincts about story, this role is for you. If you are looking for a checklist-execution job, this is not the right fit. SEE OUR WORK ------------ Before applying, study our existing video and design work: - Instagram: ---------- - YouTube: ---------- This is the visual standard, tone, and pacing you will be matching and elevating. If you cannot deliver work at or above this level, this is not the right role for you. ============================================================ SCOPE AND PHASING ============================================================ PHASE 1: DAYS 1-30 (ORIGIN STORIES) - Learn Karly's editing style, prebuilt templates, and brand standards inside and out - Take ownership of agent origin story edits — interview cuts, B-roll layering, music, captions - Deliver one published-quality origin story per week by day 30 - Begin producing video cover images and basic graphic assets in Canva using the brand guide - Daily video check-ins with Karly to review cuts, get feedback, and learn the judgment model - Get fluent with CapCut, Epidemic Sound, Canva, and Karly's existing template library PHASE 2: DAYS 31-60 (ADD BUSINESS PROFILES) - Take over business profile editing (interview + B-roll). Target 3 published profiles per month - Begin owning the full creative pipeline for origin stories — Karly reviews final, not first cuts - Take ownership of recurring graphic design work: video covers, award/feature posts, "about us" carousels - Identify recurring B-roll needs and flag gaps for future filming - Daily check-ins continue but shorten as you demonstrate independence PHASE 3: DAYS 61-90 (ADD NEIGHBORHOOD SPOTLIGHTS) - Take over neighborhood spotlight edits (combining multiple business profiles + neighborhood B-roll) - Deliver 1 neighborhood spotlight per month - Earned autonomy on origin stories — Karly reviews only when you flag for review - Own the design pipeline end-to-end for recurring formats; Karly reviews one-offs - Daily check-ins transition to weekly 1:1s - (Stretch) Begin shadowing podcast editing in Riverside if Karly d ---------- to shift ownership of that workstream ============================================================ CORE RESPONSIBILITIES ============================================================ ORIGIN STORIES - What you own: Edit agent origin story videos from interview footage + B-roll + photos. Cut to a clean narrative arc, layer B-roll, score with music, add captions and on-screen elements. - Success metric: One origin story published per week. Day-30 target: own this end-to-end. BUSINESS PROFILES - What you own: Edit local business profile videos (interview + B-roll). Match tone of the business, build a story, deliver social-ready cuts. - Success metric: 3 business profiles published per month. Day-60 target: own this end-to-end. NEIGHBORHOOD SPOTLIGHTS - What you own: Combine multiple business profiles + neighborhood B-roll into a longer-form spotlight piece. Strong pacing, clear story, music that elevates. - Success metric: 1 neighborhood spotlight per month. Day-90 target: own this end-to-end. GRAPHIC DESIGN (CANVA) - What you own: Produce supporting design assets — video cover images, award and publication-feature posts, "about us" carousels, and one-off brand-aligned graphics. Recurring formats use templates; one-offs are built from scratch using the brand guide. - Success metric: Designs match brand standards on first pass. Karly approves rather than rebuilds. B-ROLL + ASSET MANAGEMENT - What you own: Review raw footage, log usable B-roll, organize project files in Drive so the team can find anything fast. - Success metric: Zero lost or unfindable assets. Project files organized to a documented standard. CAPTIONS + ON-SCREEN ELEMENTS - What you own: Generate AI captions in CapCut, match Karly's prebuilt template, add lower-thirds and on-screen graphics consistent with brand. - Success metric: Captions are accurate, on-brand, and require minimal Karly edits. MUSIC + SOUND DESIGN - What you own: Select and customize tracks (Epidemic Sound) that match tone and elevate the edit. Cut/loop tracks cleanly. - Success metric: Music choices land without rework. Audio levels mixed cleanly across dialogue, B-roll, and music. ============================================================ AI PROFICIENCY REQUIREMENTS ============================================================ This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. Every member of the Bramlett Partners team uses AI daily. You will be evaluated on your ability to use AI to work faster, generate better first drafts, and elevate your creative output. MINIMUM EXPECTATIONS: - Proficient with Claude or ChatGPT for transcript review, story structuring, copy drafting, and creative ideation - Able to write effective prompts that produce usable first drafts (not just "write me a caption") - Comfortable using AI to summarize long interview footage and identify the strongest soundbites - Willing to experiment with new AI tools and creative workflows without hand-holding WITHIN 90 DAYS, YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO: - Use Claude to scan interview transcripts and propose narrative outlines for Karly's review - Build simple Claude Projects with reference material for recurring video formats - Suggest AI-powered creative or workflow improvements to Karly ============================================================ REQUIREMENTS ============================================================ MUST HAVE - Strong demonstrated video editing portfolio. We will watch your work. - Strong storytelling instincts and a clear sense of pacing — particularly for interview-based content where the subject may be awkward on camera. You can find the story and cut to it. - Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar professional editing software - Comfort with B-roll layering, slow-mo treatments, and frame-rate work (CapCut: slow B-roll to .70 with optimal smooth — or equivalent technique in your editor of choice) - Music selection and sound design competence — familiarity with Epidemic Sound or similar a plus - Proficiency in Canva. You will build video cover images, social posts, award and feature graphics, and brand-aligned carousels weekly. Brand guide will be provided after screening. - Excellent written and spoken English. You will collaborate with Karly in real time via phone and video calls. - Demonstrated AI proficiency (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent). You will be tested in the interview. - Reliable internet, professional home office setup, and a workstation capable of handling video editing workloads - Ability to overlap with Austin, TX business hours (CT/UTC-6) for a minimum of 6 hours daily - Strong attention to detail. Captions, lower-thirds, and on-screen elements need to be accurate and on-brand. NICE TO HAVE - Experience editing real estate, lifestyle, or brand documentary content - Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or other professional design software experience - Familiarity with Riverside (we currently use it for podcast editing only — open to expanding ownership of that workstream) - Experience with motion graphics, lower-thirds templates, or basic After Effects work - Color correction and grading experience - Experience with social-first vertical formats (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) in addition to long-form DISQUALIFIERS We will not move forward with candidates who: - Do not have a video editing portfolio we can review - Cannot present professionally on camera with clear, understandable English (Karly collaborates with you in real time — voice and presence matter) - Have no demonstrated experience using AI tools in a work context - Require constant direction. This role demands creative judgment within Karly's brand guardrails. - Cannot commit to consistent Austin business hours overlap ============================================================ AUTHORITY AND DECISION RIGHTS ============================================================ - First-pass cuts (origin stories, business profiles): Full authority. Deliver complete first cut for Karly review. - Final cut sign-off: Karly approves all final cuts in first 60 days. Earned autonomy on origin stories after day 60. - Music selection: Full authority on track selection. Karly can veto. - B-roll selection: Full authority. Karly reviews on first cut. - Graphic design (recurring templated formats): Full authority on first draft. Karly reviews before publish. - Graphic design (one-off pieces, awards, features): Karly approves before publish in first 90 days. - Anything published to brokerage social channels: Karly approves before publish. Always. - Schedule changes, scope changes, new series ideas: Propose to Karly. Do not implement unilaterally. ============================================================ TOOLS YOU WILL USE ============================================================ - CapCut — Primary editor. Karly's preferred tool. Used for all short-form and most long-form work. (Learn by Week 1) - Epidemic Sound — Music library. Custom track length and flow. (Learn by Week 1) - Canva — Primary design tool. All graphic design work — covers, posts, carousels, one-off graphics — is built here against the Bramlett brand guide. (Learn by Week 1) - Riverside — Podcast editing platform. Familiarity is a plus — podcast ownership may shift to this role over time. (Learn by Week 4, familiarity) - Claude / Claude Projects — AI-assisted prompts for transcript review, copy drafting, and creative direction. Karly will share her Strategy, Design Inspo, and Copy projects. (Learn by Week 1) - Google Workspace — Drive (footage + project files), Docs, Sheets. (Learn by Week 1) ============================================================ REPORTING AND COMMUNICATION ============================================================ DAYS 1-90 - Daily video check-in with Karly (15-30 minutes) to review cuts in progress, get feedback, and align on priorities - Daily async written summary at end of your workday: what you completed, what is in progress, what is blocked - Real-time availability during overlap hours for quick feedback loops on cuts in progress - Escalation protocol: if unsure, ask. Default to over-communicating in the first 90 days. AFTER 90 DAYS (EARNED AUTONOMY) - Weekly 1:1 video call with Karly (30 minutes) - Daily async written check-in continues ============================================================ WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE ============================================================ AT 30 DAYS - You are publishing one origin story per week without quality issues - You are fluent in CapCut, Karly's templates, Canva, and Epidemic Sound - Karly is spending less time editing origin stories and producing video covers herself - You have shown clear creative judgment on at least 4 published edits AT 90 DAYS - You own origin stories, business profiles, and neighborhood spotlights end-to-end - You own recurring graphic design formats end-to-end; Karly reviews one-offs only - Karly is reviewing your final cuts and designs, not making them - You have proposed at least 2 creative or workflow improvements (using AI or otherwise) - Karly considers you a creative collaborator she does not need to micromanage - Daily check-ins have transitioned to weekly 1:1s AT 6 MONTHS - You are a trusted creative on the Bramlett Partners marketing team - Karly is fully focused on grander campaigns because the recurring video and design pipeline runs without her in the weeds - You are experimenting with new formats, AI-augmented workflows, and creative ideas without being asked - (Possible) You have taken over podcast editing in Riverside if scope expanded in that direction ============================================================ HOW TO APPLY ============================================================ To apply, please complete the TestGorilla assessments here: ---------- YOUR APPLICATION SHOULD INCLUDE: - Your resume - A portfolio link with at least 3 examples of interview-based video editing work (origin stories, brand documentary, profile pieces preferred) and 2-3 examples of graphic design work (Canva or any tool — social posts, covers, carousels, marketing graphics). Tell us in 1-2 sentences what you did on each piece. Applications without a portfolio (video + design) will not be reviewed. PROCESS: - Step 1: Complete the assessments and submit your application materials. - Step 2: Shortlisted candidates are invited to a ~15-minute screener call with our hiring team. - Step 3: After the screener, finalists complete a trial project (real editing brief and a Canva design brief, source materials provided) so we can see how you actually work. - Step 4: Final interview with leadership team and offer.

You've worked in GoHighLevel and understand how to build automations, workflows, and campaigns inside the platform. Bonus if you've done this for a service-based or local business. A strong writer. You can write email s that sound human, build trust, and drive action—not generic marketing fluff. Systems-minded. You think in workflows and sequences. You love mapping out "if this, then that" logic and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. Make sure to include the word "genie" at the beginning of your application to indicate you've been paying attention. Data-driven. You make decisions based on metrics and are always looking for the next optimization. Detail-obsessed. Typos, broken links, and missed sends aren't in your vocabulary. Self-sufficient. You don't need to be told what to do every day. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen. Requirements 2+ years of email marketing experience Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (required) Strong copywriting skills—especially for direct response and service businesses Experience building automated workflows and drip sequences Understanding of email deliverability, list hygiene, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, etc.) Ability to analyze performance and optimize based on data Bonus Points Experience in med spa, beauty, wellness, or healthcare Familiarity with SMS marketing (we'll likely expand into this) You've built email systems from scratch before You're proactive about suggesting new ideas and improvements Why Join Us Full ownership of the channel. You're not executing someone else's vision—you're building the strategy and running with it. Real impact. Email is a direct revenue driver for us. You'll see your work translate into booked appointments and dollars. Room to grow. As we scale, this role can expand into a broader lifecycle or retention marketing position. A team that values execution. We move fast, test often, and reward results. Compensation Competitive, based on experience. We're open to full-time or part-time arrangements depending on your background and availability. To Apply Send the following: Your resume or LinkedIn A short note on your GHL experience—what you've built, what you've managed, results you've driven An example of an email sequence or campaign you're proud of (screenshots, copy doc, or brief walkthrough) We're looking for someone who treats email like a craft—not an afterthought. If you're that person, we want to hear from you.

Brand Voice & Copywriting: Act as the "editor-in-chief" for all outbound communications, ensuring a professional, insightful, and supportive tone—specifically when targeting HR Directors and C-Suite executives. title: Simple Video Editor
description: Video Editor (Screen Recording Videos) I'm looking for a reliable video editor to help me edit simple screen-recording videos. What You'll Receive Raw screen recording footage Voice-over audio Your Job Your task is very straightforward: Listen to the voice-over. Edit the screen recording so that the visuals match what is being explained in the audio. Cut out unnecessary parts and keep the video flowing smoothly. Blur any personal or sensitive information that may appear on screen (such as email addresses, account details, personal information, etc.). That's it. I am not looking for: Fancy animations Motion graphics Sound effects Background music Complex editing The main goal is simply to ensure that whatever is being discussed in the audio is clearly visible in the video at the same time. Work Volume Currently, I publish about one video per week because of time constraints. Once I have a dependable editor handling the editing, I'll be able to spend more time recording content. This means the number of videos per month will likely increase over time. Payment $1 per minute of the final edited video. The voice-over audio will already be finalized when I send it to you. You will not need to edit, shorten, extend, clean up, or otherwise modify the audio. Your job is simply to edit the screen recording footage so that it matches what is being said in the voice-over. Since the audio length is fixed, the final video length will generally be determined by the audio file I provide. Examples: 5-minute final video = $5 payment 10-minute final video = $10 payment In most cases, the duration of the final video will closely match the duration of the voice-over that I send you. Requirements Good attention to detail Ability to follow instructions accurately Basic video editing skills Ability to blur sensitive information when required Reliable communication Ability to deliver on agreed deadlines How to Apply Please include the keyword BlueMango somewhere in your application so I know you have read the entire job post. Also, please share 1–3 examples of screen-recording videos or similar videos that you have edited in the past.

description: Foresight Environmental is seeking an experienced Power BI Report Specialist to help us build a growing library of professional, client-ready Power BI and paginated reports. About Foresight Environmental Foresight Environmental is an Australian environmental services and sustainability business. We help property owners, managers and organisations improve the way they manage waste, data, reporting and environmental performance. We are expanding our internal reporting capability and want to develop a repeatable report library that supports internal delivery and future client reporting releases. The role will involve working with data from our Synthesis Portal, Dynamics 365, Excel, SharePoint, SQL databases, APIs and other approved sources. This is not a basic dashboard role. We need someone who can combine strong technical Power BI skills with excellent visual design judgement and disciplined data transformation practices. Key Responsibilities Power BI Report Development •  Design, build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards for internal and client-facing use. •  Create clear, professional report layouts that are suitable for client release. •  Translate report examples, sketches, briefs and business requirements into working Power BI outputs. •  Develop reusable report templates, page layouts, visual patterns, themes and components. •  Apply good judgement to filters, navigation, bookmarks, drill-through, interactivity and user experience. Paginated Reporting •  Build paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder / Microsoft Report Builder. •  Create fixed-format reports for PDF, Excel and structured client reporting packs. •  Design and maintain parameters, grouped tables, summary sections, headers, footers, page breaks and export layouts. •  Test rendering, pagination, formatting, export behaviour and data accuracy before handover. description: About Us We’re building a global talent pool of exceptional remote Medical Scribes / Documentation QA Specialists to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative care, and allied health support. Our shared mission is simple: make healthcare more human—by supporting clinicians with accurate, consistent documentation so patients receive safe, continuous care and clinics can operate with confidence. Role Overview As a Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality), you’ll help ensure patient charts are complete, accurate, and easy for clinicians to use. Depending on clinic assignment, your work may include real-time or near-real-time scribing during telehealth visits, post-visit documentation cleanup, and ongoing chart audits to maintain consistent standards. This is a pooling/talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to open roles with clinics based on: • Your scribing and documentation experience (telehealth, in-person, specialty exposure) • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US) • EHR systems you’ve used (or your ability to learn quickly) • Compensation alignment and expected workload volume Note: You do not provide medical advice. job_title: AI UGC Ad Creator For Social Media Platforms
description: # JOB POST #1 — AI UGC Ad Creator **Job Title:** Full-Time AI UGC Video Creator / Short-Form Ad Editor **Location:** Remote — Philippines **Schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours per week. Must be available for overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. **Salary:** USD $800 per month **Start Date:** ASAP ## About the Role ModernMed is looking for a highly creative AI Video Creator who can produce realistic, high-quality UGC-style short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You will create original videos featuring AI-generated virtual actors, product visuals, scenes, voiceovers, and realistic user-generated-content style presentations. We will provide product direction, brand assets, scripts, reference videos, and examples of styles we want recreated. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to make AI-generated content feel natural, modern, engaging, and native to TikTok and Instagram. ## Responsibilities * Create 4-6 short-form vertical videos per day. * Produce realistic AI UGC-style ads featuring virtual actors, product visuals, scenes, dialogue, and voiceovers. * Create AI-generated people holding, discussing, or presenting ModernMed product packaging and vials. * Turn provided scripts, hooks, product concepts, and references into engaging video ads. * Study provided reference videos and identify similar TikTok, Instagram, and Reels trends. * Build a research folder with screenshots, links, hooks, editing styles, caption styles, and trend ideas. * Recreate the style and structure of reference content while keeping every final video original. * Maintain consistent visual quality across AI characters, product shots, colors, labels, and branding. * Organize prompts, project files, raw assets, and final exported videos. ## Required Skills * Strong experience editing TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts content. * Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar editing tools. * Experience with AI video tools such as Kling, Runway, Pika, Veo, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, CapCut AI, or similar. * Ability to create realistic AI people, movements, scenes, voiceovers, and product visuals. * Strong understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, captions, sound effects, and viral-style editing. * Good English reading and caption-writing skills. * Ability to work quickly, take feedback well, and complete revisions. * Strong organization and attention to detail. ## Important Content Standards * AI presenters must be original virtual characters and must not copy the face, voice, identity, or likeness of a real person without permission. * Follow all ModernMed brand language and content instructions. ## Preferred Qualifications * Experience creating AI UGC ads. * Experience creating realistic AI characters. * Experience with fitness, wellness, beauty, educational, or product-based content. * Experience recreating viral TikTok ad styles. * Motion graphics skills are a plus. ## How to Apply Please send: * Your short-form video editing portfolio * Examples of AI-generated videos you have created * Your expected start date * A short message explaining why you are a good fit * Your favorite AI-generated ad you have made and why it performed well Applicants who can complete a short paid test task will be prioritized. Please include the words **“AI UGC CREATOR”** at the beginning of your application. All applicants picked will be subject to having a 10-15 minute virtual interview with ModernMed Manager. English Only.

title: Client Growth & Success Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description: Job Title: Client Growth & Success Specialist (Full-Time, Remote) Location: Remote Salary: 86,412.13 PHP per month + 5,000 PHP sign-on bonus + quarterly performance bonuses after probation About us We are a North American digital marketing agency that works exclusively with lash extension businesses across the United States and Canada. We run paid advertising, lead generation, and end-to-end booking operations for approximately 50 lash studio owners. We cover our clients' ad spend, manage their leads, and book appointments on their behalf — all for a flat weekly fee. We are a fast-growing, results-driven company that holds itself to a high standard. Every person on our team has a direct impact on client outcomes and company growth. We invest in our people and we pay well because we expect a lot. About This Role This is a full-time remote position that combines two functions: inbound discovery sales and client success management. You will be working directly with our founder and leadership team. This is not a traditional sales role. You will not be cold calling or doing outbound prospecting. Prospective clients have already expressed interest in our services before speaking with you. Your job is to walk them through what we do, assess whether they are a good fit, and connect qualified prospects with our Lash Growth Specialist for the next step. Alongside that, you will be managing relationships with our existing clients — answering their questions, reviewing their performance reports on Zoom, handling their concerns, and most importantly, overcoming objections from clients who are frustrated or uncertain. This part of the role requires emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to stay calm and professional when a client is upset. Schedule Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (MST) 30-minute unpaid lunch break Two 15-minute breaks per day You must be fully available and online during all working hours. Please verify the MST time zone against your local time before applying. Late starts, early finishes, and unexplained absences will not be tolerated. What You Will Be Doing Discovery Calls Get on Zoom calls with prospective clients who have reached out to learn about Swoop Lift Introduce yourself and explain our services clearly and confidently Assess whether the prospect is a qualified fit for our program Book a follow-up call with our Lash Growth Specialist for qualified prospects Handle any objections the prospect raises calmly and professionally Client Success Management Respond promptly and professionally to existing client questions via WhatsApp and other channels Get on Zoom calls with clients to review their monthly performance reports Handle client concerns and complaints with empathy and composure Overcome objections from clients who are frustrated, uncertain, or pushing back Escalate serious concerns to management through the proper internal process Keep accurate notes and records on every client interaction Requirements English — This Is Non-Negotiable This role requires a level of English proficiency that is indistinguishable from a native speaker in both spoken and written form. Our clients are North American small business owners. Any accent, grammatical error, or awkward phrasing that makes a client feel they are speaking to someone overseas will damage the client relationship and reflect poorly on Swoop Lift. You must speak English fluently and clearly with no accent that would be noticeable or distracting to a North American client. You will be on Zoom calls every single day with your camera on. You must write in flawless English — correct grammar, correct spelling, correct punctuation, and natural phrasing — at a fast typing speed. All client communication is written and must be professional and error-free. You must be able to produce all written communication yourself without the use of AI writing tools. We test for this during the hiring process and throughout employment. Use of AI to write client-facing messages is grounds for immediate termination. You must be a fast typist. If your typing speed is below 50 words per minute, this role is not for you. Other Requirements You must be comfortable on camera. Every call is conducted on Zoom with your camera on. This is not optional. You must have a reliable internet connection, a quiet working environment, and a clean professional background for video calls. You must have strong emotional intelligence. Our clients are small business owners who are often stressed and reactive. You need to stay calm, composed, and empathetic when a client is difficult without taking it personally. You must have excellent common sense and the ability to make decisions independently. We cannot micromanage every client interaction. You will need to read situations, use good judgment, and handle things on your own without being told what to do. You must be organized and detail-oriented. You will be managing multiple client relationships simultaneously. You must be a fast learner. We will train you on our services and processes but you are expected to retain information and apply it independently. What We Are Not Looking For Candidates who need to be told what to do in every situation Candidates who use AI to write their responses and pass it off as their own work Candidates who struggle under pressure or become flustered when clients are difficult Candidates who are not fully available during the required working hours Candidates whose spoken or written English requires any effort for a North American to understand If any of the above describes you, please do not apply. Compensation Base Salary: 86,412.13 PHP per month Sign-On Bonus: 5,000 PHP upon successful completion of probation Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based, available after probation — details discussed during the interview Employment Type: Full-time, remote How to Apply We do not accept applications through this platform alone. To be considered you must complete both of the following steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed. Step 1 — Download Telegram and send your resume to: ---------- Step 2 — Record a video of yourself responding to the following objection as if you are speaking to a real client on a Zoom call: "I love what you guys do and it sounds amazing but honestly I just cannot afford it right now. It is too much money for me at this stage." Video requirements: Camera must be on. We need to see your face. State the current date clearly at the beginning of the video. Videos without the date will not be accepted. Length should be between 2 and 4 minutes. Speak naturally. Do not read from a script. Audio must be clear and your background must be clean and professional. Send the video to the same Telegram number along with your resume. The video is your first impression. Treat it like the interview has already started. Only candidates who impress us in the video will be contacted for the next stage.

job_title: Billing Specialist | Accounts Receivable & Technical Project Billing
description: About Coastal Communications Coastal Communications is a growing U.S.-based telecommunications engineering and infrastructure services company. We support fiber-optic, wireless, utility, permitting, field engineering, design, inspection, and related technical projects. We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Billing Specialist based in the Philippines to manage both straightforward administrative billing and more complex project-based billing. This position requires someone who can understand contracts, purchase orders, project records, employee time, billing rates, and supporting documentation—not simply create basic invoices. Position Summary The Billing Specialist will prepare accurate and timely invoices for Coastal Communications’ clients. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with a mixture of: Simple fixed-fee and recurring invoices Hourly and time-and-material billing Project milestone and percentage-completion billing Unit-based or production billing Purchase order and work order billing Detailed telecommunications and engineering billing Invoice backup packages and client-specific billing requirements This role will work closely with company leadership, project managers, operations personnel, accounting staff, employees, and independent contractors to confirm that all completed work is properly documented and billed. Key Responsibilities Prepare, review, and submit client invoices accurately and on schedule. Review contracts, proposals, purchase orders, statements of work, work authorizations, and client billing instructions. Match employee and contractor time entries to approved billing rates, projects, tasks, and purchase orders. Prepare billing for hourly, fixed-fee, milestone, unit-based, recurring, and time-and-material projects. Verify that invoices include all required supporting documentation. Create organized invoice packages containing timesheets, production reports, field records, deliverables, receipts, and other required backup. Track project budgets, authorized amounts, billing limits, purchase order balances, and previously invoiced amounts. Identify unbilled work, missing time, incomplete records, billing discrepancies, and potential revenue leakage. Communicate with project managers and staff to resolve missing or inaccurate billing information. Maintain billing schedules and ensure invoices are submitted before client deadlines. Enter invoices and related information into QuickBooks or other accounting and project-management systems. Monitor accounts receivable and prepare reports showing invoice status, payment status, aging, and outstanding balances. Follow up professionally regarding overdue invoices, rejected invoices, or requests for revised documentation. Maintain accurate electronic billing files and client records. Assist with account reconciliation, collections support, reporting, and month-end billing close. Recommend improvements to billing procedures, internal controls, and documentation processes. Protect confidential company, client, employee, and financial information. Required Qualifications At least three years of billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or accounting-support experience. Strong experience preparing invoices from contracts, purchase orders, timesheets, rate sheets, and project records. Comfortable managing both simple invoices and detailed technical or project-based billing. Advanced attention to detail and accuracy. Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills. Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software. Ability to understand billing rates, quantities, units, project codes, task codes, and budget limits. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based managers, employees, vendors, and clients. Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple billing deadlines without constant supervision. Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote working environment. Willingness to maintain reasonable working-hour overlap with the U.S. Pacific Time Zone. Preferred Qualifications Experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred: Telecommunications Fiber-optic engineering or construction Utility or infrastructure services Architecture or engineering Construction Professional services Field services Government contracting Project-based consulting Additional preferred experience includes: QuickBooks Online Accounts-receivable aging and collections Purchase order reconciliation Progress or milestone billing Time-and-material billing Contractor and employee timesheet review Client billing portals Month-end closing procedures Project-management or timekeeping platforms Technical Billing Expectations Applicants do not need to be telecommunications engineers. However, the selected candidate must be willing and able to learn terminology associated with projects such as: Fiber design and field engineering Permitting and right-of-way services GIS and CAD drafting Utility coordination Pole surveys and inspections Traffic-control plans Small-cell and wireless projects Construction inspection As-built documentation Project deliverables and production units The Billing Specialist must be able to connect completed technical work to the correct project, purchase order, contract rate, billing unit, and invoice documentation. What Success Looks Like A successful Billing Specialist will: Submit accurate invoices by every required deadline. Reduce missed or delayed billing. Identify completed work that has not yet been invoiced. Maintain accurate purchase order and project-balance records. Provide complete supporting documentation with each invoice. Resolve billing discrepancies promptly. Keep leadership informed of unbilled revenue, overdue invoices, and potential billing issues. Create organized systems that make billing easier to review and audit. Work Schedule This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines. The employee must be available for scheduled meetings and regular communication with Coastal Communications’ U.S.-based team. Some overlap with Pacific Time business hours will be required. The final schedule may include a combination of Philippine daytime work and designated U.S. business-hour coverage. Compensation Competitive monthly compensation based on experience, technical billing knowledge, accounting skills, English proficiency, and availability. Applicants should include their expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos. How to Apply Please submit: Your updated résumé. A brief introduction describing your billing and accounts-receivable experience. The accounting, billing, and project-management software you have used. An example of the most complex billing process you have managed. Your experience reviewing contracts, purchase orders, timesheets, or rate sheets. Your expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos. Your availability to begin. Your preferred working hours and ability to overlap with U.S. Pacific Time. The word “Coastal” at the beginning of your application subject line. Applications that do not address the questions above may not be considered.

WHAT YOU"LL HELP WITH • Manage or help manage the email inbox • Enter orders in Zoho Inventory • Enter or mirror needed information in QuickBooks during our transition • Prepare estimates, invoices, sales orders, and order confirmations • Send customer statements and friendly payment follow-ups • Help manage customer accounts and AR • Support customer service through email and occasional calls • Help with purchasing and vendor follow-up • Maintain accurate customer, order, invoice, and payment records • Apply credits or correct clear pricing/account issues within agreed guidelines • Create checklists, improve SOPs, and document recurring processes • Identify bottlenecks and suggest and implement practical improvements • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to draft, summarize, organize, and improve efficiency • Provide regular progress updates and flag questions or process gaps THE RIGHT PERSON IS • Highly trustworthy • Accurate and detail-oriented • Organized and proactive • Comfortable with customer-facing communication • Systems-minded and tech savvy • Confident improving processes • Honest when something is unclear • Willing to ask questions before guessing • Interested in long-term work • Comfortable working with a small business where things are improving but not yet perfect You should enjoy making processes more organized, accurate, repeatable, and efficient. The trial may include watching a short order-entry screen recording, repeating the process with sample information, drafting a customer confirmation email , reviewing a sample account, or creating/improving an order-entry checklist. different hooks, pacing, CTAs and visual treatments to maximise performance - Design and build motion assets: animated supers, lower thirds, text overlays, transitions, kinetic typography, and branded end cards - Craft scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–3 seconds using a combination of editing technique and motion design - Apply re-hook techniques throughout each ad - pacing changes, visual pattern interrupts, text callouts, and motion cues that sustain viewer attention - Adapt content across platform-specific formats and aspect ratios (9:16 Stories/Reels, 4:5 Feed, 1:1 where needed) - Collaborate with the Creative Strategist and Paid Media Manager to interpret briefs, understand performance data, and iterate on creative direction - Coordinate with videographers to understand available footage and plan asset requirements - Test new creative approaches and editing styles while maintaining brand consistency - Manage multiple projects simultaneously with quick turnaround times - Stay current with paid social trends, platform algorithm changes, and emerging ad formats What We’re Looking For - 2-4 years of video editing experience with a focus on social media advertising or performance creative - Strong motion graphics and animation skills - you can build supers, lower thirds, animated text, transitions, and branded elements from scratch in After Effects (or equivalent) - Proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar) plus experience with After Effects or a comparable motion design tool - Experience with AI-driven editing and design platforms - Deep understanding of paid ad structure - you know how hooks, body content, and CTAs work together to drive conversions - Strong design eye - you understand typography, layout, colour, and hierarchy, and can apply these principles to motion assets that look polished and on-brand - Knowledge of platform-specific video formats, specs, and best practices across Meta and TikTok - Experience creating multiple creative variations for testing and optimisation - Ability to work with feedback efficiently, managing multiple projects with tight deadlines - Excellent communication skills for collaborating with creative and paid media teams across time zones Bonus Points - Experience with fitness, wellness, or supplement brands - Understanding of paid social advertising metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, thumbstop ratio, ROAS) - Experience editing UGC-style content for direct-response campaigns - Familiarity with creative testing frameworks and iteration processes - Background working with e-commerce brands or performance marketing agencies - Familiarity with the Australian market and cultural nuances Work Arrangement - 30-day contract with a view to transition into a full-time role based on performance and mutual fit - Based in the Philippines, working remotely with our Australian team - Flexible schedule with regular meetings alongside AU creative and paid media teams - Reporting to the Creative Strategist and Paid Media Manager How to Apply Please note: we will only progress applications that complete the task below. Video Editing & Motion Design Task Objective: Promote our Protein Water to fitness enthusiasts aged 22–35 through engaging short-form paid social content. Brief: You’ve been provided with raw footage here. Your task is to create 3x short-form video ads (15–30 seconds each), each with a different hook and creative approach, suitable for Facebook and Instagram Feed/Stories. You can use placeholder footage or describe your editing approach where needed. Available Assets: UGC-style fitness creator footage (gym setting, protein shaker) Pouring clips Workout clips Product pack shots Backdrop footage What We Want to See: - A strong, scroll-stopping hook within the first 3 seconds of each variation - show us you understand what makes someone stop and watch - Re-hook techniques throughout each ad that sustain viewer attention (pacing shifts, visual pattern interrupts, text callouts, motion cues) - Motion design elements you’ve built: supers, lower thirds, animated text, transitions, or branded end cards - these should demonstrate your design ability, not just your editing chops - Understanding of paid ad structure: hook > body > CTA - Platform-appropriate formatting in both 9:16 and 4:5 aspect ratios Submission Requirements: - 3x video ad variations as described above - Your portfolio showcasing relevant paid social video and motion design work - A brief cover letter explaining your experience with performance creative and motion design, and why this role excites you Evaluation Criteria: - Hook effectiveness - does it stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds? - Re-hook and pacing techniques - how well do you sustain attention throughout the ad? - Motion design quality - are your supers, text treatments, and transitions polished and well-designed? - Understanding of paid ad structure and platform best practices - Creative storytelling and performance marketing mindset - Technical editing skills and attention to detail We’re excited to see how you can help elevate our paid social creative and drive results for Muscle Nation!

description: Medical Credentialing Specialist Credentialing / Provider Services Reports To:  CEO Employment Type:  Full-Time Location:  Remote Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Credentialing Specialist to own and lead the credentialing function for our practice with minimal day-to-day supervision. This person will manage the full credentialing and payer enrollment lifecycle for all providers, partner closely with the billing team to keep providers compliant and in-network, and serve as the subject-matter expert the rest of the team relies on. In addition to leading credentialing, this role supports our front desk operations. The specialist will answer phones and schedule patient appointments when calls roll over from the front desk, and will step in to support other front-desk functions as needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable balancing detailed compliance work with patient-facing support. Key Responsibilities Credentialing & Provider Enrollment (Primary) • Take charge of the practice's credentialing operations independently, managing the complete lifecycle for all providers from initial credentialing through re-credentialing. • Complete and submit initial credentialing, re-credentialing, and payer enrollment applications for commercial and government payers (Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans). • Maintain and update provider profiles in CAQH ProView, PECOS, NPPES/NPI, and payer portals, ensuring all information is accurate and current. • Perform primary source verification of licenses, education, training, board certifications, work history, and malpractice coverage. • Track and proactively manage expirables — state licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, malpractice insurance, and other time-sensitive credentials — and renew them ahead of deadlines to prevent lapses. • Maintain organized, audit-ready provider files and credentialing records in compliance with applicable standards (e.g., NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and payer requirements). • Monitor application status, follow up persistently with payers, and resolve issues to keep enrollment moving and minimize delays. • Serve as the internal point of contact and resource on credentialing questions, escalations, and process improvements. Billing & Compliance Collaboration • Work closely with the billing team to ensure providers remain in compliance with all credentialing and enrollment requirements so that claims can be submitted and reimbursed without disruption. • Communicate provider effective dates, network participation status, and enrollment changes to billing in a timely manner. • Help research and resolve claim denials or holds tied to credentialing or enrollment issues. • Keep leadership and billing informed of upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and any gaps that could affect reimbursement. Front Desk & Patient Support (Secondary) • Answer incoming phone calls that roll over from the front desk, providing courteous and professional service to patients. • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments accurately. • Support additional front-desk functions as needed, such as patient check-in/check-out, verifying demographic and insurance information, and responding to general patient inquiries. • Provide coverage and backup for front-desk staff during high-volume periods, breaks, or absences. Required Qualifications • 3+ years of hands-on medical credentialing and/or payer enrollment experience. • Demonstrated ability to manage credentialing operations independently with minimal supervision. • Working knowledge of credentialing standards and regulatory requirements (NCQA, CMS, Joint Commission, and payer-specific guidelines). • Proficiency with CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and commercial/government payer enrollment portals. • Strong understanding of how credentialing and enrollment affect billing and reimbursement. • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to track many deadlines simultaneously. • Professional verbal and written communication skills and a patient-friendly phone manner. • Comfortable using practice management and/or credentialing software, EHR systems, and standard office applications. • High level of discretion and the ability to handle confidential provider and patient information in compliance with HIPAA. Preferred Qualifications • CPCS (Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist) or CPMSM (Certified Professional Medical Services Management) certification through NAMSS or equivalent experience. • Prior experience in a lead or senior credentialing role. • Front desk, scheduling, or patient-facing healthcare experience. • Familiarity with the specialties and payers relevant to our practice. Core Competencies • Ownership & autonomy — takes initiative and drives the credentialing function forward without needing close oversight. • Detail & accuracy — treats deadlines and documentation as non-negotiable. • Collaboration — works seamlessly across credentialing, billing, and front-desk teams. • Adaptability — moves comfortably between focused compliance work and patient-facing support. • Customer service — represents the practice professionally to patients and payers alike. Work Environment & Physical Requirements • Standard medical office environment. • Extended periods of computer and phone work. • Occasional reaching, lifting of office materials, and movement throughout the office to support front-desk coverage. description: ABOUT THE ROLE + BUSINESS! I run a design studio in Sydney working across music industry branding, web design , cover art, merch, and wedding/event stationery + more. I've got more work than hands right now, and I'm looking for a production designer who can become my right hand. You won't be inventing concepts from scratch. I bring the direction and the creative. What I need is someone who takes my work and runs it cleanly across everything it needs to become. The studio runs across two sides: graphic design (branding, logos, web, cover art, merch) and wedding / event stationery (menus, signage, place cards, full suites, Canva sites etc.), so you'd be touching a real mix of work. Take a look at what I do at ---------- ---------- on Instagram] for a general feel. That's just a taster, as I work with lots of clients across music, hospitality, retail, beauty and more. WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY BE DOING You'd be working across both sides of the studio, so this is a real mix of digital and print, branding and stationery. ~ Taking a design (say a poster) and adapting it into multiple assets: social square, story 9:16, banner, web sizes. Done properly, with real attention to layout and hierarchy at each ratio, not just squashing it to fit. ~ File prep for print, mostly on the stationery side: menus, signage, place cards, full suites. Setting up files correctly for print (bleed, crop marks, CMYK, correct dimensions) and getting them press-ready. ~ Building and styling Canva RSVP websites for events, clean, on-brand, and matching the stationery suite. ~ Helping refine and execute logo concepts I bring you. Cleaning vectors, building variations, testing at different sizes, tightening curves. ~ Vectorising. ~ File prep and organisation. Keeping my design library tidy and consistent. ~ General design work across both businesses as we build a rhythm and confidence. ***A quick note on AI: I'm not against it as a little helper along the way! But the design itself has to come from you and your skills, not from AI doing the heavy lifting. I can always tell the difference. I'll also always need working files I can open and edit, so the real work has to be there underneath.*** WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR ~ Strong in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. This is non-negotiable, you live in these every day. ~ Comfortable in Canva too, especially for the RSVP websites and quick-turnaround pieces. ~ A genuinely good eye for layout and type. You notice when something's off. ~ You get aesthetic direction quickly. My studio has a specific look, and you don't need to design in that style yourself, but you do need to see it and stay true to it when you adapt my work! ~ Fast and reliable with communication. I hate chasing people, and you need to speak and write English well. ~ You follow direction well, but you're not a robot. You'll flag it if something looks wrong! ~ Clean, organised file habits. ~ You're open to collaboration and communication. I'm always up for ideas and suggestions on the design work, so I want someone who'll actually engage! TO APPLY, SEND ME: 1. Your portfolio! A link please, not attachments. 2. In a line or two, tell me what kind of design work you most enjoy and why. I'd love to get a feel for you. 3. Start your message with the word "xplique" so I know you actually read this. I'll be deleting any that don't, sorry! If you've read this far and it sounds like you, get in touch! I'm genuinely looking for my right-hand person, and if we work out, this becomes long-term and full-time. I'd love to build the studio out with the right someone.

title: Graphic Designer — Direct Response Static Ads (Remote)
job_title: Graphic Designer — Direct Response Static Ads (Remote)
description: Graphic Designer — Direct Response Static Ads (Remote ) We're a fast-moving direct response health & wellness brand scaling aggressively on paid social (Meta FB ads. We need a graphic designer who already knows what a winning static ad looks like in the DR world — not someone we have to teach. What you'll be doing: Creating high-converting static image ads across the entire funnel. That means top-of-funnel native-style creatives designed to blend into the feed and stop the scroll, mid-funnel ads that retarget warm audiences with social proof, testimonials, comparison graphics, and "why us" positioning, and bottom-of-funnel ads that close — urgency-driven creatives, offer stacks, limited-time reminders, and conversion-focused layouts that push people over the edge. You'll also be working on advertorial-style layouts, before/afters, UGC-style statics, editorial mockups, and review/testimonial highlight creatives. Everything is built to sell, not to look pretty on a mood board. You need to have: Experience designing statics specifically for direct response brands — health, beauty, skincare, supplement, or wellness brands that run paid traffic at scale. If your portfolio is full of corporate branding or logo work, this isn't the right fit. We want to see ads that were built to convert at every stage of the funnel. Proficiency in Figma, Photoshop, and/or Canva Pro. You know how to work with ad dimensions across platforms, understand text-safe zones, and can format for mobile-first. A strong grasp of what makes people stop scrolling at TOF, what builds trust and desire at MOF, and what triggers action at BOF. You understand visual hierarchy, bold hooks, curiosity-driven layouts, and how to pair copy with imagery so the whole thing hits as one unit. What we expect: You can hit 24-hour turnaround deadlines consistently. When we send you a brief in the morning, we need deliverables by the next day — not "sometime this week." You can handle revisions fast. First round of feedback shouldn't take another full day. We move quickly and need someone who matches our speed. You're comfortable receiving direct, blunt creative feedback. We test everything and iterate based on data, not feelings. You can manage multiple briefs at once without dropping the ball. Bonus if you: Have experience creating statics that pair with video ad funnels — pre-sell pages, advertorials, landing page headers. Understand the relationship between the ad creative, the hook, and the landing page experience. Have worked with supplement, skincare, or anti-aging brands specifically. To apply: Send your portfolio with examples of direct response statics you've designed across TOF, MOF, and BOF (not brand work — actual DR ad creatives). Tell us which brands you've worked with, what platforms those ads ran on, and if possible, share any performance context. If you don't have DR-specific work to show, this role probably isn't the right match.

title: AI Savvy Operations Assistant
description: Hi! My name's Ajay, and I'm the founder of a SaaS company in the email space called GMass. My company, GMass, makes software that turns a Gmail account into an email marketing platform. For the last 12 years, I've been grinding away on all the things that a techy CEO of a promising startup does: coding, marketing, sales, support, administration, responding to email …oh boy, so much email . Which you might expect because we're an email company. I need some help with all the busy-work so I can get back to building our product and growing the company. Writing: You must have a strong grasp of written English. You should be able to write excellent prose without the use of AI. I consider myself a good writer, and you should  be able to write as well or better than me so you can communicate on my behalf. You’ll be managing my Inbox and replying to email s in my voice. Spoken English: You should be able to converse in English, so that you can participate in phone calls and video meetings. You must have a strong grasp of AI tools and their capabilities. In fact, you should already be using AI tools in your daily life. If we can travel back in time two months, and you were working with me then, here are some actual projects I’d assign to you: We have a series of email campaigns we need to send to our user-base of 1-million+ users. Wait until our content producer is finished with the content, then prep, schedule, and monitor all of the campaigns. Then, reply to everyone that replies to the campaign. Go through the last six months of email s in my Inbox and reply to anyone needing a reply. A big customer has reached out directly to me and they're upset because they feel like the support team hasn't adequately addressed the issue. Dig in, find out what's going on, and solve the issue for the customer. I need to plan an in-person retreat for my small leadership team. We need hotels, flights, dinners, and a space to collaborate. Is leasing or buying the better option now? I’ve d ---------- to buy a baby grand piano for my kids to practice on. Research pianos, stores, and costs, and ultimately tell me what to do. Finally, it's important that we get along and enjoy working together. If we don't, we'll start to drift, the role will become stagnant, and we’ll eventually part ways. Our Meta ad account / Instagram account is currently suspended, and Meta has been experiencing significant account restrictions and ban waves. Because of this, we are looking for a media buyer who can objectively assess our situation and recommend the most viable platform and strategy based on current market conditions rather than defaulting to a single advertising channel. We are not looking for someone to simply "run ads." We are looking for a strategic partner who can evaluate our situation, recommend the best path forward, and provide a well-thought-out acquisition plan before any campaign begins. Business Context Our offer is a done-for-you prop firm passing service targeted toward aspiring traders and individuals who have struggled to successfully pass prop firm evaluations on their own. We are specifically looking for a media buyer who can create a realistic launch strategy for a business starting from scratch and explain how they would progress from initial testing to a scalable acquisition system. If performance supports scaling, we are prepared to increase spend beginning in Month 2 and continue scaling in subsequent months. Why do you believe this platform is the best fit for our offer, audience, budget, and current account situation? If recommending TikTok, YouTube, Google, Meta (if available), X, or another platform, explain your reasoning. 2. Launch Strategy Please explain: Campaign structure Targeting approach Creative strategy Funnel structure Website sales vs. DMs vs. lead generation Testing methodology 3. Forecast & Performance Expectations Please provide realistic projections for: Month 1 Month 2 Month 3 Include estimated: Traffic volume Clicks Conversions Cost per result Customer acquisition cost Revenue projections ROAS assumptions Key risks and assumptions behind the forecast 4. Scaling Plan Please explain: How you would determine whether a campaign is ready to scale What KPIs you would monitor Budget increases you would recommend How strategy would evolve between Month 1, Month 2, and Month 3 5. We are specifically looking for: A recommended platform selection with supporting reasoning A launch plan tailored to our business Month 1–3 projections Budget allocation recommendations Expected KPIs and success metrics Scaling methodology Risks and assumptions behind your forecast The stronger your strategic thinking, the more likely you are to be considered. Decision Criteria We will not necessarily choose the lowest-cost media buyer. title: Email Marketing
description: We're a hospitality group running four brands: An oat-milk espresso martini beverage brand, and three restaurants in Little Italy, San Diego. We have a combined email list of tens of thousands of guests collected over the years that has never been email ed. We're building an email marketing program from the ground up and need an experienced specialist to own the execution. This is a real opportunity to take a clean slate and turn it into a high-performing revenue channel. You'll be hands-on across all four brands. What you'll do Technical setup & deliverability: Configure a dedicated sending domain, set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication, and run list cleaning and verification to remove dead and risky addresses before they hurt our sender reputation. List warm-up: Because these lists have never been email ed, you'll rebuild sender reputation the right way — starting with the most recent signups, sending in small daily batches, and ramping volume as engagement holds. No reckless blasts. Re-introduction campaign: Build and deploy a "we're finally in your inbox" re-introduction email for each brand. Goal: rebuild reputation, identify the engaged core, and set a clean baseline. Templates & design: Create on-brand, mobile-first, reusable email templates for each of the four brands. Segmentation: Segment by brand, engagement level, and behavior so the right people get the right message. Campaigns: Plan, build, and deploy ongoing campaigns — seasonal promotions, events, new menu launches, gift cards, private dining, and more. Flows & automations: Build and maintain automated flows — welcome series, birthday, win-back, and post-visit follow-ups. Loyalty: Help design and run loyalty / rewards programs that drive repeat visits. Reporting: Track open rates, click rates, and revenue, and report on what's working and what to change next. What we're looking for Proven Klaviyo experience - you've set up accounts, built flows and campaigns, and can show results. Strong deliverability knowledge - domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), list cleaning, and warming a cold or dormant list without wrecking sender reputation. Above-average results - you can point to open rates and click-through rates that beat industry benchmarks (restaurant industry averages are ~43% open / ~1.1% CTR — we want better). Email design skills - you can build clean, mobile-first templates that look on-brand, not generic. Segmentation and automation - comfortable building flows, segments, and A/B tests. Loyalty program experience - bonus if you've built or run one before. Self-starter — organized, communicative, and able to own the program with light oversight. Strong written English -  you'll be writing subject lines and email copy (or closely editing it). Nice to have Restaurant, hospitality, food & beverage, or DTC experience. Experience migrating or building a Klaviyo account from scratch. Copywriting ability. How to apply To show you actually read this post, please start your application with the word "ESPRESSO" at the top. In your application, include: A short intro about your email marketing experience and which tools you've used. Links to or screenshots of Klaviyo flows, campaigns, or templates you've built (portfolio). Your typical open rate and click-through rate, and how you achieved them. A brief description of how you would safely warm up a 40,000-person list that has never been email ed. Your weekly availability and any overlap you can offer with US Pacific time. Strong performers will get more hours and responsibility as the program grows. We're excited to find the right person - looking forward to your application!

description: A growing multi-doctor dental practice is seeking an experienced Dental Insurance & Treatment Plan Financial Coordinator to support an increasing volume of complex treatment cases. This role focuses on preparing the financial and insurance components of dentist-approved treatment plans, ensuring patients receive accurate cost estimates and helping the practice improve treatment acceptance. This is a specialized dental support position and is not a general virtual assistant, front desk, scheduling, or basic billing role. Candidates must have hands-on experience with dental insurance verification, benefit interpretation, treatment plan financials, patient cost estimation, and prior authorizations. Scope and Boundaries The Dental Insurance & Treatment Plan Financial Coordinator is responsible for building the financial and insurance package associated with a treatment plan after it has been created and approved by the dentist. The coordinator does not diagnose, create, modify, or make clinical decisions regarding treatment plans. Their role is to accurately determine insurance coverage, estimate patient responsibility, identify non-covered services, and prepare documentation needed for financial consultations and treatment approval. Core Responsibilities Take dentist-approved treatment plans and create the corresponding financial and insurance package Verify patient insurance benefits Interpret coverage percentages and code-level coverage by plan Identify which procedure codes are typically covered versus not covered Flag non-covered services so the practice can bill its UCR (usual, customary, and reasonable) rate Estimate the insurance-covered portion versus the patient’s out-of-pocket cost Handle prior authorizations required before procedures Prepare the materials the practice uses for the financial consultation with the patient Support consistency and speed in getting patients back in for financial consults Procedure Knowledge The practice performs a range of complex cases the coordinator should be comfortable working with, including cosmetic dentistry, fixed and overdentures, dental implants, oral surgery, sleep apnea treatment, and neuromodulator treatment for TMJ. Presentation of Treatment Plans The primary responsibility of this role is to prepare complete financial and insurance packages for dentist-approved treatment plans. In most cases, these materials will be provided to the in-office team, who will conduct the financial consultation with the patient. Depending on the practice's workflow and the candidate's experience, there may be opportunities to assist with remote patient consultations, including reviewing treatment costs, insurance coverage, and available financing options. Final responsibilities regarding direct patient presentations will be determined by the practice prior to placement. Requirements Required Skills and Experience Working knowledge of dental insurance: codes, benefit structures, coverage percentages, and non-covered service handling Experience with dental treatment plan financials and patient cost estimation Familiarity with prior authorization processes Comfort working within a practice management system (Open Dental experience a plus) Strong accuracy and attention to detail in financial estimation Clear communication for coordinating with the in-office team Ability to work remotely and independently while protecting PHI To apply, please fill out this form: ----------

description: About the role: I run the personal-brand website of an international keynote speaker (TV-featured, Top 1% / CSP). The site is built on Craft CMS with the SEOmatic plugin, runs in 3 languages (DE / EN / ES), and has roughly 180 pages, including programmatic "keynote speaker in [city]" location pages. I have solid SEO knowledge myself and built parts of this. I'm not looking for a beginner to learn on my site - I'm looking for an expert to take the wheel strategically and operationally. The core problem (be honest with me about this) Many of my programmatic location pages are stuck on "Crawled — currently not indexed" in Google Search Console. Organic traffic and, more importantly, inquiries dropped significantly. My priority is clear: get my existing location pages indexed again and found at scale - both in classic SERPs and in GEO/AIO (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Right now these pages are ~90% identical to each other (same testimonials, logos, stats, FAQ - only the city name and one paragraph change), which I suspect is why Google won't index them. I need someone who can fix that root cause and make these pages genuinely indexable and findable - not just polish thin pages. What you'll do: Diagnose the indexing problem and give me a prioritized 30-day plan. Get my existing location pages re-indexed and ranking at scale by making them genuinely differentiated - or recommend consolidation/pruning where it's the right call. I want your honest opinion, even if it contradicts me. Fix technical SEO: indexing, crawl efficiency, internal linking, hreflang / international SEO across DE/EN/ES, structured data. Strengthen the personal-brand entity for both classic SEO and GEO/AIO (getting recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews): entity/schema, off-site footprint, reviews, directories, press. Implement the work yourself (in Craft) and surprise me with new GEO/AIO ideas to future-proof the site. Must-have (non-negotiable): Verifiable track record getting programmatic / location-page sets indexed AND ranking - with real URLs and GSC/GA screenshots, not claims. Strong technical SEO: indexing diagnostics, crawl budget, hreflang, schema/entity. Active, demonstrable experimentation with GEO/AIO (AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT visibility). Willingness to prune, consolidate, and challenge my strategy when the data says so. Fluent written English. Nice-to-have Experience with Craft CMS / SEOmatic (or comfort working in an unfamiliar CMS). Multilingual SEO (DE/ES a plus). Personal-brand / local-service or expert-website experience. You're NOT a fit if: Your plan is "write more pages" or "spin up better templates" without solving the thin-content/duplication root cause. Your growth playbook is mostly link buying. Your "case studies" are screenshots you can't tie to a live, verifiable URL. How to apply (read carefully - this is the filter): Start your message with the word CRAWL-BUDGET so I know you read this. Send 2 verifiable case studies: live URLs of location/programmatic page sets you built, plus GSC or GA screenshots showing indexing/traffic improvement. Answer these three short questions (3–4 sentences each): - Most of my city pages are "crawled, currently not indexed," and I haven't spoken in many of these cities yet. What's your honest first hypothesis and your approach? - Under what circumstances would you tell me to delete or merge pages instead of optimizing them? - How would you get an AI engine (ChatGPT / Perplexity / Google AI Overviews) to recommend a keynote speaker - which signals off the website matter most? Engagement: Part-time, ongoing. We start with a paid audit + prioritized 30-day plan (fixed scope) so we both see how you work before committing long-term. Please include your part-time rate and your availability per week. I read every application that follows the steps above. Generic copy-paste pitches will be ignored.
