title: Video Editor - Content Creator Support
description: Entrelingo Group is an Australian company operating across NAATI-certified translation, migration, skills assessments, and recruitment. We're building a content operation to grow our brand and we need an editor who turns raw footage into scroll-stopping, publish-ready content — fast and consistently. THE ROLE We record. You deliver. Raw footage comes from our founder and team. Your job: transform it into clean, high-impact content for Instagram and YouTube. Content is a core growth channel — we treat it that way. SCOPE OF WORK (monthly) - At least 45 short-form reels (Instagram / Shorts, under 60 seconds) - 4–6 long-form YouTube videos All content is in Spanish. You don't need to speak Spanish, but you must be comfortable working with it — syncing captions, cutting silences, following audio rhythm in a language that may not be your own. WHAT EACH DELIVERY LOOKS LIKE This is the standard we hold every video to — no exceptions: - Hook in the first 2–3 seconds that stops the scroll - Zero dead air — silences, filler words, and pauses are cut without mercy - Tight pacing — every second earns its place, nothing coasts - Smooth, intentional transitions — not template transitions, not random cuts - Motion graphics and text animation that feel native to the platform - Music selected to match the emotional tone of the content — not background noise - Sound effects (SFX) layered deliberately and with purpose — they elevate the video, not decorate it - Audio mastered correctly — vocals clear, music and SFX balanced, no clipping, no dead frequencies - Color grading that looks intentional and professional, not filtered - Accurate captions — styled, on-brand, and timed precisely - Thumbnail creation for YouTube that earns the click - Vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) versions delivered when required - Files named, organized, and delivered in the correct specs for each platform REQUIRED TOOLS You must have strong working knowledge of the following. We'll ask about your workflow with each one. Editing: - Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve — advanced level, not intermediate - Adobe After Effects or CapCut Pro for motion graphics and text animation - Descript for transcript-based editing and silence removal Audio: - Adobe Audition or equivalent for audio cleanup and mastering - Epidemic Sound, Artlist, or Musicbed for licensed music - Soundsnap, Zapsplat, or equivalent SFX library — sound effects are not optional in our content - Splice or similar for custom audio assets Captions and subtitles: - Descript, CapCut, Rev, or equivalent — accuracy and visual style both matter Review and delivery: - ---------- or equivalent for feedback and version control Additional: - Canva Pro for YouTube thumbnails - Topaz Video AI or equivalent for footage enhancement when needed - Familiarity with AI-assisted tools (Runway ML, Pika, or similar) is a strong plus - Notion or Airtable for tracking deliverables WHAT WE CARE ABOUT Experience level matters less than output quality. One year of experience with exceptional edits beats five years of average work. What we cannot compromise on is craft — pacing, sound design, and the ability to make a talking-head video feel alive. What we need to see: - A portfolio with real examples — reels, talking-head content, or brand videos. No portfolio = no review, no exceptions. - Proof you've edited for a real brand or creator (not just personal projects) - Videos where the sound design is clearly intentional — music, SFX, and audio balance working together - Someone who flags problems AND proposes solutions without being asked SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted candidates receive a test edit (no payment for the test), real raw footage from our team, in Spanish. title: Youtube Post-Production Manager
description: This Is a YouTube-First Role This is not a traditional post-production manager role. We are specifically looking for someone with deep experience in YouTube-native content, where success is driven by pacing, retention, iteration speed, and audience engagement, not traditional film, TV, or broadcast workflows. If your background is primarily in film, television, or commercial post-production with long timelines or on-set focused processes, this role will not be a good fit. If you’ve worked closely with creators, managed YouTube editors, shipped content weekly, and think about edits through a performance and viewer-retention lens, you’re exactly who we’re looking for. Who We Are: Five years ago, Dragonfruit set out to bring together some of the most talented visual storytellers, viral video strategists, and big-name clients, to change the way we create and consume on YouTube.The result has been bigger than we could have imagined, having generated billions of organic views and hundreds of millions of subscribers for creators like MrBeast, Ali Abdaal, Chris Williamson, Codie Sanchez, Neil Patel and orgs like Y Combinator, e.l.f beauty, WHOOP, ClickUp, Linktree, Center for Humane Technology & more. Unlike other social media agencies or YouTube businesses, Dragonfruit refuses to celebrate a “creator economy” that trades viewers’ time and attention for rapid-fire dopamine entertainment. Instead, we are leading a global movement to make YouTube a more valuable and educational place for all people; where views and subscribers are never an end in and of themselves, but rather a means of increasing human flourishing; where viral-educational YouTube channels not only bolster awareness and impact for our client's brands, but also create genuine value in viewers’ lives. The Role: As a Post-Production Manager at Dragonfruit, you’ll sit at the operational center of some of the most influential YouTube channels in the world — ensuring that hundreds of videos each month move smoothly from edit to delivery without sacrificing quality, speed, or storytelling impact. You’ll oversee the end-to-end post-production process across multiple client accounts, coordinating with editors, creative directors, and producers to make sure timelines are met, files are organized, and every piece of content leaving the studio reflects Dragonfruit’s standards of excellence. You’re not just tracking edits — you’re architecting the systems that make world-class content possible at scale. You’ll identify workflow inefficiencies, establish clear SOPs, enforce QC standards, and act as the connective tissue between creative and operations. Success in this role means becoming the person everyone relies on to keep post-production running at peak performance — calm under pressure, obsessed with detail, and relentless about shipping great work on time. Skills and Qualifications: 3+ years of experience specifically in YouTube content production within an agency, production company, or YouTube-focused environment Proven experience editing high-performing YouTube long forms Proven experience reviewing and improving other editors’ work — with the ability to give clear, actionable, and constructive feedback Proven ability to manage large-scale, multi-client pipelines, overseeing 300+ assets in various stages of post-production simultaneously. Deep understanding of the creative workflow — from ingest and assembly through QC, revision management, and final delivery. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Premiere Pro and After Effects) and familiarity with collaborative tools like ---------- , ClickUp, Notion, or similar project-management platforms. Strong organizational and systems-thinking mindset — able to spot process bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions. Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain high quality standards under tight deadlines. Experience leading and mentoring editors teams, setting clear expectations, and managing bandwidth. Expert communicator and problem solver with strong interpersonal skills Bonus: familiarity with YouTube analytics, retention data, and how editing choices affect performance. What you can expect: An exciting creative startup culture – operate cross-functionally, wear several hats, and occasionally work long hours, during evenings, and/or weekends. We are a hungry and ambitious group of people trying to accomplish something large and challenging and we’re looking for folks who are enthusiastic and willing to do what is required to reach their goals. Personal growth – use Dragonfruit’s culture of excellence as an incubator to improve your professional skills, learn new mental models, sharpen your critical thinking, and operate at the forefront of new media. Be a key player in a fast-growing company – help take the company from 40 employees to 100+, identifying blind spots in our service offering and working collaboratively with leadership to improve systems/processes. Earn more – take advantage of regular performance-based raises, generous referral and sales commissions, & more. Perks: Work from anywhere (we're 100% remote) Competitive Healthcare Coverage (medical, dental, vision) Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements Unlimited reimbursements on book purchases (we like to read ) Paid volunteering: 1 day dedicated to supporting a cause of your choice Work directly with some of the largest creators/brands on the planet Work for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, apply now!

title: HR Generalist
description: The HR Generalist is responsible for the accurate, day-to-day administration of the company’s human resources functions, with particular emphasis on payroll integrity, benefits administration, compliance, and employee lifecycle support. This is a full-time, dedicated role requiring consistent availability, meticulous attention to detail, and ownership of recurring audits and reconciliations. The HR Generalist serves as a reliable point of contact for employees and management and ensures that all HR processes are executed completely, accurately, and on schedule. ----- ## Essential Duties and Responsibilities ### Payroll & Paychex Administration - Process and review full-cycle payroll through Paychex, ensuring accuracy of hours, rates, deductions, and tax withholdings each cycle. - Conduct thorough, documented audits of Paychex data on a defined schedule (e.g., each pay period and monthly), reconciling discrepancies before payroll is finalized. - Maintain accurate employee records in Paychex, including new hires, terminations, status changes, and compensation updates. - Generate and review payroll reports, flagging anomalies and resolving issues proactively. - Ensure payroll-related compliance filings and records are complete and submitted on time. ### Benefits Administration - Administer employee benefits programs, including enrollments, changes, and terminations. - Reconcile benefits invoices against enrollment records and resolve billing discrepancies. - Serve as a resource for employee benefits questions. ### Compliance & Recordkeeping - Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential employee files and HR documentation. - Support compliance with applicable labor laws and internal policies. - Assist in preparing for and responding to audits, ensuring documentation is accurate and readily available. ### Employee Lifecycle Support - Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring all steps are completed and documented. - Support recruitment activities as needed, including job postings, scheduling, and candidate communication. - Respond to employee inquiries promptly and professionally. ### Reporting & Accountability - Track and report on assigned HR metrics and deliverables. - Provide regular status updates to the supervisor and maintain transparent records of completed work. - Meet established deadlines and quality standards consistently. ----- ## Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, **or** equivalent combination of education and experience. - description: Overview We are a custom cabinetry shop in Nashville, Tennessee. We take released architectural plan sets and produce the interior cabinet elevations that those sets do not include. The work On a typical project we hand you a complete architectural set with floor plans, power plans, elevations, and sections. The set will not contain cabinet elevations. That is what you create. Clean drafting discipline. Every elevation carries cabinet widths and heights, toe kick, counter height, upper cabinet heights, crown and light rail where they occur, appliance and fixture openings, and overall wall dimensions. The judgment to flag a missing or conflicting dimension in a note rather than guessing. We would rather answer a question than correct a wrong assumption. Comfort applying revisions we specify, such as adjusting a cabinet width or a clearance, and confirming those changes on the drawing. Deliverables on every project Dimensioned interior cabinet elevations for all cabinet areas in the set, delivered as both an editable CAD file and a PDF. description: Job Title: Media Buyer (Google Ads) — Work on High-Spend, High-Impact Campaigns Location: Philippines — Remote Salary: 30,000 – 40,000 PHP / month Type: Full-time Experience: Minimum 1 year in Google Ads or paid media About AdCeptive Media/ AdCeptive Media is a Dubai-based performance marketing company. We run paid campaigns for global eCommerce and lead generation clients — real budgets, real CPA targets, real accountability. We hire slowly, pay fairly, and give people who execute ownership of their work. The Role:- We need a Google Ads Media Buyer who can take a campaign brief and run with it. You will launch, manage, and optimize Search, Display, and Call-Only campaigns for lead generation clients. You will work under direct supervision following our campaign SOPs. You are not expected to independently own a new vertical from day one. You are expected to follow a framework, hit KPI targets, and flag problems before they become expensive. If you need hand-holding on every decision, are comfortable with vague campaign briefs, or cannot explain why a CPA spiked — this role is not for you. What You Will Do:- • Launch and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, and Call-Only with proper structure and conversion tracking from day one • Hit CPL and CPA targets — not just manage campaigns, but optimize them down • Conduct keyword research, write ad copy variants, and run A/B tests on creatives, bids, and landing page hypotheses • Set up and verify conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and CAPI before any campaign goes live • Submit weekly performance reports with diagnosis and next actions — not just numbers • Identify scaling opportunities on accounts hitting targets and flag deterioration on those that aren't • Collaborate with landing page and creative teams to improve funnel conversion rates • Join client calls and internal reviews; communicate professionally across time zones Must-Have Skills:- • Minimum 1 year managing Google Ads campaigns (lead generation experience preferred) • Solid understanding of Search campaign structure: match types, bid strategies, Quality Score, ad groups, negative keywords • Can explain CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and CPC fro ---------- mory — and knows which metric matters most for which campaign type • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for conversion setup • Has run A/B tests and can explain what was tested, what happened, and why • Strong written and spoken English • Can work independently in a remote, async environment across time zones Nice to Have:- • YouTube Ads experience • Pay-per-call campaign exposure • Experience with call tracking tools (CallRail, WhatConverts, Redtrack,Ringba etc.) • Basic understanding of landing page optimization and funnel structure What We Expect in Your First 90 Days:- Day 1: Complete tool access setup, review one campaign and submit written observations to your manager by end of day, read and sign off on our Google Ads SOP. First 30 days: Launch at least one campaign with full conversion tracking. Deliver weekly reports with specific optimizations taken. Bring one existing campaign's CPL down by a measurable amount — or write a clear diagnosis of what's blocking it. First 90 days: Fully own your assigned accounts with minimal check-ins. Hit or beat target CPL/CPA on at least two accounts. Submit one scaling proposal for a high-performing account. Build a testing framework for at least one account. Our Hiring Process:- We run a structured process. Missing any requirement at any stage is an automatic rejection — not to be harsh, but because following instructions is the core skill this role demands. 1. Application review — compliance and experience check 2. Structured survey — technical skills, work ethic, self-management (40–45 min, no AI tools) 3. Paid trial task — a real campaign audit with a written plan and a Loom walkthrough 4. Culture interview — 45 min with the Hiring Lead, including a live walkthrough of your trial 5. Founder interview — 30 min, final call and offer discussion The trial is paid. It takes 4–8 hours of real work. You will receive a simplified version of our Google Ads SOP before you start and your plan must follow it. HOW TO APPLY:- Email your application to: ---------- Subject line — exact format, no variation: FirstName-LastName-GoogleAdsMediaBuyer-Philippines (Example: Maria-Santos-GoogleAds MediaBuyer-Philippines) Your email must include all of the following — missing any single item = no reply:- 1. CV / résumé as a single PDF:- 2. Google Ads portfolio link or samples (live accounts, case studies, or anonymized screenshots with results) 3. A plain-text two-paragraph answer written directly in the email body: describe the single best result you have produced in a Google Ads campaign and exactly how you produced it 4. Your current monthly compensation in USD equivalent and your available start date 5. A photo of your workspace 6. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload

title: Estimator Assistant - Client Coordinator – Chimney, Masonry - Remodeling
job_title: Estimator Assistant - Client Coordinator – Chimney, Masonry - Remodeling
description: About the Company We are a construction company specializing in chimney rebuilds, masonry work, Roofing, and home remodeling. We work with homeowners and contractors to deliver high-quality results, and we are growing fast. We are looking for a sharp, reliable, and proactive Virtual Coordinator to become a key part of our team About the Role This is a dynamic, multi-tasking role — not just estimating. You will be the backbone of our operations: handling estimates, communicating with clients, coordinating field crews, tracking projects, and keeping everything organized. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love having variety in your work, this role is for you. We will train you on our estimating software (Houzz Pro). What we cannot train is attitude, organization, and work ethic — those must already be yours. Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities Prepare and send accurate project estimates for chimney, masonry, and remodeling work Send estimates to clients with a professional and personalized cover message Follow up with clients who have not responded — by email and phone Coordinate job schedules with field crews and ensure smooth communication between office and teams Maintain a detailed client pipeline in Google Sheets: leads, estimates, won, lost, pending Research materials and products online — find best prices, links, and delivery times for the purchasing team Organize all client records and project documentation Deliver a clear weekly report every Friday: estimates sent, jobs won, jobs lost, follow-ups pending Handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize without losing attention to detail Be proactive — flag issues, suggest improvements, and take initiative without being asked Requirements The following are non-negotiable: Fluent English — written and spoken. All client communication is in English Experience in construction estimating (chimney, masonry, remodeling, or similar) Advanced Google Sheets — you must be comfortable building and managing spreadsheets Strong professional email writing and client follow-up skills Excellent coordination and organizational skills Stable, reliable internet connection — this is a remote role and connectivity is critical Backup internet option in case of outages (highly recommended) Available during US business hours (Eastern ) Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities at once Team Player Nice to Have Spanish language skills are a plus — the owner is bilingual (English/Spanish) Experience with Houzz Pro, Jobber, Buildertrend, or similar construction software Background in construction sales, project coordination, or customer service Experience using CRM tools to manage client pipelines What We Offer • Long-term freelance contract opportunity with a growing construction company • Independent contractor relationship (freelance services agreement) • Remote work — services performed from your home office • Competitive compensation based on experience, skills, and services provided • Opportunity for long-term collaboration based on performance and business needs Training on all our tools and systems — Clear expectations and direct communication Starting salary: $3–$5 USD/hour (full-time), based on experience and skills. All contractors begin with a paid trial period of one (1) to two (2) weeks, depending on the mutual agreement reached between both parties. This trial period allows both parties to evaluate compatibility, performance, communication, and overall fit before entering into a long-term freelance agreement. Compensation for the trial period will be discussed and agreed upon during the interview process.. How to Apply We receive many applications. To be considered, you MUST answer all 3 questions below. Applications without answers will not be reviewed — no exceptions. Do you have experience estimating construction projects such as chimneys, masonry, or remodeling? Describe one specific project — what was the scope and approximate value? Have you used Houzz Pro, Jobber, Buildertrend, or any other estimating or construction management software? If yes, describe how you used it. If no, tell us what software you have used for similar tasks. A client named John Smith received a ,500 chimney rebuild estimate from you 5 days ago. He has not responded to your email or voi cemail . Write the follow-up email you would send him today. Tip: We read every answer carefully. Be specific, be honest, and let your English and professionalism speak for itself. Generic answers will not move forward. We look forward to finding the right person to grow with us.

description: We are a Germany-based company working in the electricity and gas contract sector. We help customers in Germany with the processing, preparation, and support of energy contract documents. We already work successfully with several international remote tea ---------- mbers who have been part of our company for years. We are now looking to expand our team and hire an experienced Recruiter / Talent Sourcer who can help us find reliable German-speaking employees for long-term remote work. Job Description We are looking for a proactive Recruiter / Talent Sourcer who has experience finding and approaching qualified German-speaking candidates on platforms such as Upwork, Indeed, or similar recruiting channels. Your main task will be to actively search for suitable applicants, contact them, pre-qualify them, and help us build a reliable pipeline of candidates for our company. This position is only suitable for someone who already understands the recruiting process and knows how to find, approach, and evaluate candidates professionally. Main Tasks Search for German-speaking candidates on Upwork, Indeed, and other suitable platforms Proactively contact potential applicants Pre-qualify candidates based on our requirements Collect and organize candidate information Forward suitable applicants to our internal team Track your recruiting activities and results Report daily or weekly key performance numbers Follow our internal recruiting process Help us improve the recruiting workflow over time Expected KPIs We expect clear and measurable recruiting results. You should be able to track and report numbers such as: Number of candidates contacted Number of replies received Number of qualified candidates found Number of candidates forwarded to us Number of candidates who complete the next application steps Conversion rates from contact to qualified applicant Please only apply if you are comfortable working with clear performance expectations and measurable recruiting goals. Requirements We are looking for someone who is proactive, structured, and experienced in recruiting. You should have: Previous experience as a Recruiter or Talent Sourcer Experience searching for candidates on Upwork, Indeed, or similar platforms Experience finding German-speaking candidates Good English communication skills Understanding of candidate pre-qualification Ability to work independently and proactively Organized working style Reliable communication Experience with spreadsheets, tracking tools, or CRM systems Stable internet connection Own computer or laptop Availability to start soon German language skills are a plus, but not required if you are experienced in sourcing German-speaking candidates. What We Offer Long-term remote work Clear recruiting requirements Structured internal processes Support from our Germany-based company Opportunity to grow with us Long-term cooperation if results are strong Clear communication and measurable goals A company that already works successfully with remote international tea ---------- mbers Application Process Please send us a short application including: A short introduction about yourself Your previous recruiting experience Your experience with Upwork, Indeed, or similar platforms Your experience finding German-speaking candidates Which platforms you would use to find applicants How you would approach suitable candidates How quickly you think you can find the first qualified applicants Which tools, information, or access you would need from us Your expected hourly rate or salary expectation Your availability When you can start Please also answer the following questions in your application: How would you search for German-speaking candidates for our company? Which platforms would you use first and why? How many candidates could you realistically contact per day? How long would it take you to find the first qualified applicants? What information or tools would you need from us to start? How would you track and report your recruiting results? When would you be available to start? After your first application, we will review your answers and check whether your recruiting approach fits our requirements. If your experience and strategy match what we are looking for, we will continue with a short interview and discuss a possible long-term cooperation.

job_title: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director
salary_detail: Salary: $700 to $920 USD per month, depe
description: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director Helping Organise and Support a Multi-Award-Winning Medi-Spa Location: Remote Job Type: Full-Time Location Requirement: Philippines-based Salary: $700 to $920 USD per month, depending on experience Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Philippines time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break Benefits: 13th month pay, salary reviews, progression, performance bonuses, discounts on products we stock and 15 days’ paid leave inclusive of public holidays About Us Perfection is a high-end, multi-award-winning medi-spa in the Wiltshire countryside, specialising in laser hair removal, advanced skin treatments, aesthetics, electrolysis and wellbeing. We are a team of 13 with a strong reputation for exceptional client care, high standards and a peaceful, luxurious experience. Our purpose is simple: to help people look and feel amazing, while giving them precious time to switch off and focus on themselves. We are now on an exciting journey to grow Perfection, with a stronger focus on laser hair removal, advanced skin treatments, aesthetics and results-led services. Our team are at the heart of our business. We care deeply about our values, our standards, our clients and the way we treat each other. We believe in being honest, kind, proactive, responsible and proud of the work we do. We are professional, but we are also warm, supportive and human. Details matter here, and so does genuine care. About Me Hi, I’m Michelle, the founder of Perfection. I am creative, passionate, honest, caring and very driven. I love growing the business, improving things and building something special. I am also very open about having severe ADHD, because it affects how I work. My mind moves quickly, I have lots of ideas, and I often see opportunities before they have been fully organised into a plan. One minute we may be planning a laser event, the next we are reviewing KPIs, sorting payroll, improving the client journey or looking at a better way to run the business. I do not need someone who simply waits for instructions. I need someone who can help organise my thinking, protect my time, follow things through and help me turn ideas into completed projects. The Role This is not a basic admin role. I am looking for an exceptional Founder’s Executive Assistant to become my right-hand person. The purpose of this role is simple: to make life easier for Michelle, keep the business organised and help important things get completed. I want someone who will tell me what they need in order to do a good job, ask for clarity when needed, and take pressure off me rather than adding to it. You will support me across diary management, business administration, personal organisation, reporting, team follow-up, systems, SOPs, client journey tasks and general business operations. Your overall mission is to help me spend more time growing the business, leading the team and focusing on the work only I can do. The words I love to hear are: “Don’t worry, I’ve already sorted it.” Or: “I spotted a problem. Here’s what I’ve already done, and here’s what I recommend.” Key Responsibilities Executive Support and Diary Management • Plan my day, week and month. • Prepare my daily schedule and keep me on track. • Protect my diary, energy and focused business time. • Organise meetings, appointments and reminders. • Prepare me properly before meetings. • Turn voice notes, messages and ideas into clear actions. • Research things for me when needed. • Help me prioritise what matters most. • Gently help me stay focused when there are lots of ideas competing for attention. Communication and Follow-Up • Help organise and manage my inbox. • Draft email s, replies, documents and updates. • Summarise meetings and turn them into action lists. • Communicate with the team on my behalf when needed. • Follow up actions politely but persistently until they are completed. • Make and receive business or personal calls when needed. • Keep communication clear, calm and professional. I am not looking for someone who thinks a task is complete because they sent an email . I am looking for someone who makes sure the task actually gets completed. Personal Assistance This role includes personal assistant support as well as business support. This may include booking appointments, ordering groceries or household items, keeping track of birthdays, booking travel, organising reminders and helping with personal admin. This part of the role requires trust, discretion, common sense and kindness. Data, Reporting and Administration You do not need to be an accountant or payroll expert, but you must be confident with spreadsheets, data, accuracy and detail. Responsibilities may include: • Organising information clearly into spreadsheets and reports. • Helping track business costs, supplier spending and receipts. • Preparing simple summaries for review. • Helping monitor key business dates, including VAT, PAYE and supplier payments. • Supporting weekly and monthly reviews by keeping information tidy, accurate and easy to understand. • Collecting and organising staff hours, holiday, sickness and training information. • Preparing weekly KPI reports. • Tracking therapist turnover, retail sales, treatment course sales, consultation outcomes and client enquiries. • Using AI and software tools to help organise information, improve spreadsheets and make admin more efficient. Client Journey, Team Accountability and Systems A big part of this role is making sure important things do not quietly disappear. You will help me remember, check and follow up on things such as: • Client enquiries and follow-up actions. • Consultation records. • Where enquiries and clients have come from. • Clients who may have fallen off or not returned. • Team actions. • Stock checks. • Training records. • Standards checks. • Marketing deadlines. • Supplier information. • SOPs, checklists and important business dates. You will also help build and maintain our team intranet, organise key documents and create simple systems that save time. This needs someone calm, polite, persistent and confident with follow-up. Systems and Technology You will need to be confident using technology and willing to learn new systems. Experience with tools such as Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Replit, Canva, Phorest, Loom, Trello, ChatGPT or Claude is helpful, but not essential. CRM or GoHighLevel experience is a bonus. What matters most is that you are organised, quick to learn, competent using AI, confident making spreadsheets and able to use tools sensibly to make work easier, clearer and more efficient. What Success Looks Like After 12 Months • My week is planned before Monday starts. • I know exactly what to focus on each day. • My inbox is organised. • Nothing important gets forgotten. • Projects actually get finished. • Staff actions are followed up. • Reports and spreadsheets are organised and useful. • Meetings are prepared properly. • SOPs and systems are easy to find and use. • The business feels calmer and more organised. • I spend more time growing the business and less time chasing loose ends. title: Technical SEO Developer
description: About the Role We are seeking a skilled Technical SEO Developer to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between development and SEO strategy — auditing websites, resolving technical issues, and collaborating cross-functionally to improve organic search performance. You will work closely with our content team and bring hands-on platform experience to deliver measurable results. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits to identify crawlability, indexability, and performance issues. Diagnose and resolve technical issues including broken links, redirect chains, duplicate content, canonicalization errors, and structured data problems. Implement and monitor structured data (schema markup) and validate with Google Rich Results Test. Analyze and improve Core Web Vitals and overall page speed using Google PageSpeed Insights. Monitor website health and search performance through Google Search Console; surface insights and take corrective action. Partner with the content team to provide SEO guidance on content structure, internal linking, and on-page optimization. Perform crawl-based analysis using Screaming Frog to identify site-wide technical issues at scale. Develop and maintain SEO best practices documentation for use across technical and content teams. Stay current with Google algorithm updates, Core Web Vitals benchmarks, and evolving technical SEO standards. Required Qualifications Proven experience in technical SEO, with a strong understanding of how search engine crawling, indexing, and ranking work. Proficiency with one or more CMS platforms: WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, and/or Drupal. Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Rich Results Test, Screaming Frog, and Google PageSpeed Insights. Solid front-end development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) with the ability to implement technical fixes directly. Ability to interpret SEO data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with log file analysis and server-side SEO diagnostics. Familiarity with JavaScript SEO and rendering frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js). Knowledge of XML sitemaps, robots.txt optimization, and hreflang implementation. Experience using additional SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz. What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate is equal parts developer and SEO strategist — someone who can get into the code to fix issues but also communicate clearly with writers and marketers about how content decisions affect search performance. You are detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable owning projects from audit through implementation.

You earn your guaranteed $3.00/hour base, plus a bonus for every real estate deal you place and process to closed-and-funded status. Bigger deals pay bigger bonuses — the larger the loan you help fund, the larger your bonus. Per-deal bonus ladder (paid when the deal closes, funds, and our fee is collected): Under $100K funded: $15 $100K to $250K: $30 $250K to $500K: $50 $500K to $1M: $75 $1M and above: $150 Consistent funders earn a strong monthly bonus on top of base. title: Appointment Setter (Clear US Accent Required): Warm Bathroom Remodeling Leads: Extremely High Earning Potential
job_title: Appointment Setter (Clear US Accent Required): Warm Bathroom Remodeling Leads: Extremely High Earning Potential
description: We run ads for bathroom remodeling companies across the US. Leads click our ad, get fully qualified, and are told someone will call them. Your job is to call them fast, run a short script, and book them on our client's calendar. That's it. These are warm leads. They just raised their hand and they're expecting your call. You are not cold calling anyone. We're looking for a killer. Someone who shows up to dominate, hits the phone hard, and wants to book as many appointments as possible because every booking is more money in your pocket. If you're the type who's happy doing the bare minimum, this isn't for you. If you're hungry and want to earn, keep reading. What you'll do: Watch a Slack channel during your shift for new lead notifications Call the lead within 5 minutes of the notification (speed is the whole game here) Open the right client's CRM, go to the Opportunities tab, hit call Follow the script (it's in the CRM and in Slack) Re-qualify and book the appointment on the client's GHL calendar Done The script and everything you need is provided. You are not building anything or figuring anything out. You call, follow the script, book. What we need: A clear American accent. This is non-negotiable. You're calling US homeowners and they need to feel comfortable on the phone. If there's any noticeable accent, this isn't the right role for you. Real sales or phone experience. You can hold a conversation, handle a little hesitation, and get someone on the calendar. A closer mindset. You want to win, you want the commissions, and you treat every lead like money on the table. Reliable and fast. When a lead comes in, you're on it inside 5 minutes. Good internet and a quiet place to call from. Pay: $7.50 for every appointment you book We expect a booking rate of at least 35% of the leads you call. Leads are warm and the script works, so the more you grind, the more you earn. No cap. We're starting slower, around 5 to 15 leads a day to call, and it's ramping fast. So I'm not looking for someone just to fill a seat. I need someone who is ready now, has the experience, and wants to be here a while and grow with us as the volume climbs. You'll handle leads across all our clients from one seat, so we want someone who can own it. We're hiring one person right now. To apply: Send a 60 to 90 second voice note. This is required. No voice note means you will not be considered at all, no exceptions. It's how we hear your accent and how you'd actually sound on the phone with our leads, so make it good. After the voice note, the next step is a quick 5 minute call where I'll gauge your ability. If it's a fit, we onboard you fast and get you into the flow right away. We move quick here, so if you're ready to start earning, send that voice note now.

title: Psychology Researcher E-commerce
description: Compensation: $15.00 USD / Hour + $800 USD Bonus per validated Winning Angle Job Overview: We are a rapidly scaling US-focused e-commerce brand running high-volume Meta Ads. We are not looking for a generic copywriter. We are looking for a highly analytical Consumer Psychology Specialist & Angle Hunter. Your singular objective is to dive deep into platforms like Reddit, Amazon 1-star reviews, the Meta Ads Library, YouTube, TikTok, and niche forums to extract raw, unfiltered "Voice of Customer" (VoC) data and competitive insights. Your primary goal is to discover entirely new marketing angles specifically targeting the "Unaware" and "Problem Aware" stages of the market. You will use this data to identify untapped emotional pain points and build new psychological bridges that convert cold traffic into buyers. Your Core Responsibilities: Omnichannel Market Mining: Scrape Reddit, Facebook groups, Amazon reviews, the Meta Ads Library, trending YouTube videos, and TikTok to find the exact, visceral slang, metaphors, and "Micro- ---------- nts" our target audience uses, as well as finding fresh ad concepts from outside our direct competitors. Awareness Shifting: Focus specifically on cracking the "Unaware" and "Problem Aware" audiences. You must find ways to connect with people who either don't know they have a problem yet, or know they have a problem but don't know there is a solution. Angle Architecture: Identify the "Unique Mechanism of the Problem" (UMP) and the "Unique Mechanism of the Solution" (UMS) to create entirely new approaches to selling our products. Camouflage Hook Creation: Write raw, native-feeling "Camouflage Hooks" (10-100 words) that stop the scroll on Meta because they look like genuine user posts, not sanitized advertisements. Strategic Briefing: Synthesize your research into actionable Strategic Market Briefs and fill out our internal "Creative Hit Rate Tracker" for the media buying team. Requirements & Skills: You must be obsessed with Direct Response Marketing and consumer psychology (Bonus points if you know Breakthrough Advertising by Eugene Schwartz or Great Leads). You understand that polite, sanitized marketing language fails, and raw, visceral metaphors win. You possess a high level of analytical intelligence. You don't just collect data; you recognize behavioral patterns across multiple platforms (from Reddit text to YouTube video hooks) to construct the "Goldilocks Villain" for our ad copy. Excellent, native-level US English reading and writing skills. The Compensation Structure: Base Pay: $15.00 USD per hour for your research, brief creation, and hook writing. The Scale Bonus: We reward execution. For every new core Angle you develop that successfully passes our 72-hour testing phase and scales as a "Winning Angle" in our ad account, you will receive an $800 USD cash bonus. How to Apply: To prove you have read this entire post and possess the attention to detail required for this role, start your application with the exact phrase: "The body gets the sale, the lead selects the audience." Then, provide a brief example of a "Micro- ---------- nt" hook you would write for a chronic back pain product aimed at a "Problem Aware" audience.

title: Technical Legal Writer — Patent Application Drafting (Project-Based)
job_title: Technical Legal Writer — Patent Application Drafting (Project-Based)
description: I am the inventor of a cryptographic key distribution architecture. I have two provisional patent applications filed with the USPTO (US 64/075,248 and US 64/094,316) that need to be consolidated into one non-provisional utility patent application. I am looking for a technical legal writer to draft the full application. A U.S. patent agent will review your work before filing — your job is to produce a high-quality first draft that minimizes the agent's revision time. The Work: Draft the full specification (background, summary, detailed description, embodiments) Draft initial claims (independent and dependent) Create drawing/figure descriptions Consolidate two provisional applications into one cohesive non-provisional Ensure consistency with USPTO formatting requirements Reference the existing provisional applications for priority claims Materials Provided (after NDA is signed): Both provisional applications (full text) Technical whitepaper explaining the architecture Working demo code (Python) Live interactive demo Direct access to me for questions and clarifications Requirements: Experience drafting patent applications (specifications and claims) Strong technical writing skills — precise, detailed, unambiguous language Familiarity with USPTO utility patent format and requirements Ability to understand and describe cryptographic/computer science concepts Attention to detail — patents require exactness Available to start immediately and complete within 2-3 weeks Payment Structure: Fixed-price project: $250–$500 depending on experience and qualifications. Payment in milestones — no upfront payment: 25?ter outline + first section delivery 25?ter full specification draft delivery 25?ter claims + drawings delivery 25?ter U.S. patent agent review Milestone Policy: Each milestone is a quality checkpoint. If the work doesn't meet expectations at any milestone, we'll discuss revisions first (up to 2 rounds included per milestone). If the work still doesn't meet standards after revisions, either party can end the project. You'll be paid for all completed and approved milestones up to that point. Quality Bonus: After my U.S. patent agent reviews your draft, you will receive a bonus based on how much revision the agent needs to make: Minimal changes (under 10% rewritten): 50% bonus on total project price Moderate changes (10-25% rewritten): 25% bonus on total project price Major rewrite needed (over 25% rewritten): No bonus Example: If your project price is $400 and the agent says the draft is clean with minimal changes, you receive a $200 bonus — total $600. Important Terms: This is a work-for-hire arrangement. All work product is owned by me (Olmec Technologies LLC). NDA required before any materials are shared. 20 hours per week availability expected. About the Invention: The invention is a cryptographic key distribution architecture that eliminates stored keys by deriving at least one key component from the physical environment of the authorized device. Even if an attacker steals every stored component, the key cannot be reconstructed without physical access to the authorized device's environment. The architecture is algorithm-agnostic and works with any symmetric cipher. To Apply: Please include: Your experience with patent application drafting (specific examples if possible) Your familiarity with software, cryptography, or computer science patents Your availability and estimated timeline for this project Your expected project price within the $250–$500 range A brief writing sample (technical or legal writing preferred) Skills Required: Legal Technical Writing Intellectual Property

title: Finance and Administration Coordinator
description: About Us: We are a high-end beauty, laser, aesthetics, and skin clinic dedicated to providing exceptional service to our clients. We are seeking a motivated, highly organised, and detail-oriented Finance and Administration Coordinator to join our team and help streamline our operations.  Ideally full time, however we would consider part-time for the right candidate. Key Responsibilities: 1. Financial Management: o Compile fixed costs from bank statements into a comprehensive spreadsheet. o Provide a detailed breakdown of variable costs, including Amazon expenditures. o Organise and collect receipts, ensuring they are saved in monthly folders for easy access. o Prepare and submit organised receipts to Dext for bookkeeping purposes. o Assess business finances, establish budgets for operational tasks (including wages), and control expenditure. o Review finances weekly and monthly, providing insights on potential revenue growth and new revenue streams. o Conduct weekly check-ins with the Director and send a daily email summarising your activities and achievements. 2. Payroll Administration: o Collect payroll hours from employees and summarise them in an accessible format. o Track hours worked, including holiday, sick leave, and training hours, maintaining records in a spreadsheet. 3. Sales Reporting: o Generate detailed reports on retail sales, including items sold, selling prices, the employee responsible, and customer information. o Document treatment courses sold with similar detail. o Create monthly reports on our top spenders, focusing on the top 40 clients. o Identify and report clients who have not visited in the last six weeks to address potential fall-offs. 4. Performance Metrics: o Maintain records of each therapist's turnover and retail sales (products). o Produce reports to set targets and assess monthly business contributions. o Conduct annual competitor analysis to inform strategy. 5. Staff Management: o Organise and maintain staff contracts and personal information in an easily accessible format. o Ensure training agreements are sent out for signing and saved in personal folders. o Encourage therapists to book courses and hold them accountable by asking for updates in Microsoft Teams. o Remind therapists to collect before-and-after pictures from clients during consultations and ensure they are uploaded into the Phorest Booking System. 7. Communication: o Provide daily updates to the social media manager regarding clinic availability. o Send daily messages to the therapists and front-of-house team on Microsoft Teams to update them with figures and targets, encouraging them to achieve their goals. o Ensure suppliers’ price lists, contact details, and the price list of Perfection are all up to date and available in Microsoft Teams. o Conduct a weekly Zoom call between 9 AM and 11 AM GMT to discuss progress, challenges, and any needed support. o Provide weekly updates on progress and tasks completed, reporting directly to the Director and tracking targets. Client Management: • Ensure all client records are up to date and keep track of where clients have come from. Qualifications: • Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel. • Proven experience in finance or similar roles – strong skills in budgeting and forecasting – with the ability to plan and anticipate financial trends to ensure business growth. • Experience with Trello and Microsoft Teams. • Ability to follow instructions carefully. • Highly organised with strong time-management skills. • Exceptional attention to detail. • Capability to perform ad hoc tasks as requested by the Director. •  You’ll be expected to make decisions and own the results of those decisions. • Stable internet connection is required. • At least one year of relevant work experience. • Ability to plan effectively and meet deadlines. • Effective problem-solver, motivated to achieve high-quality results. Why Join Us? • This full-time position offers flexibility in hours (we understand there’s a time difference). • We think big, never let our teammates down and we celebrate the wins. • You’ll be based remotely so you can work from your home but you’ll need a strong and stable internet connection. • Opportunity to work with a professional, friendly and supportive team, for an multi-award winning MediSpa. • No weekend work • Comprehensive training videos will be provided for all tasks. • Competitive salary and benefits. • Staff discount on products we stock This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who truly cares and has a genuine passion for their work and is interested in the beauty and aesthetics sector. You'll have the chance to make a meaningful impact and contribute to something bigger than yourself, along with significant opportunities for personal growth and skill development. If you wish to be considered as a serious candidate, please send us a covering letter and CV. IMPORTANT: In your cover letter, please share your favourite animal—this helps us confirm you’ve read the job description! The Application Process: We are accepting applications until Sunday, 3rd November. The next stage of the process involves answering a few short questions to better understand you, and you may be required to complete a piece of sample work to accurately assess your skills and abilities. IMPORTANT: The sample work you create is not for our benefit or the benefit of our business; it is purely to evaluate your skills and will not be used for commercial purposes. ---------- Please note this is 8am - 6pm UK time

description: Makarios Marketing — Remote About the Role Makarios Marketing is an SEO agency expanding into paid media for our local service clients. We're hiring a Google Ads Manager to take full, end-to-end ownership of paid ads across our client accounts — building campaigns, auditing what's already running, and managing monthly performance with real accountability for the money being spent. This is not an execution-only role. You will own the strategy, the day-to-day management, and the communication back to us and to clients about what's working, what isn't, and what needs to change. You'll have access to an expert Google Ads contractor for roughly 8 hours a month for the highest-stakes decisions or second opinions — but the accounts are yours to run. What You'll Own Account Build & Audit Build new Google Ads accounts and campaigns from scratch for clients adding paid media to their SEO program Audit existing client ad accounts — identify wasted spend, broken conversion tracking, poor targeting, weak ad copy, and structural issues Set up proper conversion tracking so every dollar spent can be tied to a real result (calls, form fills, bookings) LOCAL CLIENTS MOSTLY, some ecom Monthly Management & Optimization Manage budgets and bid strategy across all client accounts on an ongoing basis Monitor performance daily/weekly and make adjustments — pausing underperforming keywords or ads, reallocating budget toward what converts, adjusting targeting Run Local Service Ads (LSA) for clients where it makes sense as a secondary channel alongside Search and Performance Max Communication & Reporting Clearly communicate to the team and to clients what's right, what's wrong, what's missing, and what needs to improve in each account — in plain language, not just jargon and screenshots Produce monthly performance reports tying ad spend directly to leads, calls, and revenue impact Flag risk early — if a budget is pacing wrong or a campaign is underperforming, we hear about it before it becomes a bigger problem Strategic Budget Ownership Responsibly manage real client ad spend — this role carries direct accountability for driving strong ROAS, not just "keeping campaigns running" Know when something is within your judgment to fix immediately, and when to escalate to our Google Ads contractor for expert input Continuously look for opportunities to scale spend profitably as accounts prove out What We Need From You Proven, hands-on experience managing Google Ads accounts for real clients — not just a certification, actual campaigns you've built and managed Strong understanding of Search campaigns and Performance Max; Local Service Ads experience is a bonus, not required Experience managing meaningful ad budgets with real accountability for results Comfortable auditing someone else's account and clearly identifying what's wrong and how to fix it Strong communication skills — able to explain ad performance in terms a non-technical business owner understands Detail-oriented with conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and tying spend to actual business outcomes Self-directed — you should be able to run your accounts without needing daily oversight Comfortable working US business hours for client and team communication Bonus Work on ecommerce clients on google ads Facebook ads for local contractor or agencies like ours Schedule & Pay Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week Base Pay: $1,500–$1700/month, based on experience Bonuses for: client retention, account performance/ROAS results, and successful new account builds How to Apply Send the following to be considered: Your resume/CV WHY YOU STAND OUT FROM OTHERS - tell me in the application Examples or case studies of Google Ads accounts you've managed — screenshots, results, or anonymized account data showing real performance you've driven A short note on a time you caught a major problem in an ad account (yours or someone else's) and how you fixed it Add google26 to application to be considered By applying, you consent to Makarios Marketing reviewing your application materials and contacting any references provided

description: JOB TITLE: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – No Experience Required We are hiring a highly dependable virtual assistant to manage the daily operations of multiple eBay and Poshmark stores. Previous e-commerce experience is not required because complete training, written procedures, and detailed task checklists will be provided. This position is only for someone who is reliable, learns quickly, follows instructions exactly, and takes their work seriously. WORK SCHEDULE Work begins promptly at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time every day. This is not a flexible starting time. You must be clocked in, connected to the remote computer, and ready to begin working at exactly 6:00 AM. You will continue working until all assigned daily responsibilities are completed correctly. The workload should normally take no more than eight hours, including for someone who is still learning. The primary arrangement is for one virtual assistant to work every day, including weekends and holidays. OPTIONAL TWO-PERSON ARRANGEMENT If you would prefer to share the position with another reliable person, a two-person arrangement may be considered and must be approved in advance. Under this arrangement: One person would work four days and the other would work three days. The following week, the schedules would switch. Both people must complete the application and meet all requirements. Both people must receive training and be capable of completing the job independently. You would be responsible for coordinating the schedule and ensuring every day is covered. Failure by either person to show up would not excuse unfinished work or leave the business without coverage. A two-person arrangement is optional and is not guaranteed to be approved. STRICT ATTENDANCE AND PERFORMANCE POLICY Reliability is the most important requirement for this position. You may be removed from the position immediately if any of the following occurs: You are late for a scheduled shift. You miss a scheduled shift without prior approval. You repeatedly request last-minute schedule changes. You disappear, become unresponsive, or stop working while clocked in. Your internet connection is too slow or unreliable to complete the work. You repeatedly use internet, electricity, equipment, or personal problems as an excuse for unfinished work. You fail to communicate immediately when a genuine emergency occurs. You are unable or unwilling to learn the assigned procedures. You repeatedly ask questions already answered in the training materials. You ignore instructions or create your own process instead of following the required procedure. You repeatedly make careless or preventable mistakes. You fail to improve after receiving corrections. You mark tasks as completed when they were not actually completed. You clock in without actively working. You falsify your clock-in time, clock-out time, completed tasks, screenshots, or reports. You leave work unfinished without reporting it. You fail to review your work before submitting it. You send inaccurate, inappropriate, or unreviewed messages to customers. You share passwords, remote-access information, customer information, or business information with anyone. You perform unauthorized actions on an account. You work another job or perform unrelated activities while clocked in. You are consistently too slow after receiving reasonable training and practice. You demonstrate that you cannot independently perform the job correctly. Serious attendance, honesty, internet, communication, or performance problems may result in immediate termination without repeated warnings. If it becomes clear that you cannot consistently show up on time, maintain a stable connection, learn the procedures, communicate properly, or complete the work accurately, the working relationship will be ended. Do not apply unless you are confident that you can meet these expectations. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Your daily, weekly, and monthly duties will include: Managing daily eBay and Poshmark operations. Checking new orders and marking orders as shipped. Placing customer orders accurately. Adding and verifying tracking information. Finding orders that are missing tracking or have not shipped on time. Checking cancellations, requests, disputes, returns, and other customer cases. Responding to customer messages, questions, comments, and offers. Using ChatGPT to help create professional customer responses when needed. Reviewing every ChatGPT-generated response for accuracy before sending it. Checking account performance and account-health metrics. Monitoring late-shipment rates and tracking-validation rates. Confirming that stores remain within their listing limits. Completing product research using ChatGPT and Product Hunter. Preparing bulk product lists. Confirming that enough products are available for the next day’s listings. Completing at least 100 product-research items when assigned. Checking and responding to customer offers. Taking screenshots of eBay and Amazon orders when required. Following pricing, quantity, inventory, and listing-management procedures. Confirming that shipped orders receive the required price and quantity updates. Checking store promotions, sales, handling times, and promoted-listing settings. Checking for duplicate listings. Moving listings between assigned categories when instructed. Checking negative reviews and assisting with appeals. Completing weekly and monthly store-maintenance tasks. Updating order sheets and other operational records. Following the specific written procedures for every assigned account and computer. GOOGLE SHEET TRACKING You will use a Google Sheet to manage and document your work. You must: Clock in at the beginning of every shift. Clock out only after all assigned work is completed. Check off every task only after it is actually completed. Complete the required tasks for every assigned account or computer. Leave clear notes when a task cannot be completed. Report problems immediately instead of ignoring or skipping them. Keep the tracker accurate throughout the shift. Never mark an incomplete task as completed. The tracker and remote computers will be reviewed. Dishonest clock-in information, false completion marks, misleading updates, or claiming work was completed when it was not may result in immediate termination. COMPUTER AND INTERNET REQUIREMENTS You will use your own computer to remotely access company computers. You must have: Your own dependable computer. Fast and stable internet. The ability to remotely access company computers. A quiet and dependable place to work. A reliable method of communication during every shift. A backup internet option, such as mobile data or a hotspot, is strongly preferred. Do not apply using slow, unstable, shared, or frequently disconnected internet. Internet problems that regularly interfere with attendance or work completion may result in immediate removal from the position. OTHER REQUIREMENTS No previous eBay, Poshmark, Amazon, or virtual-assistant experience is required. You must have: Strong written English. Basic computer knowledge. Excellent attention to detail. The ability to learn new systems quickly. The ability to follow detailed written instructions. The ability to perform repetitive tasks accurately. Strong communication skills. The ability to work independently after training. The ability to remain focused until the work is completed. The ability to accept corrections and apply them immediately. The discipline to review your own work before marking it complete. The ability to ask questions when genuinely confused without repeatedly asking questions already answered during training. USE OF CHATGPT You may use ChatGPT to improve customer messages and assist with other approved tasks. However, you remain fully responsible for anything you send or submit. You must read, understand, and verify every response before using it. Copying and sending an incorrect, irrelevant, or inappropriate AI-generated response without reviewing it is unacceptable. COMMUNICATION Training, instructions, schedule coordination, questions, task updates, and daily reporting will take place through ---------- , WhatsApp, or text message. You must remain responsive while clocked in. Account problems, unusual orders, customer complaints, technical problems, and tasks you do not understand must be reported immediately. Silence is not acceptable. If there is a problem, communicate it before it causes unfinished work or an account issue. WHO SHOULD APPLY This position is suitable for someone who is: Dependable. Honest. Organized. Patient. Detail-oriented. Comfortable with repetitive computer work. Willing and able to learn. Able to follow instructions without constant supervision. Interested in stable, long-term work. We care more about reliability, accuracy, communication, internet quality, and the ability to follow instructions than previous experience. DO NOT APPLY IF: You frequently arrive late. You regularly miss work. You have unreliable internet. You cannot consistently begin working at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time. You cannot work weekends or holidays. You need flexible starting hours. You disappear during working hours. You are easily distracted while working from home. You require constant reminders to complete basic responsibilities. You do not carefully read instructions. You become defensive when corrected. You are uncomfortable having your work reviewed. You plan to perform another job during the same working hours. You cannot commit to completing every scheduled shift. HOW TO APPLY Include all of the following: Your full name. Your current city and country. Confirmation that you can begin working at exactly 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time. Confirmation that you can work every day, including weekends and holidays. State whether you are applying alone or requesting the optional two-person arrangement. Confirmation that you understand the strict attendance and performance policy. A screenshot of a current internet-speed test. Your computer specifications. Whether you have backup internet or a mobile hotspot. A brief explanation of why you consider yourself dependable. Any previous remote-work or computer-based experience, if applicable. Your ---------- or WhatsApp contact information. Begin your application with the words “GREEN CHECK” so we know you read the entire post. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

description: This is NOT your typical AMV edit. I'm looking for a highly skilled video editor who wants to work on a cinematic music video unlike anything you've probably edited before. While this project isn't anime, I believe the best AMV editors are uniquely qualified for it because of their attention to detail, beat synchronization, motion design, camera movement, and ability to create emotion through editing. If you're someone who enjoys pushing your editing skills beyond standard anime edits and wants to create something visually unforgettable, I'd love to hear from you. About the Project The project is an original cinematic house music video called Skarnax. The story follows a colossal, warship-sized seagull deity that descends from the heavens and attacks an isolated 1800s fishing village. As the music reaches the drop, Skarnax unleashes chaos across the sea and nearby city before mysteriously disappearing, leaving behind only one message... He will return. I have already created the full AI-generated storyboard and reference video. Your job is to take the visuals to an entirely new level through professional editing. What You'll Be Working With I'll provide everything you need, including: Complete AI-generated reference video Character PNGs (multiple attack poses) City backgrounds Ocean backgrounds Sky backgrounds Flying ship PNGs Flying debris PNGs Crowd PNGs Smoke, waves and environmental assets Music track Beat markers already synchronized to the kick drum Additional overlay assets You are NOT creating assets from scratch. Your job is to transform these assets into an exciting cinematic sequence. The Demo Instead of asking you to complete the entire project, I first want a 5-second demo. The demo begins at the 25-second mark of the reference video. This is where the music drop starts. I'll provide: The reference video The music All PNG assets Google Drive folder containing everything: ---------- Your objective is simple: Take those five seconds and make me say... "I need this person editing my entire music video." This demo is your opportunity to showcase your creativity, technical skill, and attention to detail. What I'm Looking For I'm not looking for someone who simply syncs cuts to the beat. I'm looking for someone who understands how to build energy, create ---------- ntum, and make every beat feel impactful. Every kick drum should feel intentional. Every movement should feel motivated. Every frame should contribute to the overall cinematic experience. I'm looking for someone who understands: Storyboard sequencing Scene composition Camera movement Visual pacing Escalation Rhythm Impact Motion design Professional transitions Editing Style Your editing should include techniques such as: Advanced keyframing Quad In / Quad Out curves Custom easing Smooth scaling Position animation Camera push-ins Camera pull-outs Motion blur Overlay masking Blend modes Parallax Dynamic transitions Flash frames Beat synchronized effects Cinematic zooms Speed ramps where appropriate Layered visual effects Every movement should feel smooth and intentional. Nothing should feel robotic or linear. Required Training Videos I'll provide two YouTube videos that demonstrate the editing style and techniques I'm looking for. ---------- ---------- Before creating your demo, I expect you to watch both videos carefully. These videos explain many of the subtle editing techniques that separate an average edit from an exceptional one. Examples include: Proper keyframe easing Motion curves Position animation Scaling techniques Layer movement Transition timing Beat synchronization These details matter. Please Don't Skip the Details Please don't submit a demo unless you're genuinely committed to reproducing the techniques shown in the reference videos. I'm also a CapCut editor. I understand these techniques and will immediately recognize whether they've been applied correctly. I'm not looking for shortcuts. I'm looking for someone who enjoys obsessing over the tiny details that make an edit feel professional. I'd rather review five exceptional demos than fifty rushed ones. Let's respect each other's time. Creative Freedom I don't expect you to copy my AI storyboard exactly. You're welcome to improve it. You're welcome to combine the AI-generated video with the PNG assets if you think it creates a stronger result. If you have a better visual idea that improves the sequence while staying true to the story, I'm happy to see your creativity. The goal isn't to follow instructions blindly. The goal is to create the most exciting sequence possible. Experience Great work always speaks louder than the number of years you've been editing. If your demo impresses me, that's what matters most. How to Apply Please start your application with the following: 1. Your experience level Example: I have 12 years of professional video editing experience. or I have 5 years of experience, but I believe my work demonstrates the level you're looking for. 2. Links to your best work Please send only your strongest edits. Quality is much more important than quantity. 3. Confirm you've watched both YouTube reference videos. 4. Download the project assets from the Google Drive folder below. Google Drive: ---------- I'm looking forward to seeing what you create.

job_title: After Effects Motion Graphics Editor for YouTube (Kinetic Typography + Fast Turnaround)
description: After Effects Motion Graphics Editor for YouTube (Kinetic Typography + Fast Turnaround) The role We are a video editing company working with a roster of YouTube creators and brands, and we are looking for an After Effects specialist who lives and breathes kinetic typography and retention-style motion graphics. If you can make text snap, fly, bounce, and hit on the beat, and you can do it fast without losing quality, keep reading. You will work across multiple clients and a range of project types, so range matters. That said, one of our primary clients does high-energy retention-style content, and that work will be the bulk of your day to day. The benchmark below shows exactly what that looks like. This is the bar (watch before applying) Watch the first 1 minute and 43 seconds of this video. This is the style of our primary client and the bulk of the work you will be doing. This is the level of editing and motion graphics you need to be able to hit: ** ---------- ** Pay attention to how the text animates onto the screen word by word in sync with the speaker, how key words get scaled up, highlighted, underlined, or boxed for emphasis, how the camera punches in and zooms on important ---------- nts, and how every animation hit is matched with a sound effect. That rhythm and polish is the standard. If you cannot produce work at this level, this role is not the right fit. What you will be doing - Editing YouTube videos with heavy motion graphics and animated text - Building snappy kinetic typography (text floating in, scaling, sliding, word-by-word emphasis) - Quick zoom-ins, punch-ins, and energetic transitions cut to the audio - Animated text treatments: underlines, highlights, callouts, lower thirds, on-screen labels - Mixing typography styles and treatments to match the energy of each ---------- nt - Layering sound effects and syncing animation hits to the beat Must-haves - **Expert-level After Effects.** This is non-negotiable. You should be able to animate text and graphics fluidly without hunting through tutorials. - **Strong kinetic typography portfolio.** Show us animated text you personally built, not work you assembled from templates. - **Fast, reliable turnaround.** You ship polished work on tight deadlines and you hit your dates. - **A sharp eye for timing, pacing, and sound design.** You know why a cut lands and where a sound effect belongs. - **Range and adaptability.** You can match different client styles and brand guidelines, not just one look. Reference videos and brand kits should be something you follow closely, not override. - **Premiere Pro familiarity** for the base edit and assembly. - **Clear written English and good communication.** You ask smart questions and you do not go quiet mid-project. Nice to have - Thumbnail design or Photoshop skills - Experience working with an agency or juggling multiple clients at once - Experience in a specific niche (tell us what kind of content you have edited) - Familiarity with fast-paced, retention-style creator editing (think the energy of Hormozi, MrBeast, or Gadzhi style channels) How we work For each project we give you the raw footage, a clear direction, reference videos, and the client's brand guidelines. You bring the energy and the polish, and you match the look the client expects. You will move between clients and project types, so being organized and able to switch gears matters. We value speed, consistency, and someone who makes the work better without needing to be micromanaged. Because we are an editing company with an active client roster, this is steady, ongoing volume, not one-off gigs. Volume is typically at least 2 videos per week and often more. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to become one of our go-to editors as we grow. ## Hours and availability This role runs on US business hours. We need you online and reachable during the Central Time workday, roughly 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM CST (US Central Time). You do not have to cover the whole window, but you should be able to commit to a consistent block inside it so we can send feedback, answer questions, and turn revisions around same day. Please note: these hours are an overnight shift in the Philippines (roughly 8 or 9 PM to 7 or 8 AM your time, depending on the season). Only apply if you are comfortable working nights consistently and on time. Pay $15 to $25 per hour depending on speed and skill, with room to grow for the right person. We pay well and on time for great work. How to apply (read carefully, this is how we filter) 1. Start your message with the word **SNAP** so we know you read the whole post. 2. Send your reel or portfolio. Include 2 or 3 timestamps pointing to kinetic typography or animated text you personally created, and tell us exactly what you did on each. 3. In one or two sentences, tell us the fastest you have ever turned around a fully edited, motion-heavy YouTube video and how long that video was. 4. Tell us honestly: can you produce work at the level of the benchmark video above? If you have something in your reel that comes close to that style, point us to it. 5. List the software you use, the hours you can be online in CST (US Central Time), and your weekly availability. Generic messages with no reel will not be considered. We are hiring one great person, and the right fit will have steady, long-term work with us.
