title: Dating App Assistant
description: Personal Dating App Manager (Ghostwriter–Operator) I'm hiring someone to run the day-to-day of my dating profiles. You're the engine behind the scenes: curating matches, opening conversations, keeping promising ones warm, and getting the good ones to a scheduled date. I handle the actual dates — you handle everything up to them. This is fast AI-assisted drafting with light judgment, not pure copy-paste. You'll use tools to generate options quickly, but you read the thread and pick or adjust so it lands like a real person. The difference between a date and a dead conversation is usually one good reply at the unexpected ---------- nt — that's the skill I'm hiring for. Apps you'd manage: [Hinge / Bumble / Tinder / etc.] Goal: [be specific — e.g. "consistent, quality first dates with people I'd actually click with"] What you'll do Review and curate matches against a preferences brief I'll give you Write openers and carry conversations in my voice Keep ---------- ntum: timely replies, good questions, knowing when to ask someone out Handle the "message three" save — when someone says something the script didn't anticipate, you keep it alive Flag standout matches to me before any date is set Maintain a clean log of who's who so threads never cross Suggest tweaks to my photos and bio over time based on what's landing Edit and prep my profile photos — light retouching, cropping, ordering, and basic cleanup so the profile always looks its best (no heavy/deceptive editing; the photos still have to look like me) Tools & Workflow You'll operate a defined stack so the work is fast and consistent. I'll provide access and a voice brief. Drafting — YourMove AI (default engine for openers and replies). [Swap/secondary: SmoothRizz if we prioritize voice-consistency.] Match tracking — Wingman (AI Dating Coach app): a profile per person so we track what's been said and what's worked, and never cross threads. Also our photo/bio optimizer. Delivery — the actual apps, by hand. You log in and type inside [Hinge/Bumble/Tinder]. No automation or auto-senders — those get accounts banned. [Optional: Keys AI keyboard to speed up in-app typing, on the dedicated device only.] Access — 1Password (or Bitwarden): you get login access without raw credentials; I can revoke instantly. Brief & coordination — shared Notion doc: my voice, preferences, and standing rules live here. Photo editing — [Lightroom Mobile / Snapseed / Canva / TouchRetouch]: for cropping, light retouching, ordering, and cleanup. Use whichever you're fluent in; just keep edits natural. The rhythm: read the thread ? generate options ? pick the one that fits and tweak it to sound like me ? send ? log anything worth remembering. Seconds of judgment per message, not minutes of writing. Who I'm looking for A genuinely strong, natural writer with range — funny, warm, or sharp depending on the person High emotional intelligence and a good read on subtext Comfortable using AI tools to draft fast and the judgment to know when a suggestion is off Competent with basic photo editing — cropping, light retouching, and selecting the strongest shots Discreet and trustworthy — this is my actual dating life Responsive during [active hours] Bonus: you've done this kind of work before, or you're just unusually good at texting Confidentiality You'll have access to my accounts and personal conversations. A basic confidentiality agreement is part of the role — non-negotiable, and I'll provide it before any account access. How to apply — the screening I'm using a few short steps instead of a résumé, because the work is the audition. Step 1 — Quick intro + read-the-brief check (5 min). A short note answering: why does this kind of work appeal to you? Then, so I know you actually read instructions before acting: Start your message with the word "Banana." Keep the whole note under 100 words. End with one line confirming you're comfortable signing a confidentiality agreement. No cover letter — keep it human. (If you skip any of the three, I'll assume the instruction-following part of the job isn't a fit, and won't move forward. This is the filter, not a formality.) Step 2 — Work sample (writing + photo). I'll send a mock match profile and one sample photo. You'll: Write the opener you'd send them. Rewrite this bland bio to make it pull: "[insert a boring sample bio]" Do a quick, natural edit of the sample photo (crop + light cleanup) and send it back — show me you can make a shot look its best without making it look fake. Step 3 — The message-three save (the real filter). I'll give you a conversation that's gone cold, or a match who said something slightly off or unexpected. Show me how you'd recover or respond. This tells me more than anything else. Step 4 — Paid trial. Top candidates do a [1–2 week] paid trial on a live account, with me reviewing before anything sends. If it clicks, we make it ongoing. To start: reply with Step 1 and I'll send the Step 2 brief. Notes for me before posting: lock the rate and hours (vague pay attracts vague applicants — even a range sharpens the pool a lot), confirm which apps I'm listing, and run YourMove + Wingman through their free trials on my real threads first so I know the stack actually works before handing it off.

title: Remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager for Hawaii Prefab Company
job_title: Remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager for Hawaii Prefab Company
description: Paa Prefab is a growing prefab housing and building-products company on the Big Island of Hawaii. We sell prefab buildings, storage and office units, container-style spaces, and related building products for customers who need practical, affordable space. I am hiring a remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager to help run the parts of the company that need consistent follow-through, organization, reporting, research, and systems. This role is for someone who can take ownership across multiple areas of the business: finance admin, marketing coordination, sales follow-up, procurement research, customer communication, supplier tracking, project organization, and internal systems. I am looking for someone who can operate independently, solve problems, create structure, maintain standards, and make the business easier to run without needing constant hand-holding. You will work directly with the owner. Your job is to own the operating rhythm of the business, keep work moving, surface decisions clearly, and reduce the number of things that fall back on the owner. Financial, marketing, and sales as well as management success, a hunger and will to succeed, strong problem solving, and the track-record to prove it. Core Areas You Will Help Own Finance and Regulatory Admin You will help keep the business financially organized and legally in compliance of tax and other accounting requirements. This may include: • Organizing invoices, receipts, quotes, payments, and vendor records. • Researching required State, Federal Tax and other required reporting/submissions on time. • Tracking customer deposits, balances due, payment status, and follow-up needs. • Preparing simple finance summaries for owner review. • Coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, or outside finance support. • Flagging missing documents, unpaid balances, unusual charges, or unclear records. • Helping prepare clean records for taxes, bookkeeping, and reporting. You will not be expected to make final financial decisions without approval, but you should be able to keep the finance admin side organized and visible. Sales Operations You will help make sure leads and customers do not fall through the cracks. This may include: • Managing CRM records and lead pipelines. • Tracking every lead’s status and next step. • Drafting customer replies and follow-up messages. • Preparing quote information for owner review. • Making sure customer questions get answered or escalated. • Tracking interested customers, serious buyers, quote requests, deposits, and delivery status. • Identifying which leads need urgent attention. The goal is not just to reply to messages. The goal is to help build a reliable sales follow-up system. Marketing Coordination You will help keep marketing organized and active. This may include: • Coordinating Facebook Marketplace listings and social media posts. • Organizing product photos, descriptions, pricing notes, and listing copy. • Tracking which products are listed where. • Watching competitor listings and local market pricing. • Helping draft ads, posts, flyers, email s, and simple marketing campaigns. • Tracking which marketing channels are producing leads. • Suggesting improvements based on what customers are asking about. Marketing should be practical, consistent, and safe for the business. No spam tactics, fake accounts, risky shortcuts, or sloppy public claims. Procurement and Supplier Research You will help research and organize supplier options. This may include: • Researching prefab buildings, container units, sheds, storage units, roofing systems, panels, accessories, tools, materials, and related products. • Comparing suppliers, pricing, shipping, minimum order quantities, lead times, and product specs. • Organizing supplier quotes and conversations. • Preparing comparison summaries. • Asking suppliers clear questions. • Tracking open supplier issues and follow-ups. • Helping identify better products, better margins, or better sourcing options. The goal is to help the owner make faster, better purchasing decisions. Operations and Project Coordination You will help turn messy daily business activity into clear systems. This may include: • Creating trackers, checklists, SOPs, templates, dashboards, and simple workflows. • Preparing daily and weekly owner updates. • Tracking open decisions, blockers, customer promises, supplier follow-ups, and delivery issues. • Organizing documents, photos, product details, quotes, invoices, contracts, and project records. • Keeping important information easy to find. • Noticing repeated problems and suggesting fixes. The strongest person for this role will not wait for every task to be assigned. They will notice what is missing and help create order. Looking For: Strong General Manager Traits I am looking for someone who is: • Excellent in written English. • Highly organized and reliable. • Calm under pressure. • Graceful and professional at all times, with customers, vendors, and coworkers. • A self-starter who does not need to be chased. • Comfortable owning several business areas at once. • Good at turning messy information into clear next steps. • Strong at follow-up, reminders, tracking, and documentation. • Able to maintain business standards even when things are moving quickly. • Able to make practical recommendations, not just collect information. • Comfortable making judgment calls and explaining your reasoning. • Careful with customer promises, pricing, permitting, delivery details, and anything that could create confusion. • Honest when you do not know something. • Able to work independently while keeping the owner informed. • Practical, direct, and action-oriented. The strongest candidate will think like a general manager, chief of staff, or operations lead — someone who sees what needs to happen, organizes it, and helps make it happen. Looking For: Useful Experience Direct construction experience is helpful, but it is not required. I am interested in people who have managed complexity in real business environments. Strong candidates may come from many backgrounds, including: • Operations management for a small business. • Finance admin, bookkeeping coordination, invoice tracking, or payment follow-up. • Sales operations, CRM management, lead follow-up, or quote coordination. • Marketing coordination, social media listings, Marketplace, paid ads, or local business marketing. • Procurement, supplier research, vendor management, importing, shipping, or product comparison. • Logistics, dispatch, delivery coordination, warehouse coordination, or inventory management. • Trades businesses, contractor offices, repair businesses, mechanical services, equipment rental, automotive, marine, appliance, solar, or other hands-on service businesses. • Real estate, property management, hospitality, events, or other high-pressure customer-facing operations. • Coordinating many moving parts across customers, vendors, schedules, documents, and money records. • CRM tools, Airtable, HubSpot, Notion, Trello, Linear, Google Sheets, or similar systems. • Working for a US, Australian, Canadian, or UK business. • ChatGPT or other AI tools used for real business operations. • Building trackers, dashboards, checklists, SOPs, or simple systems for a growing company. What matters most is not the exact industry. What matters is whether you can manage complexity, maintain standards, communicate clearly, and keep moving with calm, charm, and good judgment. Looking For: Work Style The business moves fast. Some things will be messy. Your job is to help make them clear. I value short, useful updates. I do not need long vague reports. I want information that helps decisions happen faster. Looking For: AI Tool Judgment I want someone who can use AI tools well, but not blindly. Good AI use means: • Using ChatGPT to draft, summarize, organize, compare, and speed up research. • Checking facts before relying on them. • Editing AI output so it sounds human, specific, and accurate. • Knowing when a customer-facing message needs owner approval. • Separating facts, assumptions, and open questions. • Never using AI as an excuse for sloppy work or for a lack of accountability for the work you do. How To Apply Please reply with: 1 A short introduction in your own words. 2 Your relevant experience. 3 Why you think you are a fit for a General Manager / Business Operations Manager role. 4 Your expected monthly salary in USD. 5 Your available working hours in Philippine time. 6 Your available overlap with Hawaii time, if you know it. 7 A specific example of a messy process, tracker, system, or workflow you improved. 8 A specific example of a time you solved a business problem without waiting for your boss to tell you every step. 9 A specific example of a time you stayed calm and effective in a fast-moving or high-pressure situation. 10 Which areas you are strongest in: finance admin, marketing, sales operations, procurement, customer follow-up, project coordination, systems, logistics, vendor management, or research. 11 What tools you are comfortable with: spreadsheets, CRM, Google Workspace, ChatGPT, Notion, Airtable, Trello, etc. Please also answer these questions: Question 1: A potential customer asks about a prefab home but gives incomplete information. What information would you collect before the owner spends time preparing a quote? Question 2: A customer asks: “Can I live in this? Is it permitted? I’m in Puna and need something cheap fast.” How would you reply? Question 3: You notice that leads are coming from Facebook , text messages, phone calls, and referrals, but there is no reliable system for tracking who needs follow-up. What would you build first? Question 4: You are researching a new supplier. What information would you collect before recommending whether we should consider buying from them? Question 5: Describe a business environment where you had to manage many moving parts at once. What standards did you maintain, and how did you keep things from falling through the cracks? Optional: Tell me how you currently use ChatGPT or AI tools in your work, and how you check the output before using it. Applications that are generic, copy-pasted, or obviously AI-written without personal detail will be skipped. Paid Test Task Strong applicants may be invited to complete a short paid test task before hiring. The test may include: • Creating a lead follow-up tracker. • Drafting a customer follow-up message. • Creating a quote-prep checklist. • Summarizing supplier/product options. • Writing a daily owner update. • Creating a basic finance/admin tracker for invoices, deposits, balances due, and missing records. • Recommending a simple operating system for managing leads, suppliers, quotes, marketing tasks, and follow-ups. • Explaining which customer, finance, pricing, permitting, or public-facing issues should require owner approval. I am looking for judgment, clarity, structure, independence, follow-through, calm under pressure, and practical thinking. Compensation This is a serious full-time role. Pay is USD $2,000/month for the right person. I am willing to pay well for someone who is independent, reliable, organized, calm, honest, and able to take ownership of finance admin, sales operations, marketing coordination, procurement research, logistics support, vendor follow-up, and business systems so the company can run with less owner involvement.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
description: Good work should win the work. Rootl helps tradespeople and local service businesses get found, picked and booked online. We exist because good businesses lose to worse ones every day. Not because they are worse at the job, but because the worse ones got found first. It started with advice from an upstairs window to a window cleaner halfway up a ladder. By 2036 we want Rootl to be the UK's most trusted local search company for trades and local service businesses, with our first US hub open. We are building the team that gets us there. Want a seat on the bus? ## WHAT WE DO We help tradespeople and local service businesses get found on Google, and inside the AI tools their next customer is already searching with: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini. That is the job. We do it for plumbers, electricians, roofers, joiners, waste firms, architects, developers, and the trades around them. Three core services, one job done properly: getting our clients found when their next customer is looking. We are a small, growing team. The founder runs sales and strategy. A web developer builds the client sites. A content operations manager runs the content. This new seat is the founder's right hand, the person who holds everything together so the rest of us can do our jobs. ## THE ROLE, IN ONE LINE You protect the founder's time and turn what is in his head into a system the business can run on. ## ABOUT THIS SEAT This is the founder's right hand. The person who holds the structure, protects the time, and takes the mental load so the founder can focus on growing the business. ## READ THIS TWICE The next part is the honest version. Read it carefully, because it tells you exactly what you would be walking into. ## A STRAIGHT WORD, FOUNDER TO YOU I have never hired someone into this seat before. For two years I have run this business out of my own head. The inbox, the calendar, the onboarding, the follow-ups, the systems, all of it lives in my memory and on my plate. It has got me this far. It will not get me where we are going. I know that to scale this business I have to get the mentalness out of my head and into a system someone else can run. That is the job. You are not walking into a finished machine. You are helping me build it, then helping me let go of it. So be clear on what you are walking into. I move fast. I set twelve things going in a week and I need someone to catch the three that fell. Some weeks will feel like organised chaos. This role exists to bring order to it. If that excites you rather than worries you, this is your seat. It is a rocket ship, and I want you on it. ## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Here is the real test, and it comes from my corporate days before Rootl. I had an emergency appendectomy three days before a major event in San Diego that I was running. I could not fly. So I wrote up a full handover plan and passed it to my boss from the back of the car while my replacement was on their way to the airport. The event ran without me, because everything they needed was written down. That is what winning looks like in this seat. If I take an afternoon off, or a week off, the system runs itself. You are the person who makes that true, by turning what is in my head into something written down that anyone can pick up. There is a second, quieter version of success, and it happens every single day. You become the gateway. I have taken email off my phone and handed the inbox to you. You manage my calendar, not me. I do not always know what is coming up next week, because I do not need to. You do. I trust the surface you show me to be right, and that trust is the whole point of the seat. ## TRUST AND CONFIDENTIALITY This is the part that matters most, so read it carefully. This seat sees things almost no one else does. My inbox, my calendar, the numbers, the decisions, the conversations I would not have anywhere else. The role only works on a foundation of complete trust. We need someone with a high degree of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality. What you see in this seat stays in this seat. This is written into the contract as the first clause, and we will talk about it openly at interview, because it is not a detail. It is the ground the whole role stands on. ## WHY YOU'D WANT THIS SEAT - A real seat at the table. You work closely with the founder, you are the eyes and ears across the team, and you are someone I can bat ideas off. This is not a fetch-and-carry role. - A clear lane that is yours. I run sales, marketing and strategy. Our web developer builds the sites. Our content manager runs the content engine. You hold the operation together and protect my time. Everyone knows their seat, and this one is yours. - Responsibility from day one. Not a six-month shadow. - You help write the process, not just follow it. Using the founder's own recordings (camcorder method), voice notes, and you build the SOPs every future Rootl hire is trained on. - Variety with depth. You will do a range of things, and you will also do similar things well and make them tighter each time. - Real long-term upside for the person who stays the course. We will talk that through properly once you are established. - The local search world is shifting under everyone's feet right now. You will be close to the front of it. - We hire the right person, not the perfect person. Every candidate is DISC profiled, because the seat has to fit how we work. ## WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Inbox and calendar. You filter the inbox, surface only what I need, and protect my diary. I do not want email on my phone. That is your world. - Helping me plan the week. What is scheduled, what can be pushed, what matters most. You are the person I benchmark against so I feel organised. - Meeting prep and follow-ups. Getting me ready before a call, and making sure nothing drops after it. - Marketing and offers admin. Organising campaigns, drafting offers from my rough notes, and crafting my weekly Thursday networking pitch with other business owners so I can review and rehearse it. - Client onboarding, owned end to end. Intake form, welcome email , CRM setup, contract back-end, getting people access to systems. One repeatable process, run the same way every time. - Sales support. Scheduling the inbound enquiries and DMs that come from our campaigns, running first-pass research on a prospect against our fit benchmark and handing me a profile sheet before the call, and chasing proposals through to a yes or a clean no. - Team conduit. Keeping Slack current and Notion up to date, documenting decisions as they happen, and holding our weekly team rhythm with the rest of the team. - System building. Working with me to document one process every week, so the business stops living in my head. - Tool stand-up. Owning the setup when a new system comes in: project boards, pipelines, trackers, CRM updates. There will also be ad hoc tasks. This seat suits someone who enjoys variety and likes being the person who keeps an eye on how things are running across the team. ## HOW THIS SEAT THINKS This is the standard I am building toward, and it is how I want this seat held from day one. These five run underneath everything above. - Protect my time. You filter what comes in and d ---------- what actually needs me. Most things do not. Guarding my time and attention is the first job, and everything else sits under it. - Prioritise revenue. When everything feels urgent, you sort by what makes money or saves money first. That is the tie-breaker. The task that protects a client or wins a job comes before the one that just shouts loudest. - Design the play. You come prepared and you think ahead. You see the thing coming before it lands on me, and you have already worked out the options. You plan the week, the meeting, and the follow-up before I have to ask. - Answer everyone well. Every message gets a clear, kind reply, even when the answer is no. How we treat people is how we are remembered, and you are often the first voice they hear from Rootl. - Keep the calendar clean and clear. Every entry has the context I need to walk into it cold. Who, what, why, and what I need to have ready. No naked invites, no guessing, no surprises. ## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - You love systems. You see a messy process and you want to make it clean and repeatable. - You are a strong planner. Detail is your thing. You enjoy mapping out how something will run before it runs. - You are analytical and you will push back when something does not add up. Not on the person, on the logic. I want someone who tells me when I am wrong. - You are calm in chaos. A founder still building the rail does not rattle you. You bring order without needing everything to be tidy first. - You are good with people and relationships. You become the eyes and ears of the team without anyone feeling watched. - You are comfortable with ambiguity. This seat is being built as it runs, and you are helping to build it. - You take pride in doing similar work to a high standard, week in, week out, and improving it as you go. - Excellent written English. We will test this. Nice to have, not essential: - A bit of technical appetite. Comfort with tools like Zapier, simple automations, or project planning software. - Experience supporting a founder or senior leader directly. - Experience editing AI-written content to a publish-ready standard. - A handy eye for social content. If you know your way around Canva and can keep a light hand on the quality of social posts going out to local groups, that is a real plus. We have someone producing the content, but having an in-house person who knows the business well enough to sense-check it is genuinely useful. - A systems-and-time way of thinking. If you have read books like Buy Back Your Time by Dan Martell, The E-Myth by Michael E. Gerber, or you naturally think about how to protect a founder's time and turn chaos into a repeatable system, that is a real plus. It means we already speak the same language. ## HOW THIS SEAT WORKS WITH THE FOUNDER I run hot and fast. I set a lot in motion and I need someone to hold the structure underneath it. I use the word "comfortable" when I am settling for less than I should, and I say "it's in my head" when I mean I have not written it down yet. I race to the destination before the scaffolding exists, which is sometimes my greatest strength and sometimes my biggest risk. Your job is the pause valve, not the brake. You do not slow me down. You make sure the path exists for me to run on. Come to me with goals and a plan, never empty-handed. Hit your deadlines. Hold closure on decisions, because leaving things hanging is the thing I find hardest. I am direct, I am honest, and I will tell you what is on my mind. I am looking for someone who can do the same. ## TOOLS YOU WILL USE Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, HighLevel, Toggl, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. I am already teaching AI to write in my voice, so you will be editing and shaping output, not starting from a blank page. Experience with Zapier and automation tools are a bonus. Training and SOPs provided. You do not need every tool on day one, but you do need to learn fast. ## HOURS, PAY AND HOW IT WORKS - Part-time to start, around 10 hours a week, paid at $10 USD an hour. Hours grow toward 20 a week within the first 90 days as we find our rhythm and as I hand more over. - We start with a short unpaid test task so we can see how you work. If it goes well, you move onto a paid trial, paid for the hours you actually work. - Your hours and your rate both grow as you prove yourself and as the business grows. The aim is to build this into a senior, long-term seat for the right person. - If the work ever drops, we give you at least one week's written notice of any change to your hours. - Paid weekly for your first month, then monthly after that, by Wise. - You track your time in Toggl. Your tracked hours are what you invoice, so it stays clear and fair on both sides. - Every Monday we run a 30-minute tea ---------- eting using the LIONS sheet: last week, issues, opportunities, the next seven days, and successes. You fill yours in and come ready to run your part. - Most mornings we jump on a quick 15-minute call to set up the day, what matters, what is moving, what I need from you. A slightly longer one at the start of the week to plan it out. This daily contact is how the seat works, so you need to be someone who is happy with that rhythm. - I try to work UK hours, 7:00 to 4:30. At least half your hours each week need to fall inside that window so we can work together properly. For you in the Philippines that is roughly 2pm to 11:30pm, so an evening pattern fits well. - This is an independent contractor role on a proper written agreement covering confidentiality, client data, and how we pay you. You look after your own taxes in the Philippines, and you provide your own computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work. - Four weeks' notice on either side if it is ever not working out. ## THE HIRING PROCESS We want this to be clear and fair, so here is exactly how it runs. Everything up to the offer is unpaid, and the test task is the same for everyone. 1. You apply (opening with the screening phrase below). 2. We shortlist. 3. We send you a short test task with a clear deadline. 4. You complete and return it. 5. We score it and shortlist again. 6. You complete a DISC profile (a short questionnaire, so we understand how you work). 7. You have an interview with the founder. 8. If it is a yes on both sides, we make a provisional offer: a paid trial of one to two weeks, paid for the hours you work. 9. If the trial goes well, we move into a longer arrangement. ## HOW TO APPLY - Start your application with the phrase "Save me a seat" so we know you have read this far. - Tell us, in a few lines, about a time you took something chaotic off someone's plate and made it run smoothly. - Tell us about a system or process you built or improved, and what changed because of it. - Share any examples of executive support, admin, or operations work you are proud of. - The test task, when it comes, will be a real early-morning brain dump from the founder, for you to sort, prioritise, and turn into a clear plan. Unpaid, and the same for everyone. ## A LAST WORD We are not the biggest name out there, and we are not trying to be, (yet!) We are building something properly, and this seat is fundamental to getting it right. If you have read this far and something here lit you up, that is a good sign. Show us why it should be you. Want a seat on the bus?

Role Description: We are seeking an experienced Production & Sourcing Manager to oversee apparel production across multiple factory partners in China. This role is responsible for ensuring orders are produced on time, meet quality standards, and move efficiently from development through shipment. You will serve as the primary point of contact between our team and our manufacturing partners, managing production schedules, solving factory issues, coordinating logistics, and sourcing new suppliers when needed. The ideal candidate has extensive experience working directly with apparel factories, understands garment construction and production processes, and is highly organized when managing multiple orders simultaneously. Mandarin language skills are highly preferred but not required. Tasks and Responsibilities: 1. Production Management - Own the production calendar from purchase order through shipment. - Track all active orders across multiple factories and ensure milestones are met. - Maintain accurate production timelines and proactively identify delays before they become issues. - Hold factories accountable for deadlines and production commitments. - Escalate timing risks and recommend solutions before customer deadlines are impacted. 2. Factory Communication - Serve as the primary daily point of contact with factory partners primarily through WeChat. - Follow up continuously on production status, materials, samples, and shipment readiness. - Build strong relationships with factory management teams while maintaining accountability. - Ensure factories clearly understand product specifications - timelines and expectations. 3. Product Development & Sampling - Review tech packs, specifications, measurements, materials, and construction details. - Coordinate sample development from initial concept through production approval. - Verify samples meet requirements before bulk production begins. - Identify construction, fit, quality or manufacturing concerns early in the process. 4. Quality Control - Monitor production quality across all active orders. - Identify and resolve defects, workmanship concerns, material inconsistencies, and specification issues. - Coordinate third-party inspections when necessary. - Work with factories to implement corrective actions and prevent recurring issues. 5. Factory Sourcing & Vendor Management - Research, identify, and qualify new factories for existing and future product categories. - Request and evaluate factory capabilities, pricing, minimums, lead times, and quality standards. - Build a network of reliable manufacturing partners. - Assist with transitioning production away from underperforming suppliers when necessary. 6. title: Xero Bookkeeper - Australian GST/BAS Experience (Part-Time)
description: About the role We run two Australian businesses - a digital agency and a property services business and we need a reliable part-time bookkeeper to keep the books clean across both in Xero. You'll own the day-to-day and the monthly close so the numbers are always accurate and the quarterly BAS/tax work is easy for our accountant. This is steady, ongoing work) for someone who takes pride in tidy, reconciled books. What you'll do - Keep two separate Xero files (one per business) reconciled and up to date - bank feeds, coding, and clearing the unreconciled queue. - Code every transaction with the correct Australian GST treatment (GST, GST-free, BAS-excluded) so the books are always BAS-ready. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable - enter bills, match payments, flag anything overdue. - Run a clean month-end close for both entities: reconcile balance sheet accounts, tidy the P&L, and send a short summary of anything that needs attention. - Keep payroll and superannuation records straight in Xero (we don't expect you to lodge anything - just keep it clean and accurate). - Flag anything unusual instead of guessing - a quick question beats a wrong entry. > Note: BAS and tax lodgement stay with our registered accountant. You don't need to be a BAS agent. Your job is to hand them a clean, reconciled, BAS-ready set of books each quarter. You're a great fit if you - Have real, hands-on Xeroexperience and have done the books for Australian businesses before. - Understand Australian GST/BAS coding cold you know what's GST-free vs taxable and you code for it without being told. - Are accurate and self-checking - you reconcile to the cent and don't leave a mess for next month. - Keep two sets of books cleanly separate and never mix entities. - Communicate clearly in writing and raise questions early. - Bonus: awareness of NSW payroll tax / workers-comp obligations, and you use AI tools to work faster (we're an AI-forward team). Logistics - Part-time, fully remote, ongoing. - Some overlap with Australian business hours (AEST) around month-end is helpful. - Tools: Xero (core, two files), Microsoft 365, a shared document/receipt folder, and a task manager. Dext experience is a plus. How to apply (read carefully) To show us you read this far, start your application with the word "RECONCILED" in the first line. Applications that don't will be skipped. Then answer these three questions: 1. Which Australian businesses have you kept the books for in Xero, and for how long? 2. Walk us through your process for making sure every transaction is coded BAS-ready (GST vs GST-free vs excluded). 3. How do you run a monthly close so the balance sheet actually reconciles - what's your checklist?

title: AI-Assisted Research + Development Writer
description: Research + Development Writer AI-Assisted Course Creation for Online Learning Platform About the Role We are looking for a thoughtful, detail-oriented Research + Development Writer to help us create high-quality online courses using AI tools. You do not need to be an expert in coaching, psychology, business or education, although interest in these areas would be helpful. Your main role will be to follow a clear step-by-step process using AI tools such as ChatGPT to research course topics, develop lesson structures, and turn ideas into clear, engaging video scripts and learning materials. This is ideal for someone who enjoys learning new topics, working carefully with instructions, improving AI-generated content, and turning complex ideas into well-structured educational material. About the Business We are developing an AI-native education platform focused on coaching, philosophy and coaching business education. The courses will be delivered using AI video faculty, supported by scripts, visual guides, reflection questions, worksheets and other learning resources. Our aim is not to create cheap AI content. We want thoughtful, well-researched, beautifully structured learning experiences that feel intelligent, reflective and human. Main Responsibilities You will help create online courses by: * Using AI tools to research course topics * Following a step-by-step content development process * Turning rough course ideas into structured outlines * Developing module and lesson plans * Creating clear video scripts for AI presenters * Improving AI-generated drafts so they sound natural, thoughtful and useful * Checking that ideas are explained clearly and logically * Creating summaries, key points and reflection questions * Helping develop worksheets, workbook sections and learner exercises * Organising research notes and source material * Following brand, tone and formatting guidelines * Revising scripts based on feedback * Helping build repeatable systems for course creation What You Will Not Need to Do You do not need to appear on camera. You do not need to be a professional coach. You do not need to be a business expert. You do not need to create everything from scratch without guidance. You will be given processes, prompts, examples and feedback. Your job is to use AI carefully and intelligently, then shape the results into strong educational content. The Kind of Person We Are Looking For You may be a good fit if you are: A strong English writer Curious and willing to learn unfamiliar topics Comfortable using AI tools Careful with detail Good at following structured processes Able to improve rough drafts Able to organise complex information clearly Patient, thoughtful and self-directed Interested in education, psychology, coaching, leadership or personal development Open to feedback and willing to revise work Required Skills * Excellent written English * Experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools * Strong research and summarising ability * Good organisation skills * Ability to follow detailed instructions * Ability to turn information into clear, engaging scripts * Reliable communication * Good attention to detail Helpful But Not Required Experience or interest in any of the following would be useful: * Online course creation * Coaching or personal development * Psychology or philosophy * Business education * Instructional design * Copywriting * YouTube scripts * Academic research * Notion, Google Docs or project management tools Tools You May Use You may work with tools such as: * ChatGPT * Claude * Google Docs * Google Drive * Notion or similar project tools * Research tools * AI writing and editing tools Training and guidance will be provided where needed. Compensation Starting pay: PHP 35,000 to PHP 40,000 per month, depending on experience, skill level and fit. There is scope for growth over time as you become more skilled, take on more responsibility, and help improve the course creation process. We are looking for someone who can grow with the business, not just complete short-term tasks. Working Style This is a remote role. You will need to be comfortable working independently, following written instructions, and communicating clearly about progress, questions and challenges. The work will usually involve moving through a structured process from: 1. Course concept 2. AI-assisted research 3. Course outline 4. Module structure 5. Lesson script 6. Reflection questions 7. Workbook or worksheet content 8. Review and revision Example Tasks A typical task might be: * Research a topic using AI and provided sources * Create a structured course outline * Draft a 1,500-word video lesson script * Rewrite the script to make it clearer and more engaging * Create 5 reflection questions for learners * Create a short summary of the key ideas * Format everything neatly in Google Docs Important Qualities The most important qualities for this role are not subject-matter expertise. They are: * Clear thinking * Good writing * Careful use of AI * Willingness to follow a process * Curiosity * Reliability * Taste and judgement We want someone who can help turn AI-generated material into something much better: clearer, deeper, more useful and more human. How to Apply Please apply with: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Your writing or research experience 3. Your experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools 4. Why this role interests you 5. A sample of your writing, if available Please also answer this question: How would you use AI to help research and write a course script while still making sure the final result is clear, accurate and useful?

title: Email Management VA for Influencer Campaigns (CreatorFlow)
job_title: Email Management VA for Influencer Campaigns (CreatorFlow)
description: We are CreatorFlow, a Germany-based influencer management service specializing in micro-creators. We manage the inboxes of content creators and handle incoming brand collaboration requests on their behalf. Our goal is to filter, structure, and prepare collaboration opportunities so that creators can focus on content while we handle communication and deal flow. Your role is highly structured and process-driven. You will be responsible for reviewing incoming email s from brands and sending the first response based on a clear checklist and predefined system. The goal is to extract all relevant information needed to evaluate a potential collaboration. This is not a creative writing job. It is a logical, detail-oriented role where you follow a system and think carefully. What You Will Do: • Read incoming email s from brands (collaboration requests) • Carefully extract all available information from each email • Identify missing information using a structured checklist • Respond with a professional and friendly message requesting the missing details • Ensure that after your reply, all important collaboration details are clarified • Categorize email s into high-quality, unclear, or low-quality opportunities • Filter out irrelevant or low-value offers (e.g., product-only deals when not suitable) • Work across multiple creators with different requirements and standards • Occasionally respond differently depending on the creator’s preferences (e.g., rejecting certain offers directly) Key Objective: Your main goal is to ensure that every conversation is moved forward in a structured way so that all important information is available for decision-making. After your reply, we should clearly see: • What the brand wants • What they offer • Whether the collaboration is worth pursuing Typical Workload: • Around 30 to 60 minutes per day • Work should be done daily to keep inboxes up to date • Workload may increase over time Requirements: • Strong written English (very important) • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally • Strong attention to detail • Ability to follow structured processes • Logical thinking and decision-making • Reliability and consistency Nice to Have: • German language skills (many email s are in German) • Experience with email tools (Zoho, Gmail, etc.) • Experience with influencer marketing or brand collaborations • Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT (allowed and encouraged if used correctly) Important Context: We manage multiple creators, and each creator has different collaboration rules. Examples: • Some creators accept product-only collaborations • Others only accept paid deals • Some require minimum budgets You must be able to: • Understand which creator the email is for • Apply the correct logic when responding • Make smart decisions based on guidelines Screening & Growth: We will start with a paid test task to evaluate your ability to follow instructions, think logically, and communicate professionally. If you perform well, this position can turn into a long-term role with: • More working hours • More responsibility • Growth within the company We are looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, and structured who wants to grow with us long-term.

title: High-Energy Beat Sync Video Edit
description: Welcome! Before you begin, please follow the workflow below. Google Drive Assets Click here to access the Google Drive folder with all project files: [INSERT GOOGLE DRIVE LINK] Step 1 — Watch the Storyboard Open STORYBOARD VIDEO.mp4 first. This AI-generated video explains the story and overall vision for the project. It is not the final editing style. It is simply there to help you understand the sequence of events and what is happening throughout the music video. The drop section is the part you will be recreating and elevating. Step 2 — Watch the CapCut Instructional Video Open the CAPCUT INSTRUCTIONAL VIDEO next. This video shows me creating a quick sample and explains the basic editing approach I want you to follow. Step 3 — Watch the Demo Open CAPCUT DEMO WITH MUSIC.mp4. This is the finished basic example I created in about 10 minutes to demonstrate the overall editing philosophy. Notice how almost every beat introduces a new visual event that progresses the story. Your job is to take this concept and elevate it 10x using your creativity and professional editing skills. Step 4 — Build Everything Using the Beat Markers Open the AUDIO folder and import BEAT MARKERS.mp3 into your editing software first. This is the most important file in the project. The beat markers are the blueprint for your edit. Every transient represents a major beat in the music and should guide the timing of your entire sequence. Nearly every beat should trigger a meaningful visual event, such as camera movement, scene progression, object movement, destruction, character entrances, reveals, transitions, or visual effects. When the beat hits, the viewer should see or feel something happen. Once your sequence is finished, replace the beat marker track with THE DROP SKARNAX.mp3 and make any final timing adjustments to ensure everything is perfectly synchronized with the music. Step 5 — Submit a 5-Second Demo If you're interested in working on this project, please create a 5-second demo using the assets provided in this Google Drive. Along with your demo, please include a short explanation of your creative vision and the editing techniques you chose to use. If your demo demonstrates strong beat synchronization, creative scene composition, and exceptional attention to detail, I'll reach out to discuss the full 26-second project. I'm much more interested in the quality of your work than the speed at which it's completed.

Maintain brand consistency and distinct voice across every client account. Track content performance and deliver clear, simple monthly reports. WHAT WE REQUIRE Experience: Minimum 2 years managing social media for multiple clients in an agency or freelance capacity. Portfolio or examples required with your application. If you encounter a problem, you first resource a solution on your own and collaborate with others on the team before asking for help, but if you're stuck, you're not afraid to ask for help and offer solutions. Clients receive their content calendar proposal before they think to ask for it. Feedback rounds are smooth because the submission was clear. Approvals come back fast because you made it easy to say yes. Posts go out on time, every time, without anyone checking in on you. Brand voice is consistent, copy is sharp, and reports are clean. You do not let details fall through. You are not waiting to be told what to do next. You know what the next step is and you take it. WORKING WITH MISSION SIERRA MEDIA The work will begin with part-time hours (4 hours daily) with the option to grow full time (8 hours daily / 40 hours weekly). The ability to manage multiple client accounts and grow your portfolio. Remote, flexible work from the Philippines. But work U.S. compatible EST (New York) hours. title: Senior Operations & Systems Manager
description: # Operations & Systems Manager (Remote) ## Company Introduction Buckeye Illumination is a fast-growing outdoor lighting company based in Ohio, specializing in premium Christmas lighting, permanent architectural lighting, and exterior lighting solutions for residential and commercial properties. We're building more than a lighting company—we're building scalable systems and a world-class customer experience. As we continue to grow, we're looking for someone who enjoys creating order, improving processes, solving problems, and helping build the foundation of a business. This isn't a traditional Virtual Assistant role. You'll work directly with the owner to document systems, implement AI and automation, improve operations, and help build a company designed to scale. --- ## Key Duties & Responsibilities * Build and maintain the company's Operations Manual. * Create high-level process documentation for every department. * Write detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). * Develop employee training manuals and onboarding materials. * Build and maintain an organized company knowledge base. * Improve existing workflows and recommend new systems. * Assist with recruiting, onboarding, and training future tea ---------- mbers. * Organize projects and ensure deadlines are met. * Research software, vendors, and operational improvements. * Implement AI tools and business automation where appropriate. * Manage CRM workflows and customer communication processes. * Track company KPIs and create management reports. * Coordinate projects with internal and external tea ---------- mbers. * Take ownership of assigned projects from start to finish. --- ## Required Qualifications ### Required * 3+ years of Operations, Project Management, Executive Assistant, or Business Administration experience. * Excellent written and spoken English. * Strong organizational and time management skills. * Exceptional attention to detail. * Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking ability. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Experience creating SOPs and documenting business processes. * Comfortable learning new software quickly. * Reliable high-speed internet connection. * Professional home office environment. ### Preferred Software Experience * **GoHighLevel (HighLevel)** – CRM, pipelines, workflows, automations, AI integrations, calendars, forms, and customer communication. * **ClickUp** (preferred), Asana, or ---------- . * **Slack** for team communication. * **Google Workspace** (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Calendar). * **Microsoft Office**. * **ChatGPT** and other AI productivity tools. * **Zapier**, **Make**, or **n8n** automation platforms. ### Bonus Qualifications * Experience managing remote teams. * Experience implementing operational systems. * Experience with AI workflow development. * Process improvement or Lean operations experience. * Experience working with U.S.-based service businesses. --- ## Additional Information We're looking for someone who wants to grow with our company long-term. This role has the opportunity to become a leadership position as we continue to expand. We're not looking for someone who simply completes tasks—we're looking for someone who enjoys building systems, solving problems, improving efficiency, and taking ownership. Our ideal candidate is proactive, organized, resourceful, and excited about using technology and AI to build a world-class operation. Hours are 9am-5pm EST hours will be a set 40hrs Mon-Fri. with additional hours as needed during peak season. Pay period is Biweekly rate will be based on final role and experience ranging from $1,200 to +$2,000 with performance bonuses. **To confirm you've read this posting, begin your application with the phrase "Built to Scale."** When applying, please include: * Your resume. * A brief introduction explaining why you're interested in this role. * Examples of SOPs, process documentation, operations manuals, or workflow improvements you've created (if available). * A short Loom video (2–5 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a great fit. * Your experience with GoHighLevel, ClickUp, Slack, AI tools, and business automation. * Your expected hourly rate and your weekly availability.

title: Research Analyst

Your responsibilities will include: • Reviewing the research brief. • Reviewing all interview transcripts and summaries. • Identifying recurring themes and patterns. • Performing additional secondary research where necessary. • Determining whether the original hypothesis is supported, should be revised, or should be rejected. • Quantifying the business impact wherever possible. • Identifying the root cause of the problem. • Writing a clear final report based entirely on the evidence. title: Business Research Interviewer
description: Hey! I'm looking for someone to help me with the second stage of a business research project. The goal is simple: talk to business owners and uncover how they actually work. Your responsibilities will include: • Reviewing the research brief. • Creating an interview guide. • Contacting businesses by email , LinkedIn and/or phone. • Scheduling interviews. • Conducting approximately 10–20 interviews. • Recording interviews (with permission). • Creating AI transcripts. • Writing a short summary after every interview. • Adapting the interview questions if new themes emerge. At the end of the project, I'd like to receive: • Interview recordings (where permission was given). • Interview transcripts. • A summary for every interview. • The final interview guide. • Any observations that you think will help the analyst understand the interviews. The project pays €300 and is expected to take about three weeks. I'm looking for someone who is naturally curious, listens carefully, and asks good follow-up questions. To apply, please give me a short introduction about yourself. I’d also like to see how you approach this kind of work, so please walk me through your thought process for the following: • Imagine you’re about to interview a business owner. What information would you want to uncover, and why do you think it’s important? • If, halfway through the project, you discover that the original hypothesis seems wrong, what would you do? • Imagine you're interviewing the owner of a small business. They tell you everything is running smoothly. How would you continue the conversation to uncover potential problems? Feel free to give examples of things you would ask/say. This project is expected to begin after the previous stage of the research project has been completed. I'll keep you updated on the expected start date throughout the process. title: Dispatcher - Customer Service with Emergency Response Background
job_title: Dispatcher - Customer Service with Emergency Response Background
description: Job description: Remote · $10–$12/hr · Full Time · U.S. Company hiring from the Philippines About SureFire CPR SureFire CPR helps people get the lifesaving training and certifications they need, when they need them. We run a 24/7 CPR training operation so students can get real support, complete their certification, and actually feel confident doing it. Our mission is simple: equip people with the skills to save lives. We operate across 100+ locations and are scaling to 1,000 before 2029, which means more people who can step in when it counts, for a coworker, a patient, a stranger, a child. When a student calls for help, the person who picks up represents everything we're trying to do. Who We Are We help people save lives. That's it. 24 hours a day, every day. Three values run through everything we do, including, how we hire, how we coach, how we lead, and how we show up for students. They're not a tagline. They're non-negotiable. We Set the Pace. We move fast, get it done, and are proud of it. We take proactive, bold action and let nothing stand in our way. We’re resourceful, methodical and curious. We take others with us. We don’t wait to be told. We just go. Because the work matters. Make It Simple. Simple isn’t easy - it’s a choice we make on purpose. We take the extra time to remove anything that isn’t essential, and we step back often to make sure we're still focused on what matters most. Because complexity is the enemy of execution. Care Deeply. About the impact. About doing things right. About each other. We do more - the little bit extra that surprises people and makes them feel special. We never stop at “good enough.” Because caring deeply helps save lives. A Note from the Head of Delivery Our students are nurses, parents, coaches, teachers, first responders. A lot of them are anxious. Some are frustrated. A few are calling during genuinely hard ---------- nts. The person who answers sets the tone. We need someone who can stay calm, listen well, and give clear direction without making the student feel like a burden. Someone who follows the process, communicates with care, and stays with the problem until it's solved. You don't need CPR training experience — we'll teach you everything you need to know. But if you've worked in healthcare support, EMS, 911 dispatch, technical support, or any environment where urgency and empathy had to coexist, you'll get up to speed fast. Here's what we're looking for: You own the call. No deflecting, no passing the buck. You communicate clearly, even when the student is flustered. You follow the process and sweat the details. You can be kind and firm at the same time. You care about why this work matters, not just what the task is. If that sounds like you, keep reading. What You'll Do You are the student's point of contact when something goes wrong, something is confusing, or they just need someone to walk them through it. Your job is to resolve it on that call, whenever possible. Answer with urgency. You move first. You don't let confusion sit and turn into frustration. Treat every call like it matters. Because to that student, it does. They may need this certification for a job, a license, a deadline. Document everything. Accurate notes, correct dispositions, updated systems. The next person who touches that account needs to know what happened. Bring problems forward. If you're hearing a question without a dedicated response in our system, that's a signal. You flag it so training can fix it. What Success Looks Like Students leave the call knowing exactly what to do next Issues get resolved with you, not transferred to someone else Every interaction is documented accurately Recurring gaps in the process get surfaced and fixed Students get the same quality of support whether they call at 2pm or 2am How You'll Work This is a 24/7 operation. Shifts may include evenings, weekends, holidays, or overnight hours depending on business needs. Reliability isn't optional. Students are counting on us to pick up. You'll work closely with the rest of the Delivery Team: Training & QA — When you spot a recurring question or a confusing instruction, you bring it to them. They build the fixes; you give them the raw material. Facilities — When a location issue affects a student's experience, you document it and escalate it properly. Dispatch Team — You communicate clearly with your teammates, share context, and help maintain coverage. No student falls through the cracks because a hand off was sloppy. What You Bring Strong spoken and written English Experience in emergency response work — Emergency response, technical support, dispatch, or similar A track record of helping frustrated or anxious people without getting rattled Attention to detail and accurate documentation habits Comfortable picking up new platforms and tools quickly The ability to follow a process closely, and to ask when something isn't clear An ownership mindset — you don't wait to be told to care Helpful Background Any of these will help you ramp faster, but none are required: Healthcare or medical scheduling support · EMS or 911 dispatch · CPR, BLS, ACLS, or First Aid experience What Won't Work Here Guessing instead of asking Transferring problems you could have solved Getting defensive with frustrated students Skipping documentation because it feels like extra work Treating this like ordinary customer service It isn't ordinary. The standard stays the same whether it's busy, slow, or 3am. How to Apply Record a Loom video — 3 minutes max — answering two questions: Tell us about a time you helped a frustrated or confused customer. What happened, and what did you do? Why this role? We're not looking for a polished pitch. We want to hear how you communicate and how you think. Upload your resume, your Loom link, and your written responses to questions at the link below. We only take applicants who apply through this form: ---------- In the "Anything else?" field, begin your first sentence with one of our values. Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed. Benefits: Paid training Work from home Work Location: Remote

title: Right-Hand VA (AI & Tech Focus) — Clean Christian Music App

We'd take a brilliant fast-learner over a seasoned coaster every single time. A self-starter who takes initiative instead of waiting to be told, and teaches themselves what they don't know. Helpful (but NOT required — we'll train you) AI & automation — bonus points for hands-on Claude / Claude Code experience, automation work (n8n, Make, Zapier), or any interest in coding or scripting. Using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your daily workflow. Data analysis (with AI's help) to generate reports and spot trends. Pinterest / social media scheduling tools. Customer service experience. WordPress publishing and AI image generation (e.g., Ideogram, gpt-image). Influencer outreach and management. The details: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term. title: Architect (Medior & Senior)
description: Overview REMBOX is an international architecture, engineering, and BIM services company with over 650 professionals across Israel, Europe, and North America. We partner with leading architectural firms, engineering consultancies, project managers, and construction companies, providing architectural, structural, and BIM services for projects in Israel and the United States. Our portfolio includes residential complexes, high-rise towers, public buildings, office developments, industrial facilities, and large-scale infrastructure projects. As part of our global growth strategy, we are expanding our operations in the Philippines and are seeking talented architects to build an international career while working remotely with world-class clients and project teams. All candidates must meet the following baseline requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Architecture Experience with Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD Strong professional ethics and attention to quality Ability to work effectively in a remote team environment Willingness to learn and continuously develop professional skills Strong communication and teamwork abilities Ability to work according to company standards and project requirements Experience Levels: Medior: 2–5 years of professional experience, with demonstrated independent work capability. Requires: Strong Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD skills (intermediate to advanced), ability to produce and deliver project documentation independently, understanding of BIM workflows and coordination processes, experience coordinating with structural and MEP disciplines. Senior: 5+ years of professional experience, with project leadership and tea ---------- ntoring experience. Requires: Advanced Autodesk Revit expertise (templates, standards, large model management), strong BIM coordination experience across disciplines, demonstrated experience leading project teams and documentation processes, experience reviewing, supervising, and approving deliverables, leadership, mentoring, and people development skills, excellent communication skills for client-facing and multidisciplinary coordination. Please note: For this specific hiring round, we are exclusively considering Medior and Senior candidates. Junior candidates are welcome to express interest for future openings once our Philippine team expands. What REMBOX Offers Full-time remote employment Long-term career opportunities within a growing international company Participation in large-scale international projects in Israel and the United States Professional mentoring and development programs BIM, software, and technical training Clear career growth path (Junior to Medior to Senior) Collaborative, people-centered work culture International team of 650+ professionals Onboarding & Employment Structure During the initial months, candidates will work as independent contractors under a formal agreement with REMBOX's Israeli company. Upon the establishment of the local Philippine entity, contractors will transition to direct employment through REMBOX Philippines. This transition to local PH employment is a confirmed part of the onboarding plan. title: Community & Brand Ambassador
description: # Job Description: Community & Brand Ambassador ## Company: BRUMICON ## Position Type: Full-Time ## Reports To: Operations Manager ## Compensation: P20,000 - P40,000 (Based on skills and experience) ## About BRUMICON BRUMICON is an entertainment studio centered mainly on creating high-quality video games and interactive experiences. Our mission is built into our name: **BRU — Bringing Real Unity** **MI — Meaningful Interactions** **CON — Combining Our Narratives** We believe games are more than entertainment. They bring people together, create shared stories, and build communities that players want to return to. BRUMICON is looking for a passionate and energetic **Community & Brand Ambassador** to help grow our brand, connect with players, and become one of the public voices of our company. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to enter the gaming, entertainment, and social media field and grow with a creative studio from the ground up. --- ## Role Overview The **Community & Brand Ambassador** will help manage BRUMICON’s public presence across social media, livestreaming platforms, and gaming communities. This person will create content, engage players, host livestreams, build excitement around BRUMICON, and help grow our audience. The ideal candidate is a natural entertainer: confident, charismatic, energetic, creative, and comfortable talking to strangers. They should enjoy gaming culture, love connecting with people online, and be able to make viewers feel welcomed, entertained, and excited to follow BRUMICON. This role is especially focused on engaging the Filipino gaming community, while also helping BRUMICON reach players from other countries. --- ## Key Responsibilities ### Social Media & Brand Management * Manage and help grow BRUMICON’s social media presence across platforms such as: * Facebook * TikTok * YouTube * Instagram * X/Twitter * ---------- * Twitch or other livestreaming platforms, if needed * Create regular posts, videos, updates, announcements, ---------- s, short-form content, community questions, and promotional material. * Maintain a consistent posting schedule and brand voice. * Help build hype, recognition, and excitement around BRUMICON and its projects. * Monitor comments, messages, reactions, and community feedback. * Respond to players and followers in a friendly, professional, and engaging way. --- ### Video Content & Livestreaming * Appear on camera for videos, livestreams, announcements, interviews, updates, and community content. * Host livestreams for gameplay, community events, Q&A sessions, contests, previews, and special announcements. * Record, edit, and publish short-form and long-form video content. * Create entertaining content that helps viewers feel connected to BRUMICON. * Help develop a recognizable online personality for the brand. * Learn and improve livestreaming techniques over time. Prior professional livestreaming experience is not required, but the candidate must be confident, engaging, and willing to learn. --- ### Community Engagement * Help build and manage BRUMICON’s player community, especially on ---------- and social platforms. * Welcome new community members and encourage positive interaction. * Start conversations, polls, challenges, discussions, and community activities. * Gather player feedback and report important trends, questions, and concerns to the Operations Manager. * Help create a fun, respectful, and exciting community atmosphere. * Encourage players to feel that they are part of BRUMICON’s journey. --- ### Contests, Events & Collaborations * Plan and help host online contests, giveaways, challenges, and community events. * Collaborate with gamers, streamers, influencers, creators, and community leaders. * Help identify potential partners and influencers who fit BRUMICON’s brand. * Coordinate promotional activities to increase brand recognition and player engagement. * From time to time, attend public gaming events, competitions, conventions, or community gatherings when requested. * Conduct casual interviews with players, creators, influencers, or event participants when needed. Travel may occasionally be required for public events, gaming competitions, or promotional activities. --- ### Story-Based Brand Content * Help create fictional story-based content that supports BRUMICON’s brand and intellectual properties. * Assist with ideas for animated or voice-acted episodes, character-driven shorts, lore-based videos, and narrative promotional content. * Help write or develop episode ideas, scripts, voice lines, and social media story content. * Participate as a host, narrator, voice actor, or on-camera personality when appropriate. * Coordinate with editors, animators, artists, writers, or voice actors when needed. * Promote story-based episodes across BRUMICON’s social platforms. --- ### Content Planning & Reporting * Help maintain a content calendar for social media posts, videos, livestreams, contests, and community events. * Track basic performance metrics such as follower growth, livestream viewers, engagement, content consistency, and player feedback. * Report what content performs well and suggest ways to improve future content. * Stay aware of gaming trends, Filipino gaming culture, ---------- s, popular creators, and current social media formats. * Bring creative ideas to the team regularly. --- ## Required Qualifications * Must be based in the Philippines. * Must speak and write English very well. * Must speak Tagalog. * Strong interest in gaming and gaming culture. * Comfortable appearing on camera. * Comfortable speaking with strangers online and in person. * Confident, energetic, and naturally engaging personality. * Able to create regular social media content. * Able to host or learn to host livestreams. * Able to communicate clearly and professionally with players and followers. * Creative mindset with a strong sense of what makes content entertaining. * Reliable, organized, and able to follow a content schedule. * Willing to learn new tools, platforms, and content creation skills. * Willing to occasionally travel for gaming events, competitions, or promotional activities when needed. --- ## Preferred Qualifications The more of these skills the candidate has, the better: * Experience creating TikTok, Facebook , YouTube, Instagram, or livestream content. * Experience managing a ---------- community. * Experience with gaming communities, esports, online games, mobile games, PC games, indie games, or card/strategy games. * Experience recording and editing short-form videos. * Experience writing captions, scripts, announcements, or promotional posts. * Experience hosting livestreams, interviews, events, or community activities. * Experience collaborating with influencers, gamers, streamers, or creators. * Familiarity with tools such as: * Canva * CapCut * Adobe Premiere Pro * Adobe Photoshop * OBS Studio * Streamlabs * ---------- * Meta Business Suite * TikTok Studio * YouTube Studio * Google Workspace * Trello, Notion, Asana, or similar project tools * Other Filipino languages, such as Cebuano or others, are a bonus. --- ## Ideal Personality Fit We are looking for someone who is: * Charismatic * Confident * Creative * Energetic * Comfortable talking to new people * A natural entertainer * Friendly and approachable * Passionate about games * Excited to build a community * Able to make people smile, laugh, and feel included * Comfortable being one of the public faces of the BRUMICON brand This role is not just about posting content. It is about helping people feel connected to BRUMICON. --- ## Success Metrics Success in this role may be measured by: * Growth of BRUMICON’s social media followers. * Growth of livestream viewers and repeat viewers. * Consistency and quality of posted content. * Community engagement and player interaction. * Quality of player feedback gathered and reported. * Growth and activity of the ---------- /community space. * Successful contests, events, and collaborations. * Increased brand recognition among gamers, especially within the Filipino gaming community. --- ## Work Setup This is a full-time, fully remote position for someone based in the Philippines. The role may require flexible hours at times, especially during livestreams, gaming events, community activities, or collaborations with creators in different time zones. Occasional travel may be required for public gaming events, competitions, conventions, interviews, or promotional appearances. --- ## How to Apply Interested applicants should submit: * Resume or short work profile. * Links to any social media pages, videos, livestreams, gaming content, or sample work, if available. * A short intro video introducing yourself. In your intro video, please include: * Your name. * Your location in the Philippines. * Languages you speak. * Your gaming background. * Why you are interested in BRUMICON. * Why you think you would be a great Community & Brand Ambassador. Prior professional experience is helpful, but not required. We are looking for someone with the right personality, creativity, passion for gaming, and ability to connect with people.

description: Content, Creative & Operations Support — for a Growing Singapore-based Digital Agency In plain terms: a hands-on, do-a-bit-of-everything marketer — copywriting-led, with design, video, and light ops support — who helps a lean agency run and grow. Full-Time • Remote • Long-Term Career Opportunity SGD600/month (probation) ? SGD800/month (on confirmation), with progression to SGD1,000–1,200 based on competency Reports directly to the Founder. You'll join a lean core team — Founder, Executive Assistant, and you — with a designer and freelance specialists supporting the work. ABOUT US Meander Digital is the digital marketing partner of choice for founder-led and expert-led service-based businesses. We help our clients rise above their competition and become recognised in the marketplace for their expertise through timeless sales and marketing strategies. Our work spans direct response advertising (performance marketing), lead generation, personal branding, and content marketing. We run lean by design. Our core team is small — the Founder, an Executive Assistant, and you — supported by a trusted network of freelance specialists. We believe that in an AI-enabled world, a capable, cross-functional operator can create the kind of leverage that used to require several separate hires. We are not looking for someone to stay inside one narrow job scope. We are looking for a T-shaped marketer — someone with real depth in one craft and the range to contribute across many — who enjoys making themselves useful across the business and quietly makes the whole team more effective. "A jack of all trades is a master of none, but oftentimes better than a master of one." That, in one line, is who we're looking for. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF… - You only want to specialise in one function and have no interest in learning adjacent skills. - You instinctively say "that's not my job" rather than "what do I need to learn to move this forward?" - You wait for instructions instead of looking for problems to solve. - You dislike standard operating procedures, documentation, and organised systems. - You treat AI-generated work as a finished product. - You are looking for a short-term stepping stone before your next opportunity. - You become stressed when priorities change in a fast-moving agency environment.
