YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Content & Marketing Support - Conduct audience, competitor, and industry research - Draft AI-assisted ad copy, email s, landing pages, and social media content - Set up and launch Meta ads campaigns (campaign optimisation stays with the Founder/media buyer) - Repurpose long-form content into short-form assets - Build and maintain swipe files and research libraries Creative Production (to a functional standard — our designer owns final polish) - Create and edit graphics in Canva - Resize and adapt existing ad creatives - Edit short-form videos using CapCut or equivalent software - Generate and refine AI-generated images where appropriate - Collaborate with our designer when an asset needs a higher level of polish Operations & Coordination (a supporting role — our Executive Assistant owns this area) - Help coordinate workflow between internal tea ---------- mbers and freelancers - Work alongside the Executive Assistant — not in place of her — as the subject-matter/technical point of contact for tea ---------- mbers, freelancers, and clients on marketing and creative work, keeping communication clear and timely (the Founder owns client strategy and decisions) - Support the Executive Assistant in following up on outstanding tasks and commitments, with firmness and tact, keeping projects moving without unnecessary friction - Help maintain clear communication across a geographically distributed team spanning Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Malaysia - Help track deliverables and keep projects moving forward - Maintain organised file structures and digital assets - Contribute to SOPs, checklists, and internal documentation Marketing the Business (our own agency marketing and the founder's personal brand) - Help publish case studies and keep our website current - Support email marketing, social media content, and lead generation initiatives - Turn the founder's ideas, talks, and raw recordings into publishable assets — LinkedIn content, long-form articles, video, podcast repurposing - Provide research and presentation support for thought-leadership initiatives Internal Projects & Documentation - Help move internal projects from idea to implementation — SOP creation, AI implementation, knowledge base development, workflow optimisation - Document key workflows so institutional knowledge no longer sits with only one person - Support small internal experiments and strategic initiatives From time to time you'll also provide secondary support on meeting preparation and reporting or data consolidation. You are not expected to replace specialists — you're expected to become competent enough to provide continuity when required. WORKING ENVIRONMENT Fully remote, full-time, with fixed hours of 9am–6pm Singapore time. If you're based in the Philippines, Indonesia, or Malaysia, that's regular daytime hours — we share a similar time zone. title: Enterprise Integrator Full-Time | Remote (Daylight Overlap)
description: About Us We are a private enterprise infrastructure and governance firm. We build highly structured, automated systems for enterprise clients. We operate a streamlined model, utilizing workflow automation to eliminate manual administrative layers. We value calm focus, direct communication, and deep clarity in systems. Why This Role Exists We are looking for a singular operational integrator to manage our automated systems. You will serve as the central bridge connecting our payment gateways, relational databases, and compliance documentation. Your objective is to ensure the enterprise runs with strict operational discipline and perfect data hygiene, completely removing the Chairman from daily operational noise. Core Responsibilities Workflow Automation: You will manage and maintain the automated logic that connects our financial gateways to our internal databases, ensuring that contracts, payments, and data flow without manual data entry. Deal Desk Governance: You are the absolute gatekeeper of our commercial pipeline. You will enforce strict binary rules: no project or deal moves forward without a standardized transaction ID and verified payment. The Exception Queue: You act as the ultimate operational shield. You do not wait for step-by-step instructions. You solve problems independently and only escalate the "Exception Queue" to leadership with fully built solutions that require only a "Yes" or "No" approval. The Ideal Candidate Profile The Grounded Operator: You project institutional calm. You are emotionally regulated, highly disciplined, and thrive in structured environments where rules are mathematically defined. title: EA / Book Keeper
description: About the role I’m an executive running ann entertainment/talent supply business — and I’m looking for a sharp, reliable Executive Assistant who can also handle bookkeeping. This is a true right-hand role. I move fast across a lot of projects, and I need someone who can keep everything on track without me having to chase it. If you’re organized to the point of being slightly obsessive, you like systems, and you take genuine ownership of your work, we’ll get along well. If the trial goes well — and I expect it to with the right person — this becomes a permanent, long-term full-time role with room to grow as my businesses do. I want to find someone I can build with for years, not just fill a seat. How to apply Please don’t send a generic application. To show me you read this carefully: 1. Start your message with the word “Anchor” so I know you read to the end. 2. Tell me briefly about a founder or executive you’ve supported, and one thing you did that made their life easier. 3. List the bookkeeping tool(s) you’ve used and your level of Airtable experience (none / some / strong). 4. Attach/supply your resume if you have one. What You Will Do • Design schematics and PCB layouts in KiCad based on specifications we provide • Select components and source parts from LCSC, Mouser, DigiKey, and AliExpress • Generate manufacturing files and order assembled PCBs from JLCPCB • Read datasheets, verify pin assignments, check footprints, and confirm compatibility before ordering • Troubleshoot assembled boards (we will provide test equipment as needed) • Coordinate with enclosure designers on board dimensions, mounting holes, and connector placement • Maintain organized project files in Git (we will set up repositories for you) • Communicate daily via chat/messaging and weekly via video call Current Project Your first project is two small I2C expansion boards for an ESP32-S3-based e-paper display product: Board A - Button Strip: A long narrow PCB (~260mm × 15mm) carrying an MCP23017 GPIO expander, 7 IP67 sealed tactile switches, a WS2812B addressable RGB LED, an LIS3DH accelerometer, a DRV5032 hall effect sensor, a piezo buzzer with MOSFET driver, ESD protection, and Qwiic/STEMMA QT connectors. Standard I2C bus, 3.3V logic, straightforward 2-layer board. Board B - NFC Reader: A small PCB carrying a PN532 NFC module and a Qwiic connector. Very simple board. Additionally: specify battery contacts and wiring harness for a 21700 lithium cell, and create a connection guide documenting how the expansion boards wire to the main driver board. The full technical specification for these boards is already written and will be provided to the person we hire. All design decisions have been made: component choices, I2C addresses, pin allocations, connector types. Your job is to translate the specification into working KiCad files, order boards from JLCPCB, and verify they work. Future Projects After the expansion boards, upcoming hardware work includes: • Enclosure design coordination (working with a mechanical designer) • A barcode/document scanner accessory • RFID scanners • Possible custom main board (consolidating the current off-the-shelf driver board into a single integrated PCB) • Other IoT accessories for our product platform This role grows as the product line grows. ________________________________________ Requirements Must Have • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or closely related field • Ability to read and understand component datasheets, application notes, and reference designs • Working knowledge of basic electronics: I2C, SPI, GPIO, pull-up resistors, decoupling capacitors, voltage regulators, MOSFETs • Experience with KiCad (Or strong willingness to learn. If you know Altium, Eagle, or EasyEDA, KiCad will come quickly.) • Experience ordering PCBs from JLCPCB, PCBWay, or similar fab houses • Careful and detail-oriented - you double-check footprints before ordering, you verify pin assignments against the datasheet, you ask questions when something is unclear • Strong written English communication • Reliable internet connection and availability during overlapping work hours (we are in US Pacific time, UTC-8) Nice to Have • Experience with ESP32 or other microcontroller platforms • Experience with I2C sensor boards, GPIO expanders, or NFC modules • Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control • Experience with JLCPCB's SMT assembly service specifically (BOM formatting, CPL files) • Any experience with e-paper/e-ink displays • Experience with consumer or IoT product development (not just academic projects) • RF or antenna design Not Required • Firmware or software development (we handle this) • Mechanical / enclosure design (potentially separate role, but you will coordinate with that person) • High-speed digital or power electronics Strong Bonus Experience with 3D CAD (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks) for enclosure design. Our products require custom 3D-printed enclosures, and a candidate who can own both the electronics and the enclosure design will be prioritized and compensated at the higher end of the range. If you have designed and 3D-printed enclosures for electronics projects - even personal or academic projects - please include photos, CPL files) ________________________________________ Work Arrangement • Hours: 20 hours per week to start, with potential to increase as projects grow • Schedule: Flexible, but we need at least 2–3 hours of overlap with US Pacific time (evenings in the Philippines typically work well) for real-time communication • Communication: Daily async updates via chat (Slack or similar), weekly 30-minute video call for project sync • Tools we provide: GitHub repository access, KiCad project templates, all component datasheets and specifications, JLCPCB account or reimbursement for fabrication orders • Duration: Ongoing, long-term. This is not a 1-month contract. We are building a multi-year product line and want someone who grows with us. ________________________________________ Compensation ?45,000–65,000/month (~$800–1,200 USD) Payment monthly via bank transfer, PayPal, or Wise. ________________________________________ How to Apply Please provide: 1. Your resume or CV with education, work experience, and any relevant projects 2. 2 or more examples of PCBs you have designed - KiCad screenshots, Gerber renders, or photos of assembled boards. Academic projects are fine if you have no professional examples. If you have not designed a PCB before, please be honest about that. 3. A brief message (3-5 sentences) explaining why this role interests you and what relevant experience you have 4.     A short video introduction (1–2 minutes, phone camera is fine). Please tell us your name, your educational background, one electronics project you've worked on that you're proud of, and why this role interests you. We are not evaluating production quality - we want to hear how you communicate and learn a bit about your experience in your own words. Paid Screening Task Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short paid test ($20 USD): We will send you a schematic of an existing circuit board and a component datasheet. Using those references, draw a schematic (in KiCad, by hand, or in any tool you prefer) showing how to connect an MCP23017 I2C GPIO expander to an ESP32-S3's I2C bus with 4 tactile button inputs, proper pull-up resistors, decoupling capacitors, and debounce capacitors. Include I2C device addressing. This should take 30-60 minutes for someone comfortable with I2C and basic schematic capture. We are evaluating: correctness of the circuit, understanding of I2C fundamentals, attention to detail (pull-ups, decoupling, addressing), and clarity of the schematic. Everyone who completes the test will be paid regardless of whether we hire them. ________________________________________ About Us We are a small US-based technology company building software and hardware products for a specialized professional market. Our software platform is in active development. The hardware products are IoT accessories that connect to our software platform via WiFi/MQTT. We are a small team that values clear communication, careful work, and people who take ownership of their area. This is a real company building real products. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not someone looking for a quick gig. ________________________________________ To Apply Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume, PCB examples (if any), and your brief message. We will respond to all qualified applicants within 3–5 business days.
